sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
details[data-ok-accordion][data-ok-variant][name]?[open]?   React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  summary[data-ok-accordion-summary][aria-disabled][tabindex="-1"]?   (disabled)
    … title (your heading, e.g. <h3>) and secondary text
    span[data-ok-accordion-icon][aria-hidden="true"] › svg[data-ok-accordion-plus] | your icon
  div[data-ok-accordion-details]
  div[data-ok-accordion-actions][data-ok-disable-spacing]?
```
Native `<details>` / `<summary>`: opening, keyboard (Enter / Space on the summary) and find-in-page
work without JavaScript. Same `name` = one open at a time (exclusive group).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `accordion`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `accordion-actions`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `name` (native attribute, exclusive group) · React `expanded` / `defaultExpanded` /
`onChange(expanded)`; `AccordionSummary expandIcon`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Summary: padding 16px / 8px end, `--ok-typography-subtitle1-*`; details: padding 0 16px 16px,
  `--ok-typography-body2-*`, `--ok-text-secondary`. Stories put the summary text in a Typography
  (`subtitle1`, `component="span"`, like the reference), plus a `body2` / `textSecondary` line
  in "Controlled".
- `default`: closed items are separated by `--ok-divider`; the open item is a card
  (`--ok-bg-paper`, `--ok-shadow-z8`, `--ok-radius-md`) with a 16px gutter above and below.
- `outlined`: one bordered list (`--ok-divider`, `--ok-radius-md`), items joined.
- `soft`: separate filled items (`channel(grey-500)` 8 %, 16 % when open, `--ok-radius-xl`), 8px apart; content uses `text-primary` (secondary text on the 16 % tint is below AA).
- Icon: the default plus turns into a minus; any icon rotates 180° when open.
- Actions: flex row at the end, 8px between the actions (0 with `disableSpacing`), padding 0 16px 16px.
- Disabled: `--ok-text-disabled`, no pointer events.
- Opening animates the content height where `::details-content` / `interpolate-size` are supported.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
No runtime needed to open and close. The HTML runtime adds: `ok:accordion:beforetoggle`
(cancelable, `detail.open` = the requested state) on summary activation, `ok:accordion:toggle`
after the change, and the exclusive-group fallback where `<details name>` isn't supported
(`closeOtherDetails` in core, shared with React).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: `Tab` to a summary, `Enter` / `Space` toggles. Disabled summaries are skipped.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
The summary is the disclosure button (native `aria-expanded` semantics). Put a heading inside the
summary for the page outline. Disabled: `aria-disabled="true"`, removed from the tab order.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:accordion:beforetoggle` (cancelable), `ok:accordion:toggle` (`detail.open`); instance
`toggle(open?)`, `isOpen`. React: `onChange(expanded)`; controlled refusal by not changing
`expanded`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Full width of its container at every breakpoint; long titles wrap.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API pages Accordion, AccordionSummary, AccordionDetails, AccordionActions.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Accordion` `children`, `disabled`, `disableGutters` | same | kept | |
| `expanded`, `defaultExpanded` | same; HTML `open` | kept | |
| `onChange(event, expanded)` | `onChange(expanded)`; HTML `ok:accordion:beforetoggle` / `toggle` | renamed | no event argument |
| `slots.heading` (default `h3` around the summary) | author's heading inside the summary | renamed | composition |
| `slots.region` / `slots.transition` (Collapse, `unmountOnExit`) | `div[data-ok-accordion-details]`, `::details-content` height animation | not applicable | native `<details>`; content stays mounted (find-in-page) |
| — | `variant` (`default` `outlined` `soft`), `name` (exclusive group) | kept | beyond upstream: reference variants, native attribute |
| `AccordionSummary` `expandIcon`, `children` | same | kept | |
| `AccordionSummary` `focusVisibleClassName`, ButtonBase props (ripple) | `:focus-visible` | not applicable | native `<summary>` |
| `AccordionDetails` `children` | same | kept | |
| `AccordionActions` `children` | same | kept | |
| `AccordionActions` `disableSpacing` | same; HTML `data-ok-disable-spacing` | kept | Phase 4 row 4.18.47 |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps`, `TransitionComponent` / `TransitionProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS, composition, one CSS transition |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Same `<details>` markup. React controls `open` from state: it prevents the summary's native toggle,
and toggles the browser makes itself (find-in-page, `<details name>`) are reported through
`onToggle` and reverted after render when refused. The HTML runtime lets the native toggle happen
and reports it (`ok:accordion:beforetoggle` / `ok:accordion:toggle`).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
```
div[role="alert"][data-ok-alert][data-ok-severity][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color]
  div[data-ok-alert-icon] › svg[aria-hidden="true"]          (omit with icon={false})
  div[data-ok-alert-message]
    div[data-ok-alert-title]?                                 (AlertTitle)
    … message
  div[data-ok-alert-action]?
    … your actions (Buttons) | button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-alert-close][aria-label="Close"]
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `alert`: listed under "options".)

Other props (React): `icon` (node, `false` hides it), `iconMapping`, `action`, `onClose` (renders
the close button), `closeText` (`"Close"`), `role` (`"alert"`). HTML: write the icon and buttons in
the markup; the runtime handles `[data-ok-alert-close]`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Padding 6px 16px, `--ok-radius-md`, `--ok-typography-body2-*`; icon 24px with 12px gap, message
  padding 8px 0, title `--ok-typography-subtitle1-*`.
- `standard`: background `lighter`, text `darker` (dark scheme: background `darker`, text `lighter`,
  via `light-dark()`; older browsers keep the light look), icon `main`.
- `filled`: background `main`, text `contrastText`, weight medium.
- `outlined`: background `main` 8 %, border `main` 16 %, text `dark`, icon `main`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
CSS only, except the close button: the HTML runtime emits `ok:alert:close` (cancelable) and then
hides the alert (`hidden`). React calls `onClose`; you stop rendering the alert.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
The alert itself is not focusable. Its close button and actions are native buttons: `Tab` reaches
them, `Enter` / `Space` activates them.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role="alert"` by default (announced on insertion — use `role="status"` for non-urgent messages).
Icons are `aria-hidden`; the close button is named by `closeText`. Filled and outlined colors follow
the reference (ADR-0014): exempt from axe `color-contrast` only.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: HTML: `ok:alert:close` (cancelable); instance `close()`. React: `onClose`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Full width; the message wraps, actions stay at the end.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API pages Alert, AlertTitle.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity`, `variant`, `color`, `children` | same | kept | |
| `icon` (`false` hides), `iconMapping`, `action`, `closeText`, `role` | same (React); HTML markup | kept | |
| `onClose(event)` | `onClose()`; HTML `ok:alert:close` (cancelable) → `hidden` | renamed | no event argument |
| `slots.closeButton` / `closeIcon` / `icon` / `message` / `action` | parts `[data-ok-alert-*]`; `action` replaces the close button | not applicable | composition |
| `AlertTitle` `children` | same | kept | |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS and composition |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Closing differs by design: React reports `onClose` and the app removes the alert; the HTML runtime
hides it (`hidden`) after `ok:alert:close` unless the event is prevented.

sections.body:
A text field with a list of suggestions (WAI-ARIA combobox + listbox popup). A composite of
TextField, Chip, IconButton and Popover; core `createComboboxController` turns keys, clicks and
blur into intent, `filterOptions` / `nextAutocompleteValue` / `moveHighlight` are shared rules.
React owns value, text, open and highlight; the HTML runtime `autocomplete` keeps them in the DOM.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-autocomplete][data-ok-multiple]?[data-ok-free-solo]?[data-ok-disable-close-on-select]?
    [data-ok-disable-clearable]?[data-ok-open-on-focus]?[data-ok-auto-highlight]?[data-ok-limit-tags]?[data-ok-open]?
    [data-ok-auto-complete]?[data-ok-auto-select]?[data-ok-blur-on-select]?[data-ok-clear-on-blur]?
    [data-ok-clear-on-escape]?[data-ok-disabled-items-focusable]?[data-ok-disable-list-wrap]?
    [data-ok-filter-selected-options]?[data-ok-handle-home-end-keys]?[data-ok-include-input-in-list]?
    [data-ok-loading]?[data-ok-read-only]?[data-ok-reset-highlight-on-mouse-leave]?[data-ok-select-on-focus]?
    [data-ok-virtualize]?
  div[data-ok-text-field] (TextField, fullWidth)
    label[data-ok-text-field-label][for]
    div[data-ok-text-field-control]
      span[data-ok-text-field-adornment="start"]?                       (multiple, with values)
        span[data-ok-chip][data-ok-variant=soft][data-ok-size=small][data-ok-value][hidden]? … · span[data-ok-autocomplete-more]?
      input[data-ok-text-field-input][role=combobox][aria-autocomplete=list|both][aria-expanded][aria-controls]
           [aria-activedescendant]?[autocomplete=off][readonly]?
      span[data-ok-text-field-adornment="end"]
        button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-autocomplete-clear][aria-label][tabindex=-1][hidden]?   (not disableClearable)
        button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-autocomplete-toggle][aria-label][data-ok-label-open|close][tabindex=-1][hidden]?
              (not freeSolo, or forcePopupIcon; hidden while read only)
      fieldset (outlined)
  template[data-ok-autocomplete-tag]                (HTML: the chip of a value; multiple, or a single value drawn as a chip)
  div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][data-ok-placement=bottom-start][data-ok-disable-auto-focus]
     [data-ok-disable-restore-focus][data-ok-autocomplete-paper]            (--_ok-autocomplete-width)
    ul[role=listbox][id][aria-label]                        (virtualized: --_ok-autocomplete-before|after)
      li[data-ok-list-subheader][role=presentation][hidden]?   (groupBy: ListSubheader before its options)
      li[role=option][id][data-ok-value][aria-selected][aria-disabled]?[hidden]?[data-ok-focused]?
        [aria-setsize][aria-posinset]                          (virtualized: the window in view only)
    div[data-ok-autocomplete-loading][hidden]?              (React: when `loading` is given)
    div[data-ok-autocomplete-no-options][hidden]?
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `autocomplete`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `options` (`(string | { value, label, disabled? })[]`, or any objects with
`getOptionLabel`), `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` (`V | null`, `V[]` multiple; `V` is
the option's `value`, the option itself with `getOptionLabel`, or `getOptionValue(option)`),
`inputValue` / `onInputChange(text)`, `open` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)`,
`onHighlightChange(option | null, reason)` (`keyboard` · `mouse` · `touch` · `auto`),
`getLimitTagsText(more)`, `filterOptions(options, text)` (`createFilterOptions(config)` makes one),
`getOptionLabel`, `getOptionKey`, `getOptionValue`, `isOptionEqualToValue`, `getOptionDisabled`,
`groupBy(option)`, `renderGroup({ key, group, children })`, `renderOption(option, { selected })`,
`renderValue(value, getItemProps)`, `noOptionsText`, `loadingText`, `clearText`, `openText`,
`closeText`, `clearIcon`, `popupIcon`, `forcePopupIcon` (`"auto"`), `ListboxComponent`, and
TextField props `label`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `error`, `variant`, `size`, `disabled`,
`id`, `name`. React-only by nature (functions, elements); their HTML equivalents: groups are
`li[data-ok-list-subheader]` in the markup (or `group` in `setOptions`), `renderValue` is the chip
template, icons and the open button are markup. `filterOptions` / `createFilterOptions` and object
values have no HTML equivalent: HTML values are the options' `data-ok-value` strings and the runtime
filters with the default rule. `useAutocomplete(props)` is the component's state as a hook (prop
getters `getRootProps`, `getInputLabelProps`, `getInputProps`, `getListboxProps`,
`getOptionProps({ option })`, `getClearProps`, `getPopupIndicatorProps`, `getItemProps({ index })`;
`groupedOptions`, `filteredOptions`, `popupOpen`, `value`, `inputValue`, `highlightedIndex`); HTML
has no hook (the runtime is the behavior).

API mapping: see "Upstream API mapping" below.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
The field is a TextField; in an autocomplete its control wraps (chips row-gap 4px, chip margin
3px), the start adornment is `display: contents`, the input keeps 32px minimum, the end buttons
sit absolutely at the right (28px icon buttons, 4px padding; 64px reserved, 36px free solo),
centered on the first line (28px; small fields 20px). Clear shows on hover / focus with a value.
The toggle chevron turns when open. Paper: Popover (translucent paper, `--ok-shadow-dropdown`),
as wide as the field, min 160px; listbox max 360px, scrolls. Options: min 34px, padding 6px 8px,
4px apart, `--ok-radius-sm`, body2; selected `--ok-action-selected`, highlighted
`--ok-action-focus`, disabled 0.48. No options: 14px 16px, `--ok-text-secondary`. "+N":
secondary text.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Typing filters (label contains the text, case and accents ignored), opens and resets the highlight
(`autoHighlight`: first). Arrow keys open a closed list, then move the highlight (wrapping,
skipping disabled); Page keys move 5; Home / End (not free solo). Enter picks the highlighted
option or commits free text. A pick replaces the value (single, text = label) or toggles it
(multiple, text cleared); the list closes unless `disableCloseOnSelect` (multiple). Escape closes.
Backspace in an empty multiple field removes the last chip; chip delete buttons remove theirs.
The clear button empties value and text; the toggle opens / closes; a press on a closed field
opens it. Blur closes and (not free solo) puts back the chosen label (multiple: empty). An outside
press closes (Popover). `limitTags`: extra chips `hidden` while the field isn't focused, "+N".

Phase 4 options: `autoComplete` shows the highlighted option's label in the input (arrow keys, or
typing with `autoHighlight` when the label starts with the text) with the untyped rest selected
(`aria-autocomplete=both`); deleting never completes. `autoSelect`: blur picks the option highlighted
by keys / `autoHighlight` (free solo: commits the text). `clearOnBlur` (default `!freeSolo`) is the
blur reset above. `blurOnSelect` (`true` · `mouse` · `touch`) blurs after a pick by that pointer.
`clearOnEscape`: Escape on a closed list clears. `selectOnFocus` (default `!freeSolo`): the first
click after focus selects the text. `includeInputInList`: the arrows go back to the input (-1) past
an end; `disableListWrap`: they stop. `disabledItemsFocusable`: disabled options take the highlight,
Enter does nothing. `handleHomeEndKeys` (default `!freeSolo`). `resetHighlightOnMouseLeave`: the
pointer leaving the listbox removes a highlight it made. `filterSelectedOptions` hides chosen
options. `readOnly`: the list never opens, no clear, toggle `hidden`, chips without delete buttons,
no Backspace removal. `loading`: the loading text shows while no option is visible (no options
hidden then). Groups: consecutive options with the same `groupBy` key share a heading, hidden
while none of them is visible. `virtualize`: only the visible options in view are drawn (overscan
4), padded by `::before` / `::after` spacers of the rows above and below (stride measured from the
first drawn option, 38px by default); a keyboard highlight scrolls its row into the window; groups
aren't shown; React draws none while closed, the HTML runtime keeps the option elements in memory.
A single value drawn by `renderValue` (HTML: a single field with a chip template) leaves the input
empty; Backspace on the empty input removes it.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| ↓ / ↑ | Open, then next / previous option |
| Page Down / Page Up | ±5 options |
| Home / End | First / last option (not free solo) |
| Enter | Pick the highlighted option / commit free text |
| Escape | Close |
| Backspace (empty multiple) | Remove the last chip |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role=combobox` on the input with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`;
listbox named by the label; options `aria-selected` / `aria-disabled`; end buttons named and out of
the tab order; chips' remove buttons named "Remove <label>"; checkbox options decorative
(`aria-hidden`, `tabindex=-1`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:autocomplete:change` (cancelable, `{ value }`), `ok:autocomplete:open` / `close`
(`{ reason }`), `ok:autocomplete:highlight` (`{ value, reason }`). Instance `{ value,
setValue(value), setOptions(options), isOpen, open(), close() }`; `setOptions` takes strings or
`{ value, label, disabled?, group? }` and builds plain text options (and headings unless
virtualized). `data-ok-loading` and `data-ok-read-only` may change at any time (observed).
React `onChange`, `onInputChange`, `onOpenChange(open, reason)`, `onHighlightChange(option, reason)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: The field fills its container; the paper follows the field's width (min 160px) in the top layer.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Autocomplete`, mui.com/material-ui/api/autocomplete/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `inputValue`, `open`, `multiple`, `freeSolo`, `disableCloseOnSelect`, `disableClearable`, `openOnFocus`, `autoHighlight`, `limitTags`, `getLimitTagsText`, `filterOptions`, `renderOption`, `noOptionsText`, `clearText`, `openText`, `closeText`, `disabled`, `id`, `size` | same | kept | `options`: strings or `{ value, label, disabled? }` |
| `onChange(event, value, reason, details)` | `onChange(value)` | renamed | value-first (ADR-0015) |
| `onInputChange(event, value, reason)` | `onInputChange(text)` | renamed | |
| `onOpen` / `onClose` | `onOpenChange(open, reason)` | renamed | |
| `renderInput` | TextField props (`label`, `placeholder`, `helperText`, `error`, `variant`, `name`) | renamed | the field is built in |
| `getOptionLabel`, `getOptionKey`, `getOptionValue`, `isOptionEqualToValue`, `getOptionDisabled` | same | kept | React: object options and values (4.18.24); without them options stay `{ value, label, disabled? }` with string values; HTML values are `data-ok-value` strings |
| `fullWidth` | — | not applicable | the field always fills its container (reference) |
| `groupBy`, `renderGroup` | same | kept | React functions; HTML: `li[data-ok-list-subheader]` headings in the markup or `group` in `setOptions` |
| `loading`, `loadingText` | same | kept | HTML `data-ok-loading` + `[data-ok-autocomplete-loading]` |
| `autoSelect`, `blurOnSelect`, `clearOnEscape`, `selectOnFocus`, `includeInputInList` | same | kept | `selectOnFocus` defaults to `!freeSolo` (MUI) |
| virtualization | `virtualize` | renamed | MUI virtualizes through a react-window `ListboxComponent`; Owlky draws the window itself in both implementations |
| `slots.listbox` (`ListboxComponent`) | `ListboxComponent` | kept | React only (an element type); HTML writes its own listbox element |
| `readOnly` | same | kept | HTML `data-ok-read-only` (+ `readonly` on the input) |
| `onHighlightChange(event, option, reason)` | `onHighlightChange(option, reason)` | renamed | value-first; HTML `ok:autocomplete:highlight` |
| `autoComplete` (inline completion), `clearOnBlur`, `filterSelectedOptions`, `disableListWrap`, `disabledItemsFocusable`, `handleHomeEndKeys`, `resetHighlightOnMouseLeave` | same | kept | `clearOnBlur`, `handleHomeEndKeys` default to `!freeSolo` (HTML `"true"` / `"false"`, absent = that default) |
| `renderValue` (MUI `renderTags`) | same | kept | `renderValue(value, getItemProps)`; HTML: the chip `<template data-ok-autocomplete-tag>` (single fields too) |
| `clearIcon`, `popupIcon`, `forcePopupIcon` | same | kept | React nodes; HTML: the buttons' markup (an omitted toggle = `forcePopupIcon={false}`) |
| `useAutocomplete`, `createFilterOptions` | same | kept | `useAutocomplete` in `@owlky/react` (React only, a hook); `createFilterOptions` in core (React `filterOptions`; HTML filters with the default rule) |
| `slots.paper`, `slots.popper`, `disablePortal` (`PaperComponent`, `PopperComponent`) | Popover | not applicable | top layer, no portal |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Snippets of the Grouped, Asynchronous requests, Single value rendering and Virtualization stories are
generated from the React examples: `pnpm build && node apps/storybook/scripts/autocomplete-snippets.mjs`
(the Playground and Country select snippets are written by hand). A virtualized listbox is empty
while closed in both implementations.
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the root and the Popover. The chip `<template>` is
HTML-only (parity skips templates); hidden chips / options / no-options are skipped by parity.
Country flags of the reference are not reproduced: options show the country code on a Label.

sections.body:
(Options of `avatar`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `avatar-group`: listed under "options".)

React: `src`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `alt`, `children`, `imgProps` (upstream `slotProps.img`);
AvatarGroup `max` (5, at least 2), `total`, `renderSurplus(n)`, `variant` (cloned onto the
children). Beyond MUI, from the reference: `color` (Minimals), `size` (the reference sizes with
`sx`). AvatarGroup `spacing`: `medium`, `small` or a number of px (MUI). Not applicable: `sx`,

sections.body:
React: on image error, children → first letter of `alt` → a person icon. HTML runtime `avatar`:
`data-ok-size` → `--_ok-avatar-size` (CSSOM, observed); `error` on an `img` (capture) → the image
gets `hidden` and, if the avatar has no other content, a `span[data-ok-avatar-fallback]` with the
alt's first letter (textContent). HTML runtime `avatar-group` (behavior-only folder): a numeric
`data-ok-spacing` → `--_ok-overlap` (CSSOM, observed); React writes the same property in `style`.

adds `role="img"` + `aria-label`. Colored backgrounds follow the reference (ADR-0014).

sections.body:
A dimmed layer over the whole viewport that shows content (usually a loader) in front of the page.
Display is CSS only; the HTML runtime `backdrop` adds triggers and events. No core controller:
React renders from `open`.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-backdrop-open="id"]                       (HTML trigger)
div[data-ok-backdrop][id][data-ok-open]?[data-ok-invisible]?[data-ok-backdrop-close]?
  › children (e.g. span[data-ok-circular-progress][data-ok-color="inherit"][aria-label])
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `backdrop`: listed under "options".)

React: `open` (required, `data-ok-open` when true), `invisible`, `children`, `ref` and DOM props
on the root (`onClick` closes it in the demo). Deferred: `transitionDuration` (upstream API audit,
`docs/roadmap.md`). Not applicable: `component`, `slots`, `slotProps` (one `div`), `classes`,
`sx`, Fade props (`TransitionComponent`: one CSS fade).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`position: fixed; inset: 0`, flex centered, `z-index: var(--ok-z-modal)` (upstream is `-1` inside
Modal; the reference demo raises it above the drawer). Background `--ok-backdrop`
(`data-ok-invisible`: transparent), text `--ok-palette-common-white`, `-webkit-tap-highlight-color:
transparent`. Closed: `opacity: 0; visibility: hidden` (out of the accessibility tree, no hit
testing). Fade: opacity in `--ok-duration-short`, out `--ok-duration-shorter`,
`--ok-easing-standard` (upstream 225 / 195 ms); none with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Contrast: white over `--ok-backdrop` on a white page is 2.97:1 in light mode (dark: 17.5:1;
upstream black 50%: 3.98:1). Accepted (one backdrop look with Dialog and Drawer); text goes on a
paper inside the backdrop, not on the backdrop itself.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Covers the viewport at every width; children stay centered. No breakpoint changes.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Not focusable, no role, no key handling (upstream): focus stays where it was (the trigger) and the
page behind stays reachable by keyboard. The children carry the semantics (a progress has
`role="progressbar"` and a name). For a blocking surface that keyboard users can dismiss, use
Dialog. Close a loading backdrop when the work ends.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML triggers: `[data-ok-backdrop-open="id"]`; `[data-ok-backdrop-close="id"]`, or
`[data-ok-backdrop-close]` with no value inside a backdrop or on the backdrop itself (a click
anywhere on it closes it, like the reference's `onClick`). `data-ok-open` opens it on load.
Events: `ok:backdrop:beforeopen` (cancelable, `detail.trigger`), `ok:backdrop:open`,
`ok:backdrop:beforeclose` (cancelable, `detail.reason`: trigger | api), `ok:backdrop:close`.
Instance: `{ isOpen, open(trigger?), close(reason?) }`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API page Backdrop (inherits Fade).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open`, `invisible`, `children` | same; HTML `data-ok-open`, `data-ok-invisible` | kept | |
| `transitionDuration` | same, a number of ms for both fades; HTML `data-ok-transition-duration` | kept (4.9) | core `backdropStyle` → `--_ok-backdrop-duration` (React `style`, HTML CSSOM); `{ enter, exit }` not applicable |
| `component` | — | not applicable | one `div` |
| Fade props (`appear`, `easing`, `timeout`, `addEndListener`, `onEnter`… callbacks) | one CSS fade | not applicable | HTML `ok:backdrop:open` / `close` events |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps`, `TransitionComponent` / `TransitionProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS, composition, one CSS transition |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body: None: both render the same `div`; React adds `data-ok-runtime="off"`.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Their modal paths keep the native `::backdrop` (top layer: a DOM element can't sit between a
top-layer `<dialog>` and its `::backdrop`), painted with the same `--ok-backdrop`; their
`hideBackdrop` matches `invisible`.

Hiding scales to 0 (`--ok-duration-shorter`). An avatar as content loses the pill.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `badgeContent`, `children`, `max`, `showZero`, `invisible`, `overlap` | same (HTML writes the displayed text) | kept | |
| `anchorOrigin` `{ vertical, horizontal }` | same; HTML `data-ok-vertical` + `data-ok-horizontal` | kept | |
| `color` | + `info` `success` `warning` | kept | |
| `variant` (`standard` `dot`) | + `online` `always` `busy` `offline` `invisible` | kept | Minimals statuses |
| `component` | — | not applicable | always `span` |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS and composition |

sections.body:
The path from the site root to the current page, as links. CSS only, plus the HTML runtime
`breadcrumbs` for collapsing long trails (`maxItems`).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
nav[data-ok-breadcrumbs][aria-label="breadcrumb"][data-ok-max-items]?…[data-ok-expanded]?
  ol[data-ok-breadcrumbs-list]
    li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item] › a[href] (svg[aria-hidden]? text)   (a Link: color inherit, underline hover)
    li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-separator][aria-hidden="true"] › "/" | span[data-ok-breadcrumbs-dot]
    li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item][data-ok-breadcrumbs-collapsed]                (collapsed)
      › button[type="button"][data-ok-breadcrumbs-expand][aria-label="Show path"] › svg
    li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item][hidden] …                                     (collapsed items)
    li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item] › span[aria-current="page"]
```
Items compose Link (`link.md`: `data-ok-typography data-ok-link`, `color="inherit"`,
`underline="hover"`, as in MUI's demos); a plain `a` gets the same look from `breadcrumbs.css`,
which loads after `link.css`.
Collapsed order: items before, their separators, the expand item, a separator, the hidden items
(each with its following separator hidden), the items after.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `breadcrumbs`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item]` | `children` (each child = one item) | links and the current page |
| `li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-separator]` | `separator` (default `"/"`; `<BreadcrumbsDot />`) | node |
| `data-ok-expand-text` | `expandText` (default `"Show path"`) | string |
| `aria-label` | `aria-label` (default `"breadcrumb"`) | string |

API mapping (MUI): kept `children`, `separator`, `maxItems`, `itemsBeforeCollapse`,
`itemsAfterCollapse`, `expandText`, `aria-label`. Added: `BreadcrumbsDot` (the reference's
Customized separator). Not applicable: `component`, `slots` / `slotProps` (`CollapsedIcon`: one
built-in icon), `classes`, `sx`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root `--ok-text-secondary`, body2 size / line height. List: flex, wrap, gap 4px (rows) ×
16px (`spacing × 4`). Items inline-flex, gap 4px, min-height 24px (WCAG 2.5.8), `overflow-wrap:
anywhere`; icons 20px. Current page `--ok-text-primary`. Links: no underline, underline on hover
(hover-capable devices), focus ring 2px `--ok-text-primary`. Dot 4px `--ok-palette-grey-500`.
Expand button 32 × 24px, `--ok-action-hover` (hover `--ok-action-selected`), `--ok-radius-xs`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
More items than `maxItems` (default 8) and `itemsBeforeCollapse + itemsAfterCollapse` (default
1 + 1) below the count → collapsed (core `breadcrumbsCollapse`). The expand button shows every
item, removes itself and focuses the first revealed item (MUI). React keeps `expanded` in state;
the HTML runtime collapses plain markup on mount (markup already collapsed is kept) and expands on
click; `data-ok-expanded` marks an expanded trail in both.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native links and button: Tab, Enter; Space on the expand button.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`nav` landmark named "breadcrumb" (unique labels for several trails); `ol`; separators
`aria-hidden`; current page `aria-current="page"`, not a link; decorative icons `aria-hidden`.

HTML `ok:breadcrumbs:expand` (cancelable). Instance `runtime.get(el, "breadcrumbs")` →
`{ collapsed, expand() }`. React: no callback (state inside).

Upstream: MUI `Breadcrumbs` (mui.com/material-ui/api/breadcrumbs, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `children` / `li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-item]` | kept | each child = one item |
| `separator` | `separator` / `li[data-ok-breadcrumbs-separator]` | kept | `BreadcrumbsDot` added |
| `maxItems`, `itemsBeforeCollapse`, `itemsAfterCollapse` | same / `data-ok-max-items`, `-items-before-collapse`, `-items-after-collapse` | kept | |
| `expandText` | `expandText` / `data-ok-expand-text` | kept | |
| `component` | — | not applicable | root is always `nav` (landmark) |
| Typography props (inherited) | — | not applicable | root keeps body2 / text secondary; consumer CSS |
| `slots.CollapsedIcon` / `slotProps.collapsedIcon` | — | not applicable | composition; one built-in icon (HTML: author the button's `svg`) |
| `classes`, `sx` | — | not applicable | by decision |

sections.body: Trigger an action (`<button>`) or navigate (`<a href>`) with the button styling.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
(button[type="button"] | a[href])[data-ok-button][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-size]
    [data-ok-full-width]? [data-ok-loading][data-ok-loading-position][aria-busy="true"][disabled]?
  span[data-ok-button-icon="start"][aria-hidden="true"]?  › svg[aria-hidden="true"]
  span[data-ok-button-loader][aria-hidden="true"]?        › span[data-ok-button-spinner] | text
  span[data-ok-button-label]                              (always; carries the accessible name)
  span[data-ok-button-icon="end"][aria-hidden="true"]?    › svg[aria-hidden="true"]
```
Visual order is set by CSS `order`: start icon, loader (start), label, loader (end), end icon.
Default loader: a Circular progress (`specs/components/circular-progress.md`),
`span[data-ok-circular-progress][data-ok-variant="indeterminate"][data-ok-color="inherit"][data-ok-button-spinner]`,
sized 16px by `button.css` (CSS only, no runtime needed). An empty `span[data-ok-button-spinner]`
(earlier markup) still renders as a CSS ring.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `button`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| loader content | `loadingIndicator` | spinner or text (e.g. `Loading…`) |
| `<a href>` | `href` | URL, passed through untouched |
| icon wrappers | `startIcon` / `endIcon` | ReactNode |

React renders all modifiers explicitly (`buttonAttributes()`); unknown values fall back to the
defaults in both `buttonAttributes()` and CSS. `disabled` (or `loading`) on a link removes `href`
and sets `aria-disabled="true"`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Radius `--ok-radius-md`; heights and paddings are multiples of `--ok-spacing`; font
`--ok-font-size-sm|md|lg` + `--ok-typography-button-*`; colors through the `--ok-c-*` bindings,
with `--ok-c-channel` for translucent fills (`rgb(var(--…-channel) / α)` — never `color-mix()` in
component CSS); hover shadow `--ok-c-shadow` (`--ok-shadow-z8` for inherit / black / white).

| Variant | Rest | Hover (`hover: hover` only) |
|---|---|---|
| contained | bg `main`, text `contrast` | bg `hover` (`dark`; 72 % for black/white) + `--ok-c-shadow` |
| outlined | border `channel` 48 % (inherit: grey-500 32 %), text `main` | bg 8 %, border `currentColor` + 0.75px ring |
| text | text `main` | bg 8 % |
| soft | bg `channel` 16 %, text `text` | bg 32 % |
| disabled | text `--ok-action-disabled`; bg `--ok-action-disabled-bg` (contained / soft) or border (outlined) | — |
sections.title: Tokens

sections.body:
Same size per `data-ok-size` at every breakpoint; labels don't wrap (`nowrap`); rows of buttons
wrap. Use `fullWidth` for full-width mobile actions. Every size is ≥ 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Native element only — **CSS only, no runtime**. Loading uses native `disabled` (approved
decision): the button leaves the tab order while loading.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native: `Enter` / `Space` activate a button; `Enter` follows a link.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- Name = label text. Icons and the loader are `aria-hidden`; while loading in the center the
  label is made transparent, never hidden, so the name stays. Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
- `aria-busy="true"` while loading; 2px focus outline (`:focus-visible`), offset 2px.
- Colors follow the reference (ADR-0014): white on `main` fills (dark on warning), `main` text
  for outlined / text; soft uses the AA `-text` tone. `black` / `white` are for light / dark
  surfaces.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLButtonElement`, or `HTMLAnchorElement` with
`href`) and every native button / link prop.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Button` (+ `ButtonBase`), mui.com/material-ui/api/button/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` (`text` · `contained` · `outlined`) | `variant` | kept | + `soft` (reference) |
| `color` | `color` | kept | default `inherit` (reference; MUI `primary`); + `black` / `white` |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg` · `xl`) | renamed | + `xl` (reference) |
| `children`, `disabled`, `fullWidth`, `disableElevation`, `href`, `startIcon`, `endIcon` | same | kept | disabled link: no `href`, `aria-disabled` |
| `loading`, `loadingIndicator`, `loadingPosition` | same | kept | `loading` boolean (MUI `null` = no loader slot) |
| `type` (ButtonBase, default `button`) | native `type` | kept | |
| `component`, `LinkComponent` (ButtonBase) | same | kept | 4.18.22: `component` renders that element or component (a router link gets the attributes, `ref` and its own props such as `to`); `LinkComponent` replaces the `<a>` when `href` is set; `component="button"` + `href` still renders the link (MUI). Elements other than `button` are links: a disabled router link keeps its `href` (routers need it), gets `aria-disabled` + `tabindex=-1`, and CSS turns pointer events off (`[href][aria-disabled=true]`). Non-interactive elements (`span`, `label`) aren't supported: no `role=button` or key handling is added (native first; Upload covers MUI's `component="label"` file buttons). HTML: the router renders the `a`, with the same attributes |
| `action`, `focusVisibleClassName`, `onFocusVisible` (ButtonBase) | `ref.focus()`, `:focus-visible` | not applicable | |
| `nativeButton` (ButtonBase) | — | not applicable | always a native element |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple`, `disableTouchRipple`, `centerRipple`, `focusRipple`, `TouchRippleProps`, `touchRippleRef` | — | not applicable | no ripple (CSS states) |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
None: React renders the snippet markup (`jsxSource` examples and HTML snippets are compared by the
parity e2e tests, per option in `options-parity.spec.ts`).
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Visible focus outline (the reference has none); loader wrapper `aria-hidden` + `aria-busy` (the
loader is a `progressbar`, as on the reference, but hidden from assistive technology); "Link" is a real `<a href>`;
consistent sizes across variants (the reference's soft `sm` / `lg` differ slightly); black / white
shown on matching surfaces. Colors match the reference (ADR-0014); strict AA is an opt-in override.
sections.title: Differences from the reference (intentional)

(Options of `button-group`: listed under "options".)

React passes `variant` (default `outlined`, as MUI), `color`, `size`, `disabled` and
`disableElevation` (default on, as in the reference) to every direct child Button (a child prop

sections.body:
The group only joins its children: outer corners rounded, inner corners square; a 1px separator
between buttons (contained: `dark` 48 %, neutral grey 32 %; text: `channel` 48 % / 32 %; soft:
`dark` 24 %; disabled: `--ok-action-disabled-bg`); outlined buttons share borders. Contained
buttons have no hover shadow inside a group. A focused button is raised above its neighbours.

None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLDivElement`); group props reach **direct**
child elements only (`cloneElement`).

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `ButtonGroup`, mui.com/material-ui/api/button-group/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children`, `orientation`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, `disableElevation` | same | kept | reach **direct** child Buttons only (`cloneElement`); `disableElevation` on by default (reference) |
| `variant` | `variant` | kept | default `outlined` (as MUI); + `soft` |
| `color` | `color` | kept | default `inherit` (MUI `primary`); + `black` / `white` |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg` · `xl`) | renamed | |
| `component` | same | kept | 4.18.22: the root element (default `div`), always with `role="group"`; HTML: write any element |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

sections.body:
In HTML, write `data-ok-variant` / `data-ok-color` / `data-ok-size` / `data-ok-disable-elevation` on every button (React does it
from the group's props).

sections.body:
A surface for content and actions about one subject. Built on Paper (`specs/components/paper.md`,
"Composition contract"): one element carries Paper's attributes and `data-ok-card`. CSS only.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
<element>[data-ok-paper][data-ok-card][data-ok-variant][data-ok-elevation][data-ok-square]?[data-ok-raised]?
  div[data-ok-card-header]?
    div[data-ok-card-header-avatar]?                     › an Avatar
    div[data-ok-card-header-content]
      span[data-ok-typography][data-ok-variant="h6"][data-ok-card-header-title]?
      span[data-ok-typography][data-ok-variant="body2"][data-ok-color="textSecondary"][data-ok-card-header-subheader]?
    div[data-ok-card-header-action]?                     › an IconButton…
  <img|video|picture|iframe|audio>[data-ok-card-media][src]?     media element: shows the media
  <element>[data-ok-card-media]?                                 other element (default div):
    img[data-ok-card-media-image][src][alt=""]?                  a decorative cover image
  div[data-ok-card-content]?
  div[data-ok-card-actions][data-ok-disable-spacing]?
  button[type=button][data-ok-card-action-area] | a[href][data-ok-card-action-area]?   wraps media / content
```
The title and subheader are Typography roots (composition, no DOM change to Typography). The
media part may be any component's root, such as an Image (`span[data-ok-image][data-ok-card-media]`).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `card`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `card-actions`: listed under "options".)

React (not options, HTML writes them as markup):
- `Card`: Paper's `component` (default `div`), `children`, `ref`, every attribute.
- `CardHeader`: `avatar`, `action`, `title`, `subheader` (nodes), `disableTypography`,
  `titleProps` / `subheaderProps` (Typography props, over `variant="h6" component="span"` and
  `variant="body2" color="textSecondary" component="span"`), `component` (default `div`).
- `CardContent`: `component` (default `div`).
- `CardMedia`: `component` (default `div`), `image` / `src` (alias). Media elements (`img`,
  `video`, `picture`, `iframe`, `audio`) and components (`Image`) receive `src`; any other
  element renders `img[data-ok-card-media-image][alt=""]` (MUI's background image, CSP-safe: no
  `style`). Other props pass through (`alt`, `height`, `controls`, Image's `ratio`…).
- `CardActions`: `disableSpacing`.
- `CardActionArea`: a `button type="button"`, or an `a` with `href` (`disabled` on a link removes
  `href` and sets `aria-disabled`), every button / anchor attribute.

API mapping (MUI): kept `raised`, Paper's `variant` / `elevation` / `square` / `component`,
`avatar`, `action`, `title`, `subheader`, `disableTypography`, `image`, `src`, `disableSpacing`;
`titleTypographyProps` / `subheaderTypographyProps` / `slotProps.title|subheader` → `titleProps`
/ `subheaderProps`. Not applicable: `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, other `slotProps`,
`focusVisibleClassName` and ButtonBase ripple props (CSS `:focus-visible`), MUI's title default
`body2` / `h5` by avatar (Minimals' theme: always `h6` / `body2`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root (on Paper): `position: relative`, `z-index: 0`, `overflow: hidden`, `--ok-radius-xl`
  (16px). Shadow: `--ok-shadow-card` at the default level (1, or a value Paper doesn't know);
  other levels keep Paper's `--ok-elevation-<n>` (0: none); `raised` → `--ok-elevation-8`
  (MUI's raised level); `outlined` → no shadow (Paper's outline); `square` → radius 0. Background,
  text color, outline and the shadow transition come from Paper.
- Header: flex, centered, padding `spacing × 6` (24px) top and sides, 0 bottom. Avatar slot
  `margin-inline-end: spacing × 4`; content `flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0`; action
  `align-self: flex-start`, margins −4px block / −8px inline end. Title block `h6`; subheader
  block `body2`, `--ok-text-secondary`, `margin-block-start: spacing` (4px).
- Media: block; media elements `width: 100%`, `img` / `picture` `object-fit: cover`; other
  elements are `position: relative; overflow: hidden` around an absolute cover image
  (`object-fit: cover`) — the author gives them a height. Media right after the header gets
  `margin-block-start: spacing × 6` (the header has no bottom padding).
- Content: padding `spacing × 6` (24px).
- Actions: flex, centered, `gap: spacing × 2` (8px, 0 with `disableSpacing`), padding 8px.
- Action area: block, full width, inherits font / color / radius, no border or padding;
  `::after` tint: `--ok-action-hover` on hover (hover-capable devices), `--ok-action-focus` +
  a 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline inset by 2px on `:focus-visible`; `:disabled` /
  `aria-disabled` → default cursor, no pointer events. Tint transition `--ok-duration-shortest`
  (none with reduced motion).
- `card.css` loads right after `paper.css` and `typography.css`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Fluid: the card takes its container's width (stories cap it at 345px). Nothing changes per
breakpoint; the header's content shrinks (`min-width: 0`) so long titles wrap.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
The card is not focusable. The action area is a native button or link (Tab, Enter, Space for the
button). Its content is its accessible name. Keep other actions outside the action area (nested
interactive). Cover images are decorative (`alt=""`); `img` media take the author's `alt`. Header
and content text use `--ok-text-primary` / `--ok-text-secondary` (AA in both schemes).
Selection state on an action area (MUI's "Active state styles" `data-active`) is the author's:
the stories use `aria-pressed` and story CSS.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body: None (native `click` on the action area and controls).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API pages Card, CardHeader, CardMedia, CardContent, CardActions, CardActionArea (Card inherits Paper).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Card` `raised`, `children`; Paper's `variant`, `elevation`, `square`, `component` | same | kept | see paper.md |
| `CardHeader` `avatar`, `action`, `title`, `subheader`, `disableTypography`, `component` | same | kept | |
| `CardHeader` `slotProps.title` / `subheader` (`titleTypographyProps` / `subheaderTypographyProps`) | `titleProps` / `subheaderProps` | renamed | |
| `CardHeader` title variant by avatar (`body2` / `h5`) | always `h6` / `body2` | not applicable | Minimals theme |
| `CardMedia` `image`, `src`, `component`, `children` | same; non-media elements get a cover `img` | kept | no `style` background (CSP) |
| `CardContent` `component` | same | kept | |
| `CardActions` `disableSpacing` | same | kept | |
| `CardActionArea` `children`; ButtonBase `disabled`, `href` | `button` or `a[href]` | kept | |
| `CardActionArea` `slots.focusHighlight`, `focusVisibleClassName`, ripple props | `::after` tint, `:focus-visible` | not applicable | |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS and composition |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
None: React renders the same elements and attributes as the snippets (generated from the React
examples by `apps/storybook/scripts/card-snippets.mjs`). Stateful stories (Complex interaction,
Active state styles) render their first state; HTML pages toggle `hidden` / `aria-expanded` /
`aria-pressed` in a page script. Complex interaction's method section is a Collapse
(`timeout="auto"`, as MUI's `<Collapse in timeout="auto">`) around the `CardContent`: the
`collapse` runtime animates it when the page script toggles `hidden`.

stories.html:
G
Golden flower bed April 14, 2025

A sunny bed of golden flowers lights up the garden from spring to autumn. Plant it once and it comes back every year with a little care.

Method:

Pick a spot with at least six hours of sun. Loosen the soil to a spade's depth and mix in a layer of compost.

Set the plants a hand's width apart, firm the soil around each one and water them well.

Water once a week while they settle in, then only in dry spells.
stories.name: Complex interaction
stories.react:
import {
  Avatar,
  Card,
  CardActions,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardMedia,
  Collapse,
  IconButton,
  Typography,
} from "@owlky/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { DemoIcon } from "../shared/demo-icon.js";

/** A card whose method section opens and closes with the chevron button, through a Collapse. */
export function ComplexInteractionDemo() {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Card className="sb-card">
      <CardHeader
        avatar={
          <Avatar color="error" role="img" aria-label="Garden">
            G
          </Avatar>
        }
        action={
          <IconButton aria-label="Settings">
            <DemoIcon name="moreVertical" />
          </IconButton>
        }
        title="Golden flower bed"
        subheader="April 14, 2025"
      />
      <CardMedia component="img" height="194" src="images/image-4.svg" alt="Golden flowers" />
      <CardContent>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
          A sunny bed of golden flowers lights up the garden from spring to autumn. Plant it once
          and it comes back every year with a little care.
        </Typography>
      </CardContent>
      <CardActions disableSpacing>
        <IconButton aria-label="Add to favorites">
          <DemoIcon name="heart" />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton aria-label="Share">
          <DemoIcon name="share" />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton
          className="sb-card-expand"
          aria-label="Show the method"
          aria-expanded={expanded}
          aria-controls="card-garden-method"
          onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        >
          <DemoIcon name="chevronDown" />
        </IconButton>
      </CardActions>
      <Collapse id="card-garden-method" in={expanded} timeout="auto">
        <CardContent>
          <Typography variant="body2" gutterBottom>
            Method:
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2" gutterBottom>
            Pick a spot with at least six hours of sun. Loosen the soil to a spade's depth and mix
            in a layer of compost.
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2" gutterBottom>
            Set the plants a hand's width apart, firm the soil around each one and water them well.
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2">
            Water once a week while they settle in, then only in dry spells.
          </Typography>
        </CardContent>
      </Collapse>
    </Card>
  );
}

sections.body:
Show a set of slides one view at a time; people swipe, scroll, drag, use the arrow keys or the
controls. The viewport is a native scroll container with CSS scroll snapping (works without
JavaScript); core `createCarouselController` adds Embla's options and plugins and writes the
derived state (selected snap, slides in view, controls) for React and the HTML runtime alike.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-carousel][aria-roledescription="carousel"][aria-label][data-ok-align][data-ok-axis]
       [data-ok-contain-scroll][data-ok-effect][data-ok-loop]?…[data-ok-slides-to-show[-sm|-md|-lg|-xl]]?
       [data-ok-breakpoints='{json}']?          (+ controller flags: data-ok-ready, data-ok-looping,
                                                  data-ok-dragging, data-ok-pointer-down, data-ok-scrolling,
                                                  data-ok-auto-scrolling, data-ok-playing)
  div[data-ok-carousel-stage]?                   (positions overlay controls over the slides)
    div[data-ok-carousel-viewport][tabindex="0"]   (scroll container; arrow keys, Home, End)
      div[data-ok-carousel-container]
        div[role="group"][aria-roledescription="slide"][aria-label="1 of 4"][data-ok-carousel-slide]
           [data-ok-snapped]?[data-ok-in-view]?    (one per slide; any content)
          …[data-ok-carousel-parallax]?           (effect="parallax": the layer that moves)
      span[data-ok-carousel-live][aria-live="polite|off"][aria-atomic="true"]   (visually hidden)
    div[data-ok-carousel-arrows][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-placement]?
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-carousel-prev][aria-label][aria-disabled]? › svg
      span[data-ok-carousel-counter]?            (variant="number": "1/8")
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-carousel-next][aria-label][aria-disabled]? › svg
    div[data-ok-carousel-dots][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-placement]?
      button[type="button"][data-ok-carousel-dot][aria-label][aria-current="true"]? (text with variant="number")
    span[data-ok-carousel-progress][aria-hidden="true"][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-placement]?
    div[data-ok-carousel-thumbs][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-placement]?
      button[type="button"][data-ok-carousel-thumb][aria-label][aria-current="true"]? › img
  button[data-ok-button][data-ok-carousel-play]  (Button: two icons and two labels
                                                  [data-ok-carousel-play-label="play|pause"])
```
Every control can sit anywhere inside the root (several sets at once). React parts: `Carousel`,
`CarouselStage`, `CarouselViewport`, `CarouselSlide`, `CarouselArrows`, `CarouselDots`,
`CarouselProgress`, `CarouselThumbs`, `CarouselThumb`, `CarouselPlayButton`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `carousel`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `carousel-arrows`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `carousel-dots`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `carousel-progress`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `carousel-thumbs`: listed under "options".)

Outside the schema:
- `align`: also a number 0–1 (`data-ok-align="0.1"`), and in React a function
  `(viewSize, snapSize, index) => offset`.
- `slidesToShow`: a number (`2`, `1.5`), a percentage (`"70%"`) or `"auto"` (the slide's own size),
  per breakpoint `{ xs, sm, md, lg, xl }` → `data-ok-slides-to-show`, `-sm`, `-md`, `-lg`, `-xl`
  (600 / 900 / 1200 / 1536px). Sizes become `--_ok-carousel-basis-*` (React `style`, HTML CSSOM).
- `slidesToScroll="auto"`; `containScroll={false}` → `data-ok-contain-scroll="false"`.
- `breakpoints`: Embla's media query → options object (`active`, `align`, `loop`, `dragFree`,
  `draggable`, `dragThreshold`, `skipSnaps`, `containScroll`, `slidesToScroll`, `duration`,
  `inViewThreshold`, `autoplay`, `autoScroll`, `wheelGestures`), JSON in `data-ok-breakpoints`;
  invalid keys and values are dropped.
- `direction` (Embla) is the `dir` attribute of the root or an ancestor.
- Parts: `CarouselArrows` `prevLabel` / `nextLabel` (default "Previous slide" / "Next slide"),
  `prevIcon` / `nextIcon`; `CarouselDots` `getLabel(index)` (default "Go to slide n");
  `CarouselThumb` `aria-label` (default "Go to slide n"); `CarouselPlayButton` `playLabel` /
  `pauseLabel` and every Button prop (default contained, primary, small).

### API mapping (Embla → Owlky)
| Embla | Owlky | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `align`, `axis`, `loop`, `dragFree`, `dragThreshold`, `skipSnaps`, `containScroll`, `slidesToScroll`, `duration`, `startIndex` (v9 `startSnap`), `inViewThreshold`, `active`, `breakpoints`, `focus` (v8 `watchFocus`) | kept | |
| `watchDrag` (v9 `draggable`) | `draggable` | v9 name |
| `direction` | `dir` attribute | native |
| `container`, `slides` | `CarouselViewport` / `[data-ok-carousel-slide]` | anatomy |
| `watchResize`, `watchSlides`, `inViewMargin`, `ssr` | not applicable | always observed; CSS sizes are SSR-safe |
| Autoplay `delay`, `jump` / `instant`, `playOnInit`, `stopOnInteraction`, `stopOnMouseEnter`, `stopOnFocusIn`, `stopOnLastSnap`, `rootNode` | `autoplayDelay`, `autoplayJump`, `playOnInit`, `stopOnInteraction`, `stopOnMouseEnter` (default `true`: WCAG 2.2.2), `stopOnFocusIn`, `stopOnLastSnap`; `rootNode` = the root | |
| Auto Scroll `speed`, `startDelay`, `direction`, `playOnInit`, `stopOn…` | `autoScrollSpeed`, `autoScrollStartDelay`, `autoScrollDirection`, shared `playOnInit` / `stopOn…` | |
| Fade | `effect="fade"` | |
| Auto Height `heightEvent` | `autoHeight`, `heightEvent` (`select`, `slidesInView`) | |
| Class Names `snapped`, `inView`, `draggable`, `pointerDown`, `loop` | `data-ok-snapped`, `data-ok-in-view` (slides), `data-ok-pointer-down`, `data-ok-dragging`, `data-ok-looping` (root) | attributes, not classes |
| Wheel Gestures `forceWheelAxis` | `wheelGestures`, `forceWheelAxis` | |
| Accessibility plugin labels | slide `aria-label`, `prevLabel` / `nextLabel`, `getLabel`, live region | |
| Tween examples (opacity, scale, parallax) | `effect` | |
| Minimals `slidesToShow`, `slideSpacing`, arrows / dots / progress / thumbs | kept | parts |

Beyond the reference and upstream (accessibility): pause on hover by default, never auto-starting
with reduced motion, a play / pause part, a live region, `aria-disabled` arrows that keep focus,
`placement` for overlay controls, `color` on controls.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Written by the controller (React renders only the initial state from `startIndex`):
`data-ok-snapped` / `data-ok-in-view` on slides, `aria-current="true"` on the selected dot and
thumbnails, `aria-disabled="true"` on arrows that can't move, the counter text, the live region
text and `aria-live` (`off` while playing), root flags listed in the anatomy, and private custom
properties: `--_ok-carousel-snap*`, `-order`, `-tween`, `-parallax`, `-progress`, `-height`,
`-lead` / `-trail`, `-duration`.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- Snaps: groups of `slidesToScroll` (or as many as fit), aligned by `align`, contained by
  `containScroll`; the browser snaps to the same positions (per-slide snap alignment and margins).
- Selection follows the scroll position (nearest snap); `select` fires when it changes, `settle`
  when scrolling stops (120 ms after the last scroll event).
- Animated scrolls last `duration × 20` ms with an ease-out; instant with reduced motion or `jump`.
- Mouse: drag scrolls; release moves one snap in the drag direction (`skipSnaps`: by velocity,
  `dragFree`: momentum). Clicks after a drag longer than `dragThreshold` are prevented. Touch, pen
  and trackpads scroll natively (`skipSnaps` off = `scroll-snap-stop: always`).
- Loop (ADR-0033): the visual order rotates through CSS `order`; no clones; falls back when the
  content is shorter than one viewport plus two steps. The rotation puts the selected snap in the
  middle of the scroll range (by length, not by count); jumps rotate around the target, animated
  moves around the middle of the shortest way.
- Fade: slides stacked; swipes step; hidden slides are `visibility: hidden`.
- Effects: `opacity`, `scale` (the slide's child) and `parallax` (`[data-ok-carousel-parallax]`).
- Focus inside a slide scrolls to its snap (`focus`).
- Autoplay: every `autoplayDelay`, next snap (wraps to the first); pauses on hover, stops on
  focus, pointer down and wheel; `stopOnInteraction={false}` pauses until it settles.
- Auto scroll: `autoScrollSpeed` px per frame after `autoScrollStartDelay`; same interactions.
- The play button toggles autoplay (or auto scroll when only that is on).
- Auto height: the viewport height follows the tallest selected (or in-view) slide.
- Resize, slide changes, option attributes and matching breakpoints re-initialize the carousel.
  A scroll frame or a settle that finds the sizes changed re-initializes first (a resize can
  re-snap the viewport before the ResizeObserver reports it); a running animation is retargeted.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action (focus on the viewport) |
|---|---|
| Right / Left arrow | next / previous snap (x axis; mirrored right to left) |
| Down / Up arrow | next / previous snap (y axis) |
| Home / End | first / last snap |
| Tab | arrows, dots, thumbnails and slide content are native buttons and links |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
WAI-ARIA APG carousel: labelled `section` (region) with `aria-roledescription="carousel"`, slides
as `group`s with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and "n of total" labels; arrows stay focusable at
the ends (`aria-disabled`); the live region announces moves the user makes, never autoplay; autoplay
and auto scroll have a play / pause control, pause on hover and stop on focus (WCAG 2.2.2) and
never start with `prefers-reduced-motion`. Loop never duplicates content. Dots and thumbnails are
24px and larger (WCAG 2.5.8).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML events on the root: `ok:carousel:select` `{ index, previous }`, `settle` `{ index }`,
`scroll` `{ progress }`, `slidesinview` `{ indexes }`, `reinit` `{ snapCount }`, `autoplay` /
`autoscroll` `{ playing }`, `slidefocus` `{ index }`, `pointerdown`, `pointerup`, and the cancelable
`pointermove` (the pressed pointer moved; prevented → no drag step), `resize` `{ entries }` (the
viewport or a slide changed size, compared with `getBoundingClientRect()` sizes recorded when it is
observed, like Embla's resize handler; prevented → no re-measure) and `slideschanged`
`{ records }` (slides added or removed; prevented → no re-measure; the scroll and settle checks
may still measure later).
Instance (`runtime.get(root, "carousel")`) and React `apiRef`: `scrollNext(jump?)`,
`scrollPrev(jump?)`, `scrollTo(index, jump?)`, `canScrollNext()`, `canScrollPrev()`,
`selectedScrollSnap()`, `previousScrollSnap()`, `scrollSnapList()`, `scrollProgress()`,
`slidesInView()`, `slidesNotInView()`, `slideNodes()`, `rootNode()`, `containerNode()`, `reInit()`,
`autoplay.{play, stop, reset, isPlaying, timeUntilNext}`, `autoScroll.{play, stop, reset, isPlaying}`;
Embla v9 aliases `goToNext(jump?)`, `goToPrev(jump?)`, `goTo(index, jump?, direction?)` (`forward` ·
`backward` force the way round a loop), `canGoToNext()`, `canGoToPrev()`, `selectedSnap()`,
`previousSnap()`, `snapList()`, `snapIndex(offset = 0)` (the selected snap moved by `offset`,
wrapped with `loop`, clamped otherwise).
React callbacks: `onSelect(index, previous)`, `onSettle(index)`, `onScroll(progress)`,
`onSlidesInView(indexes)`, `onReInit(snapCount)`, `onAutoplayChange(playing)`,
`onAutoScrollChange(playing)`, `onSlideFocus(index)`, `onResize(entries)`, `onSlidesChanged(records)`
(return `false` to cancel); pointer moves use the native `onPointerMove`, like `onPointerDown` /
`onPointerUp`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Mobile first: one slide per view unless `slidesToShow` says otherwise per breakpoint; controls wrap;
floating arrows sit inside the slides' edges; touch swipes are native.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: Embla Carousel options, methods, events and official plugins
(embla-carousel.com/docs/api/options, /methods, /events, /plugins, v9.0.0-rc04, checked
2026-11-09). "API mapping (Embla → Owlky)" above holds the option-level detail; this table adds
statuses and the v9 API.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Options `active`, `align`, `axis`, `breakpoints`, `containScroll`, `dragFree`, `dragThreshold`, `duration`, `focus`, `inViewThreshold`, `loop`, `skipSnaps`, `slidesToScroll` | same | kept | |
| `draggable` (v8 `watchDrag`), `startSnap` (v8 `startIndex`) | `draggable`, `startIndex` | kept / renamed | `startIndex` keeps the v8 name |
| `direction` | `dir` attribute | renamed | native |
| `container`, `slides` | anatomy | not applicable | |
| `resize`, `slideChanges` (v8 `watchResize`, `watchSlides`), `inViewMargin`, `ssr` | — | not applicable | always observed; CSS sizes are SSR-safe |
| Methods `goToNext` / `goToPrev` / `goTo` (with `direction`), `canGoToNext` / `canGoToPrev` | same, and the v8 `scrollNext` / `scrollPrev` / `scrollTo`, `canScrollNext` / `canScrollPrev` | kept | both names (roadmap 4.18.80) |
| Methods `selectedSnap`, `previousSnap`, `snapList` | same, and the v8 `selectedScrollSnap`, `previousScrollSnap`, `scrollSnapList` | kept | both names |
| Methods `scrollProgress`, `slidesInView`, `slideNodes`, `rootNode`, `containerNode`, `reInit` | same (+ `slidesNotInView`) | kept | |
| Method `snapIndex(offset)` | same | kept | v9 rc04 takes an offset from the selected snap (not a slide); the snap of a slide stays internal |
| Methods `destroy`, `on` / `off` | runtime `stop()` / unmount, DOM events, React callbacks | renamed | |
| Methods `plugins`, `cloneEngine`, `internalEngine`, `ssrStyles`, `createEvent` | — | not applicable | no plugin system / engine; CSS sizes |
| Events `select`, `settle`, `scroll`, `slidesinview`, `reinit`, `slidefocus`, `pointerdown`, `pointerup` | `ok:carousel:*` · `onSelect` … `onSlideFocus` | kept | |
| Events `resize`, `slideschanged`, `pointermove` (cancelable) | `ok:carousel:resize` / `slideschanged` / `pointermove` · `onResize`, `onSlidesChanged`, native `onPointerMove` | kept | cancel = `preventDefault()` / return `false` |
| Event `destroy` | — | deferred | runtime `stop()` / unmount |
| Plugins Autoplay, Auto Scroll, Auto Height, Fade, Wheel Gestures, Class Names, Accessibility | options / attributes (table above) | kept | Class Names → `data-ok-*` |
| Plugin Ssr | — | not applicable | SSR-safe CSS sizes |
| Minimals `slidesToShow`, `slideSpacing`, arrows / dots / progress / thumbs / play button | same | kept | |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
The HTML runtime adds or removes dots when the measured number of snaps differs from the markup
(React re-renders them). Parity ignores `style` (sizes and controller values).

components.summary: Show a set of slides one view at a time; people swipe, scroll, drag, use the arrow keys or the controls. The viewport is a native scroll container with CSS scroll snapping (works without JavaScript); core `createCarouselController` adds Embla's options and plugins and writes the derived state (selected snap, slides in view, controls) for React and the HTML runtime alike.

sections.body:
Show values as lines, areas, columns, bars, points, pie / donut slices, radial bars (rings,
gauges), a radar, box plots, heatmap or treemap cells, bubbles, range bands, funnels or slopes —
full size or as sparklines — with a legend that hides series, a tooltip
for the pointer, touch and keyboard, and the data as a table. The SVG is drawn by one layout engine
in core (`renderChart`), so React and HTML render the same markup.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
figure[data-ok-chart][data-ok-type][data-ok-x-type][data-ok-curve][data-ok-legend][data-ok-fill]
      [data-ok-stacked]?[data-ok-horizontal]?[data-ok-height]?[data-ok-marker-size]?

  div[data-ok-chart-toolbar][role=group][aria-label]?   (toolbar; first child)

      › svg[data-ok-chart-tool-icon][aria-hidden] › path       (zoom tools: with zoom on an x axis)
    button[type=button][data-ok-chart-tool="svg|png|csv"][aria-label][title] › "SVG" | "PNG" | "CSV"
    span[data-ok-chart-status][role=status]                 (visually hidden; announces failed downloads)
  div[data-ok-chart-legend]                              (absent: one series unless showForSingleSeries, legend "none")
    button[type=button][data-ok-chart-legend-item][data-ok-color][aria-pressed]

      defs › linearGradient[id][data-ok-color] › stop[data-ok-chart-stop]×2   (gradient areas)
      g[data-ok-chart-grid] › rect[data-ok-chart-stripe="row|column"][fill-opacity][data-ok-color]?* (4.18.64)
        + line[data-ok-chart-grid-line]                  (grid: horizontal, vertical, both or none)

      text[data-ok-chart-axis-title=x]?                  (xTitle, under the x labels)
      g[data-ok-chart-axis=x] › text[data-ok-chart-tick][data-ok-major]?
      g[data-ok-chart-axis=y][data-ok-index]?[data-ok-opposite]? › text[data-ok-chart-tick]
                                                         (one per drawn value axis; data-ok-index with several)
      g[data-ok-chart-background-bars]?                  (4.18.61: backgroundBars / backgroundBarColors)
        rect[data-ok-chart-background-bar][rx][data-ok-color]?[fill-opacity]? (one per bar slot)
      g[data-ok-chart-crosshair] › rect[data-ok-chart-band] | line[data-ok-chart-crosshair-line]
      g[data-ok-chart-series-group]                      (areas, bars, lines, scatter: in that order)
        g[data-ok-chart-series][data-ok-type][data-ok-color][data-ok-index]
          path[data-ok-chart-area][fill=url(#…)]? · path[data-ok-chart-line] ·
          path[data-ok-chart-bar][data-ok-color]? · circle[data-ok-chart-marker][data-ok-color]?
      g[data-ok-chart-data-labels]?                      (dataLabels; only when a label fits)
        text[data-ok-chart-data-label="inside|outside"]  (inside slices / bars: white; outside: above points)
        text[data-ok-chart-data-label="total"]           (stackTotals: past each stack's end, 4.18.61)
      Non-color cues (4.18.62): defs › pattern[id][patternUnits=userSpaceOnUse][width=8][height=8]
        [data-ok-chart-pattern="slantedLines|squares|circles|horizontalLines|verticalLines"][data-ok-color]
        › rect[data-ok-chart-pattern-tint][fill-opacity] + path | circle[data-ok-chart-pattern-mark]
        (bars, areas and slices then carry fill=url(#…)); markers may be
        path[data-ok-chart-marker][data-ok-shape="square|triangle|diamond|cross|plus|star"][data-ok-color]?
        (hover markers too); lines path[data-ok-chart-line][stroke-width]?[stroke-dasharray]?
      g[data-ok-chart-selected]?                         (selected points, 4.18.60; before the active group)
        circle | rect | path[data-ok-chart-selected-mark] (ring around points, frame around blocks
                                                          and cells, outline of slices and rings)
      g[data-ok-chart-active] › circle[data-ok-chart-active-marker][data-ok-color]
      g[data-ok-chart-center]?                           (donut / radial bar center)
        text[data-ok-chart-center-label] · text[data-ok-chart-center-value]
    Polar charts (phase 2) draw no axes groups except radar's, and these series shapes:
      pie, donut:  g[data-ok-chart-series] › path[data-ok-chart-slice][data-ok-color]
                   crosshair › path[data-ok-chart-active-slice][data-ok-color] (a halo behind the slice)
      radialBar:   defs › linearGradient[id] › stop[data-ok-chart-stop][data-ok-color]×2 (lighter → color)

                     path[data-ok-chart-radial][data-ok-color][stroke-width][stroke=url(#…)]?[stroke-dasharray]?)×n
      radar:       g[data-ok-chart-grid] › path[data-ok-chart-web] (value rings) + line[data-ok-chart-web] (spokes)
                   g[data-ok-chart-axis=x] › text[data-ok-chart-tick] (category labels around the web)
                   g[data-ok-chart-axis=y] › text[data-ok-chart-tick] (values along the top spoke)
                   g[data-ok-chart-series][data-ok-type=radar] › path[data-ok-chart-area] + path[data-ok-chart-line] (closed)
    Phase 3 series shapes (ADR-0029):
      boxPlot:     g[data-ok-chart-series] › (line[data-ok-chart-whisker]×4 + rect[data-ok-chart-box="upper|lower"][data-ok-color])×n

      bubble:      g[data-ok-chart-series] › circle[data-ok-chart-bubble][data-ok-color]?
      heatmap:     g[data-ok-chart-axis=x|y] (categories | series names), no grid;

      treemap:     no axes; g[data-ok-chart-series] › rect[data-ok-chart-cell][fill-opacity]…;
```
