sections.body:
A modal surface. Runtime behavior: core `createModalController` (shared with Drawer: native
`showModal()`, fallback with inert siblings, focus trap and return, scroll lock, layer stack).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-dialog-open="id"][aria-haspopup=dialog]
dialog[data-ok-dialog][id][aria-labelledby][data-ok-max-width][data-ok-scroll]…
  › div[data-ok-dialog-paper]
      › h2[data-ok-dialog-title][id]
      › div[data-ok-dialog-content][data-ok-dividers]? › p[data-ok-dialog-content-text]?
      › div[data-ok-dialog-actions][data-ok-disable-spacing]? › … [data-ok-dialog-close]
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `dialog`: listed under "options".)

React: `open` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (escape | backdrop | close), `paperProps`; the title
names the dialog automatically (`aria-labelledby`, unless `aria-label` is given). Parts:
`DialogContent dividers`, `DialogActions disableSpacing`. Renamed: `onClose(event, reason)` →
`onOpenChange`; `PaperProps` → `paperProps`; `maxWidth={false}` → `"none"`;
`TransitionComponent` → `transition` (a Motion entrance on the paper: `data-ok-motion`,
`data-ok-variant`, `data-ok-trigger="mount"`; without it, the paper's own fade and scale).
Deferred: `keepMounted` (always mounted), exit transitions. Not applicable: `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`, `BackdropComponent` (native `::backdrop`,
`--ok-backdrop`, the Backdrop component's token: a DOM Backdrop can't sit between a top-layer
`<dialog>` and its `::backdrop`), `disablePortal` (top layer).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Paper: radius `--ok-radius-xl`, `--ok-shadow-dialog`, `--ok-bg-paper`, margin 16px (32px from
600px), max height viewport − 2 × margin; widths xs 444px, sm 600px, md/lg/xl the breakpoint
tokens. Title h6 (600) padding 24px; content padding 0 24px (dividers: 16px + 1px lines); content
text `--ok-text-secondary` body1; actions padding 24px, gap 12px. Full screen: no margin, radius,
shadow. Backdrop `--ok-backdrop`. Opening: fade + scale 0.96 (`--ok-duration-short`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Mobile-first margin (16px → 32px at 600px); the paper never exceeds the viewport.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Native modal: inert page, Tab trapped, Escape → `onOpenChange(false, "escape")` (unless
`disableEscapeKeyDown`), backdrop click (press and release outside the paper). Focus: first tabbable
or `[autofocus]`, else the paper; returns to the trigger. Scrollable content gets
`tabindex="0"` + a name in the stories.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:dialog:beforeopen` (cancelable), `ok:dialog:open`, `ok:dialog:beforeclose` (cancelable,
`detail.reason`: escape | backdrop | trigger | api), `ok:dialog:close` (also `native`). Instance:
`{ isOpen, open(trigger?), close(reason?) }`. `data-ok-open` opens on load.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API pages Dialog (inherits Modal), DialogTitle, DialogContent, DialogContentText, DialogActions.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open`, `children`, `fullScreen`, `fullWidth`, `scroll`, `role` (`alertdialog`), `aria-*` | same | kept | the title names the dialog automatically |
| `maxWidth` (`false`) | `"none"` | renamed | |
| `onClose(event, reason)` (`escapeKeyDown` `backdropClick`) | `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (`escape` `backdrop` `close`); HTML `ok:dialog:beforeclose` | renamed | |
| `PaperProps` / `slotProps.paper` | `paperProps` | renamed | |
| `TransitionComponent` | `transition` (a Motion entrance on the paper) | renamed | |
| `transitionDuration` | — (fixed `--ok-duration-short`) | deferred (4.18.44) | waits for 5.1 exit transitions |
| `PaperComponent` | — | not applicable | the paper is a fixed part; compose inside it |
| Modal `disableEscapeKeyDown`, `hideBackdrop` | same | kept | |
| Modal `keepMounted` | same (React only), default `true` | kept (4.8) | MUI default `false`; ours keeps the children like the HTML markup (no breaking change); `false` renders them only while open |
| Modal `disableRestoreFocus`, `disableScrollLock` | same (`data-ok-disable-restore-focus`, `data-ok-disable-scroll-lock`) | kept (4.18.45) | core modal controller `restoreFocus` / `lockScroll`; the browser's own focus return after `dialog.close()` is undone |
| Modal `disableAutoFocus`, `disableEnforceFocus` | — | not applicable | native `showModal()` focuses and traps |
| Modal `container`, `disablePortal` | — | not applicable | top layer |
| Modal `closeAfterTransition`, `onTransitionEnter`, `onTransitionExited`, `BackdropComponent` / `BackdropProps`, `onBackdropClick` | `ok:dialog:open` / `close`; native `::backdrop` | not applicable | `onBackdropClick` deprecated upstream |
| `DialogTitle`, `DialogContentText` `children` | same | kept | |
| `DialogContent` `dividers` | same | kept | |
| `DialogActions` `disableSpacing` | same | kept | |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps`, `TransitionComponent` / `TransitionProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS, composition, one CSS transition |

1px `--ok-divider`; `inset` 72px start (`--ok-spacing` × 18); `middle` 16px inline (vertical: 8px
block); vertical `height: 100%`, `flexItem` stretches; `absolute` pins to the bottom. With text:
`--ok-text-secondary` body2, lines as `::before` / `::after`, text padding 10px (`left` / `right`:
the near line is 10%).

outlined Card; words and paragraphs are Typography `body2` / `textSecondary` (story classes
`sb-divider-*` keep layout only).

sections.body: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (navigation, filters, details).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[trigger] button[data-ok-button][aria-haspopup="dialog"]     HTML: [data-ok-drawer-open="<id>"]
dialog[data-ok-drawer][data-ok-anchor][aria-label | aria-labelledby]   React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  div[data-ok-drawer-content]                                the paper; any content
    … HTML close: [data-ok-drawer-close] (inside) or [data-ok-drawer-close="<id>"]
```
Scrolling content: put it in a Scrollbar inside the content — `[data-ok-drawer-content] ›
section[data-ok-scrollbar]`; the Scrollbar fills the panel and scrolls (the panel stops scrolling).
The dialog then focuses the Scrollbar first on open (it is the first focusable element).
The `<dialog>` is a transparent full-viewport container; the content is the paper. A click whose
target is the `<dialog>` itself is a backdrop click.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `drawer`: listed under "options".)

React: `<Drawer variant open | defaultOpen onOpenChange(open, reason)>` holds the state (reason:
`"escape"` · `"backdrop"` · `"close"`; refuse by not changing `open`); `anchor`, `hideBackdrop` and
`disableEscapeKeyDown` are props of `DrawerContent`. HTML initial state: `data-ok-open` (temporary)
or no `hidden` attribute (persistent); refuse a close with `ok:drawer:beforeclose`.

Docked variants (`persistent`, `permanent`) render `<aside>` in the page flow — no backdrop, no focus
trap, no scroll lock; their trigger toggles and carries `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`. Put the
drawer and the page area in a flex row (left / right) or column (top / bottom).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Paper `--ok-bg-paper`, text `--ok-text-primary`; backdrop: native `::backdrop` with `--ok-backdrop` (shared with the Backdrop component, which can't
  sit in the top layer; `hideBackdrop` matches its `invisible`); stacking `--ok-z-modal`
  (fallback path).
- `left` / `right`: full height, width from the content, at most `100% - 56px`; shadow
  `--ok-shadow-dialog-start` (left) / `--ok-shadow-dialog` (right).
- `top` / `bottom`: full width, height from the content, at most `100% - 56px`; shadow
  `--ok-shadow-z16`. Taller content scrolls inside the Scrollbar placed in the paper (without one,
  the paper itself scrolls).
- Opening slides the paper in from its edge and fades the backdrop (`--ok-duration-short`,
  `--ok-easing-decelerate`) where `@starting-style` is supported; closing is immediate.
  `prefers-reduced-motion` disables both.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- **Open:** `showModal()` (fallback: `open` + `data-ok-fallback`, siblings inert, ADR-0006); push onto
  the layer stack; lock page scroll; focus `[autofocus]` → first tabbable → content.
- **Dismiss requests** (Escape, backdrop) are reported, not acted on: React updates state (controlled
  drawers may refuse); HTML emits cancelable `beforeclose`. Only the topmost layer reacts.
- **Close:** release lock and stack; focus returns to the trigger if focus was lost.
- **External close** (`<form method="dialog">`): state syncs. **Removal / unmount while open:**
  cleanup without focus restoration.
sections.title: Behavior (`core` `createModalController`)

sections.body:
`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` stay inside the drawer (native modals may hand focus to browser UI); `Escape`
requests close.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Role `dialog`, modal. A name is required (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`). Background inert.
Focus returns to the trigger. Triggers carry `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:drawer:beforeopen` (cancelable) · `ok:drawer:open` · `ok:drawer:beforeclose`
(cancelable, `detail.reason`) · `ok:drawer:close` (`reason`: `escape` `backdrop` `trigger` `api`
`native`). Instance (`runtime.get(el, "drawer")`): `open(trigger?)`, `close(reason?)`, `toggle()`,
`isOpen`. React: `<Drawer open defaultOpen onOpenChange>`, `DrawerTrigger`, `DrawerContent`,
`DrawerClose`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same anchors at every breakpoint. The `56px` gap keeps the backdrop reachable on small screens.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API pages Drawer, SwipeableDrawer (Modal props through `ModalProps`).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `Drawer open` / `defaultOpen`; HTML `data-ok-open` / `hidden` | kept | |
| `onClose(event, reason)` | `onOpenChange(open, reason)`; HTML `ok:drawer:beforeclose` | renamed | |
| `variant` (`temporary` `persistent` `permanent`) | same (on `Drawer`) | kept | |
| `anchor`, `hideBackdrop` | `DrawerContent` props | kept | |
| one `Drawer` element | `Drawer` (state) + `DrawerTrigger` + `DrawerContent` + `DrawerClose` | renamed | |
| `PaperProps` / `slotProps.paper` | `DrawerContent` children (`[data-ok-drawer-content]`) | renamed | |
| `elevation`, `transitionDuration` | `DrawerContent` props; HTML `data-ok-elevation` (0–24), `data-ok-transition-duration` (ms) | kept (4.9) | core `drawerStyle` → `--_ok-drawer-shadow` / `--_ok-drawer-duration` (React `style`, HTML CSSOM); without `elevation` each edge keeps its shadow (MUI 16) |
| `ModalProps.disableEscapeKeyDown` | `disableEscapeKeyDown` | kept | |
| `ModalProps.keepMounted`, `disableRestoreFocus`, `disableScrollLock` | `DrawerContent` props `keepMounted` (React only, default `true`), `disableRestoreFocus`, `disableScrollLock` (`data-ok-*`, temporary only) | renamed (4.18.45) | props on DrawerContent instead of `ModalProps` |
| `ModalProps.container` / `disablePortal` / `disableAutoFocus` / `disableEnforceFocus` | — | not applicable | native modal `<dialog>` in the top layer |
| `SwipeableDrawer` (`onOpen`, `swipeAreaWidth`, `hysteresis`, `minFlingVelocity`, `disableSwipeToOpen`, `disableDiscovery`, `allowSwipeInChildren`, `disableBackdropTransition`) | — | deferred (4.18.46) | "could"; left after batch B (budget, shares a swipe helper with 4.14) |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps`, `TransitionComponent` / `TransitionProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS, composition, one CSS transition |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Behavior hooks (`data-ok-drawer-open/close`, `data-ok-*-close` options, `data-ok-open`) exist only in
HTML; React expresses them as props and handlers.

sections.body:
Rich text editing: headings, marks, lists, alignment, code, quotes, links and images, with
HTML in and out. Tiptap (framework-free) runs in core `createEditorController`
(`@owlky/core/editor`), shared by React and the HTML runtime; the toolbar is Owlky markup.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-editor][data-ok-full-item]?[data-ok-error]?[data-ok-editable="false"]?[data-ok-fullscreen]?[data-ok-placeholder]?
  div[data-ok-backdrop][data-ok-open]?                              (Backdrop, composed; open while fullscreen; optional in HTML)
  div[data-ok-editor-toolbar][role=toolbar][aria-label="Formatting"][aria-controls=<content id>]
    button[data-ok-editor-heading][aria-haspopup=menu][aria-expanded][aria-controls=<menu id>]   (HTML: data-ok-popover-open)
      span[data-ok-editor-heading-label] ("Paragraph", "Heading 1" … "Heading 6") + svg
    div[data-ok-editor-group][data-ok-full]?                       (9 groups; data-ok-full = only with fullItem)
      button[data-ok-editor-action=<action>][aria-label][aria-keyshortcuts]?[aria-pressed]?[disabled]?
        svg[aria-hidden]                                           (fullscreen: svg[data-ok-editor-icon=enter|exit])
  div[data-ok-editor-body]                                         (scrolls; grey 8% tint)
    div[data-ok-editor-content][id][role=textbox][aria-multiline=true][aria-label|aria-labelledby][aria-describedby]?[aria-invalid]?
      …content (Tiptap: contenteditable, class "tiptap ProseMirror", translate=no, aria-readonly when read only)
      div[data-ok-editor-code-block] › select[data-ok-editor-language][aria-label=Language]? + pre › code.language-<x>
        (select: "auto" (value ""), a disabled "—" rule, then the highlighter's languages)
      span[style="text-transform: uppercase|lowercase|capitalize"]  (text transform mark; input also data-ok-text-transform)
  p[data-ok-editor-helper][id]?
  Menu: div[data-ok-popover][id] › ul[data-ok-menu][role=menu][aria-labelledby=<heading>] › li[data-ok-menu-item][data-ok-editor-block=paragraph|h1…h6][data-ok-selected]?
        (each item in its block's type: Paragraph body2, Heading 1 17px … Heading 6 12px, bold)
  Popover (link): div[data-ok-popover][role=dialog][aria-labelledby] › form[data-ok-editor-form=link][novalidate]
    › p[data-ok-editor-form-title] + div[data-ok-editor-form-row] › TextField (input[data-ok-editor-field=href]) + Button[type=submit]
  Popover (image): same › form[data-ok-editor-form=image] › title + TextField (src) + TextField (alt) + Button[type=submit]
  -- ADR-0050 --
  (toolbar, with tables) div[data-ok-editor-group] › button[data-ok-editor-action=table][aria-label=Table][aria-haspopup=menu][aria-expanded][aria-controls=<table menu>]
                                                    (before the fullscreen group; HTML: data-ok-popover-open)
  Menu (tables): div[data-ok-popover][id] › ul[data-ok-menu][role=menu][aria-labelledby=<table button>]
    › li[data-ok-menu-item][data-ok-editor-table-action=<action>][aria-disabled]?   (12 items, editorTableActions)
  content (tables): table › tbody › tr › th|td (colspan, rowspan, colwidth; Tiptap adds colgroup + min-width style)
  content (mentions): span[data-type=mention][data-ok-editor-mention][data-id][data-label][data-mention-suggestion-char]? "@Label"
  Bubble menu: div[popover=manual][data-ok-popover][data-ok-editor-bubble-menu][data-ok-runtime=off][id][role=toolbar]
               [aria-label="Text formatting"][aria-controls=<content id>][data-ok-placement]?[data-ok-update-delay]?
    › button[data-ok-editor-action] …                             (toolbar buttons; default bold italic underline strike code link)
  Mention list: div[popover=manual][data-ok-popover][data-ok-editor-mentions][data-ok-runtime=off][data-ok-char]?[data-ok-allow-spaces]?
    › ul[role=listbox][id][aria-label="Suggestions"] › li[role=option][id][data-ok-editor-mention-option][aria-selected]   (written by core)
  template[data-ok-editor-mention-items] › [data-ok-value=<id>] "Label" …           (HTML only: the items)
  input[type=hidden][data-ok-editor-input][name]                    (with `name`: the HTML value)
```
The bubble menu and the mention list carry `data-ok-runtime="off"` in both implementations: the
editor's core controllers own them (the HTML popover runtime stays away).
Actions: `bold italic underline strike | bulletList orderedList | alignLeft alignCenter alignRight
alignJustify | code codeBlock (full) | blockquote horizontalRule (full) | link unlink image |
hardBreak clearFormat | undo redo (full) | fullscreen`. Labels and keys: `editorToolbar` in core.
Action without a button: `textTransform` (`run("textTransform", { textTransform })`, as the
reference's TextTransform extension).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `editor`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(html)` (`""` when empty), `placeholder`
(default "Write something awesome..."; HTML `data-ok-placeholder`), `helperText`, `highlighter`
(lowlight-compatible; HTML `createEditor({ highlighter })`), `onFullscreenChange(fullscreen)`,
`aria-label` (default "Editor") / `aria-labelledby` (go to the textbox).
ADR-0050: `bubbleMenu` (`true` | `{ actions, placement, updateDelay, shouldShow, label }`; HTML: the
bubble menu markup, `data-ok-placement`, `data-ok-update-delay`), `mentions` (`{ char, items(query),
allowSpaces, label }`; HTML: the list markup, `data-ok-char`, `data-ok-allow-spaces`, items from the
template or `ok:editor:mentionsearch`), `extensions`, `editorProps`, `parseOptions` (read at
creation; HTML `createEditor({ extensions, editorProps, parseOptions })`), `autofocus` (also `true`
or a position in React).

API mapping: see "Upstream API mapping" below.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root: 1px `rgb(grey-500 / 0.2)` border (error: `error-main`), radius `--ok-radius-md`, min height
240px, max height 720px. Toolbar: padding 10px, gap 8px, wraps; groups gap 4px, each preceded by a
1 × 16px rule. Buttons 28 × 28px, radius `--ok-radius-sm`, icons 18px; heading trigger 32px high,
min 120px, 1px border, body2 medium. Hover `--ok-action-hover` (hover devices), pressed /
expanded `--ok-action-selected`, disabled `--ok-text-disabled`, focus 2px inner outline. Body:
`rgb(grey-500 / 0.08)`, content padding 0 16px 16px, typography h1–h6 / body1, paragraphs 20px
apart, links `primary-main` (brand, ADR-0014), inline code `rgb(grey-500 / 0.2)` + text primary,
code blocks `grey-900` / white mono, padding 40px 24px 24px, lines wrap; syntax colors are palette
`*-light` tones (≥ 4.5:1 on grey-900). Fullscreen: fixed, inset 16px, `--ok-z-modal`, no shadow,
over the composed Backdrop (`--ok-backdrop`, `z-index: -1` inside the root's stacking context, so
the toolbar, body and helper carry the paper themselves). Heading menu items: Paragraph body2,
Heading 1 `font-size-xl × 17/16`, Heading 2–6 `font-size-xl / lg / md / sm / xs`, bold. Read
only: toolbar hidden.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- Initial content: React `value ?? defaultValue` (HTML string); HTML: the markup inside the content
  element, parsed from the DOM (no string, no Trusted Types sink). Content keeps only what the
  schema knows (no scripts, handlers or unknown elements); links and images are checked with
  `safeEditorUrl` (http(s), mailto, tel, relative; images http(s) / relative; no `data:`).
- Tiptap's trailing node keeps an empty paragraph after a final block that isn't one.
- Controlled (`value`): a new `value` replaces the content; late echoes of values the editor
  reported itself are skipped (fast typing, batched renders). Edits the owner ignores are not
  undone (as Tiptap): rich text can't be held back key by key.
- Toolbar state (`aria-pressed`, `disabled`, heading label, selected menu item) follows every
  transaction (`onStateChange`). Undo / Redo / Remove link are disabled when they can't run.
- Link / image: the button opens its form popover (link prefilled with the current `href`); Apply
  is disabled until the URL is valid; submit (button or Enter) runs the action and closes it.
  A link with an empty selection inserts the URL as text.
- Fullscreen: the button toggles `data-ok-fullscreen` and opens the root's Backdrop
  (`data-ok-open`); Escape (outside popovers) leaves it. While fullscreen (core
  `holdEditorFullscreen`): page scroll locked (shared `lockScroll`), and focus leaving for the page
  wraps to the first tab stop (Tab) or the last one (Shift+Tab; links and the language menu inside
  the content aren't stops of their own). Focus leaving for the browser UI is let go. HTML markup
  that starts with `data-ok-fullscreen` is held at setup.
- Text transform: `span` with an allowed `text-transform` style or `data-ok-text-transform` is kept
  (other spans and values are dropped); output is always the `style` form (portable HTML).
- `editable=false`: `contenteditable=false`, `aria-readonly`, toolbar disabled and hidden.
- Tiptap's injected `<style>` is off (`injectCSS: false`, CSP); editor.css carries ProseMirror's rules.
- Tables (`tables`, ADR-0050): TableKit (Table, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell; no column
  resizing). The table menu runs `insertTable` (3 × 3 with a header row), add / delete column and
  row, toggle header row / column, merge / split cells (a cell selection), delete table; items are
  `aria-disabled` when their command can't run (`can()`), like the toolbar's `disabled`. A run is
  checked with `can()` first (a refused chain would still move the focus). `getValue()` keeps a
  table of empty cells (Tiptap's `isEmpty` counts it as empty).
- Mentions (`mentions`): Tiptap's Mention + Suggestion; the list is a Popover (`bottom-start`) on
  the suggestion's rectangle, opened while there are items (async items: shown when they arrive),
  closed when there are none, on Escape and when the query ends. Core writes the options
  (`li[role=option]`, label text) into the owner's listbox; the textbox gets `aria-controls` and
  `aria-activedescendant` while it is open. Presses on the list keep the focus in the text. HTML
  items: the template's `[data-ok-value]` entries whose text contains the query (case-insensitive,
  10 at most), replaced by `respondWith()` of `ok:editor:mentionsearch`.
- Bubble menu (`bubbleMenu`): core `createEditorBubbleMenu`; shows after `updateDelay` (250 ms)
  when `shouldShow` holds (default: a non-empty text selection, editable, focus in the text or the
  menu), placed `top` of the selection (`posToDOMRect`); hides on blur unless focus moved into it,
  and when focus leaves it for the page. Its buttons are toolbar buttons (state, disabled, link /
  image forms). Presses don't take the focus (`mousedown` default prevented).
- Pass-through: `extensions` are added after the built-in set (a top-level one with the same name
  replaces it); `editorProps` merge with the editor's (`aria-readonly` wins); `parseOptions` also
  parse the HTML markup; `autofocus`, `textDirection`, `enableInputRules`, `enablePasteRules` go to
  Tiptap as given. These and `tables` / `mentions` are read when the editor is created (React:
  remount with `key` for new extensions).
- `name`: a hidden input (`data-ok-editor-input`) carries `getValue()` after every change and
  `setValue()`.
- Tiptap events (row 4.18.33): core `onEvent(name, props)` reports `beforeCreate` (during the
  constructor), `create` (a task after mount), `focus`, `blur`, `selectionUpdate`, `transaction`,
  `paste`, `drop`, `delete` (a task later, as Tiptap), `contentError`, `destroy` with Tiptap's
  props (`destroy` gets `{ editor }`). React calls the latest handler without a new editor; HTML
  relays them as `ok:editor:<lowercase>` with plain details (no transactions, slices or nodes).
  `update` stays `onChange` / `ok:editor:change`.
- Content check: `enableContentCheck` (Tiptap's): invalid initial content reports `contentError`
  and loads without the invalid parts; an invalid `setContent` (React `value`, HTML `setValue`)
  is refused and reported (Tiptap throws there; the controller catches its content errors only).
  `emitContentError` passes through (Tiptap reports invalid inserted content and keeps it). HTML
  snippet markup is parsed from the DOM by the schema, so it never reports a content error.
- Editor access: React `editorRef` gets the Tiptap editor after each creation and `null` after
  destroy (also `onCreate({ editor })`); HTML instance `editor`; both have `getJSON()` /
  `getText()` (controller and HTML instance).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
Toolbar: one tab stop (roving tabindex, `createToolbarNavigation`): ArrowLeft / ArrowRight
(wrap), Home, End. Text box: Tiptap defaults (Mod+B / I / U, Mod+Shift+S, Mod+Shift+7 / 8,
Mod+Shift+L / E / R / J, Mod+E, Mod+Alt+C, Mod+Shift+B, Shift+Enter, Mod+Z, Mod+Shift+Z) and
Mod+Shift+X (clear formatting, Owlky). Escape leaves fullscreen; Tab / Shift+Tab stay inside the
editor while fullscreen. Alt+F10 in the text: to the bubble menu when it shows, else to the
toolbar's current control (TinyMCE / CKEditor convention); in the bubble menu ArrowLeft /
ArrowRight / Home / End move, Escape goes back to the text (selection kept). Mention list:
ArrowDown / ArrowUp (wrap), Enter / Tab pick, Escape closes. Tables: Tiptap's Tab / Shift+Tab move
between cells.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Textbox named by `aria-label` (default "Editor") or `aria-labelledby`, described by the helper,
`aria-invalid` with `error`. Toolbar buttons named, `aria-pressed` for toggles,
`aria-keyshortcuts` for shortcuts; popover triggers `aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` /
`aria-controls`. Forms are dialogs named by their title; Escape closes them and focus returns to the
button. Fullscreen keeps Tab inside the editor (WCAG 2.4.11: no focus on controls hidden behind it). Content links use the brand color (contrast exempt, ADR-0014).
The bubble menu is a named `toolbar` (Alt+F10 reaches it without a pointer); the table trigger is
`aria-haspopup="menu"`; the mention list is a named `listbox` the textbox points at with
`aria-activedescendant` (focus stays in the text, as Autocomplete). Mentions are brand-colored text
on a tint (ADR-0014).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:editor:change` (`{ value }`), `ok:editor:fullscreen` (`{ fullscreen }`). Instance
`{ value, setValue(html), fullscreen, setFullscreen(on), setEditable(on), focus(), controller,
editor, getJSON(), getText() }`. Tiptap events: `ok:editor:beforecreate` (no detail), `create`
(`{ value }`), `focus` / `blur` (`{ event }`), `selectionupdate` (`{ from, to, empty }`),
`transaction` (`{ docChanged }`), `paste` (`{ event, text }`), `drop` (`{ event, text, moved }`),
`delete` (`{ type, name, from, to, partial }`), `contenterror` (`{ message }`), `destroy` (no detail).
Core: `EditorState.textTransform` (value at the selection), `run("textTransform", { textTransform:
"uppercase" | "lowercase" | "capitalize" | null })`, `TextTransform` (the mark),
`editorTextTransforms`, `readTextTransform`, `holdEditorFullscreen(root)`.
Registration is opt-in: `@owlky/html/editor`, `owlky-editor.js`, or `createEditor({ highlighter })`.
React: `onChange(html)`, `onFullscreenChange(fullscreen)`, `editorRef`, `onBeforeCreate`,
`onCreate`, `onEditorFocus`, `onEditorBlur`, `onSelectionUpdate`, `onTransaction`,
`onEditorPaste`, `onEditorDrop`, `onDelete`, `onContentError`, `onDestroy` (Tiptap's props;
`onFocus` / `onBlur` / `onPaste` / `onDrop` stay the root's DOM handlers, so the Tiptap ones are
prefixed), `enableContentCheck`, `emitContentError`. Core: controller `getJSON()`, `getText()`,
options `onEvent`, `enableContentCheck`, `emitContentError`; `editorEventNames`,
`EditorEventName`, `EditorEventProps`, `TiptapEditor`, `EditorJSONContent`.
ADR-0050: HTML `ok:editor:mentionsearch` (`{ query, char, items, respondWith(itemsOrPromise) }`),
`createEditor({ extensions, editorProps, parseOptions })`. Core: `createEditorBubbleMenu(editor,
menu, options)` (`isOpen`, `update()`, `focus()`, `setOptions()`, `destroy()`),
`defaultBubbleMenuShow`, `editorToolbarShortcut(root, content, bubble)`, `editorTableActions`,
`editorBubbleMenuActions`, `editorToolButton(action)`, `EditorMentionItem`, controller options
`tables`, `mentions`, `extensions`, `editorProps`, `parseOptions`, `autofocus`, `textDirection`,
`enableInputRules`, `enablePasteRules`; table actions through `run()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
The toolbar wraps at every width (mobile: three to four rows); the body scrolls inside the 720px
cap; forms are `min(320px, 100vw − 48px)` wide. The story puts editor and preview side by side from
900px, stacked below; the preview renders the editor's HTML with Markdown (`rawHtml`, ADR-0035),
as the reference does, in an outlined Card (`component="section"`) under a Typography `h6`
title (`component="h3"`).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: the Minimals `Editor` wrapper's props and Tiptap 3 (tiptap.dev/docs/editor/api/editor,
/api/events).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Minimals `value`, `onChange`, `editable`, `fullItem`, `error`, `helperText`, `placeholder` | same | kept | `onChange(html)`, `""` when empty |
| Minimals `resetValue` | `value=""` | not applicable | |
| Minimals `className`, `sx`, `slotProps` | root `className` | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
| Tiptap `content` | `value` / `defaultValue`; HTML: markup in the content element | renamed | |
| Tiptap `editable`, `setEditable()` | `editable`, `setEditable(on)` | kept | |
| Tiptap `element`, `mount()` / `unmount()` | `[data-ok-editor-content]` | not applicable | the anatomy owns the mount |
| Tiptap `injectCSS`, `injectNonce` | — | not applicable | `injectCSS: false` (CSP); editor.css |
| Tiptap `extensions` | `extensions` (after the built-in set; a same-named one replaces it) · HTML `createEditor({ extensions })` | kept | ADR-0050; read at creation |
| Tiptap `schemaSpec`, `coreExtensionOptions`, `enableExtensionDispatchTransaction` | — | deferred | |
| Tiptap `editorProps`, `parseOptions` | same (merged; read at creation) · HTML `createEditor({ editorProps, parseOptions })` | kept | |
| Tiptap `enableInputRules`, `enablePasteRules`, `textDirection`, `autofocus` | same · `data-ok-enable-input-rules`, `-enable-paste-rules`, `-text-direction`, `-autofocus` | kept | rule lists (arrays) in React only; HTML autofocus `start` · `end` · `all` |
| `@tiptap/extension-table` (TableKit) | `tables` / `data-ok-tables` + the table menu | kept | `resizable` and its options deferred |
| `@tiptap/extension-mention` + `@tiptap/suggestion` | `mentions` (`char`, `items`, `allowSpaces`) · HTML list markup + template / `ok:editor:mentionsearch` | kept | `suggestions` (several triggers), `renderText` / `renderHTML`, `deleteTriggerWithBackspace` deferred |
| event `update` | `onChange(html)`, `ok:editor:change` | renamed | |
| events `beforeCreate`, `create`, `selectionUpdate`, `transaction`, `destroy`, `delete`, `contentError` | React `onBeforeCreate`, `onCreate`, `onSelectionUpdate`, `onTransaction`, `onDestroy`, `onDelete`, `onContentError` · `ok:editor:beforecreate`, `create`, `selectionupdate`, `transaction`, `destroy`, `delete`, `contenterror` | kept | HTML details are plain values |
| events `focus`, `blur`, `paste`, `drop` | React `onEditorFocus`, `onEditorBlur`, `onEditorPaste`, `onEditorDrop` · `ok:editor:focus`, `blur`, `paste`, `drop` | renamed | the root's DOM `onFocus`… keep their names |
| events `mount`, `unmount`, `beforeTransaction` | — | not applicable / deferred | the anatomy owns the mount; `beforeTransaction` through `editorRef` / `editor.on()` |
| Tiptap `enableContentCheck`, `emitContentError` | same · `data-ok-enable-content-check`, `data-ok-emit-content-error` | kept | read at creation; invalid `setContent` reported, not thrown |
| `getHTML()` | `getValue()`, instance `value` | renamed | |
| `getJSON()`, `getText()` | controller and HTML instance `getJSON()`, `getText()`; React through `editorRef` | kept | |
| `isEmpty`, `isFocused`, `registerPlugin()`, `setOptions()`, `on()` / `off()` | the Tiptap editor: React `editorRef` / `onCreate`, HTML instance `editor` | kept | escape hatch |
| `chain()`, `can()`, `isActive()`, `getAttributes()` | `run(action, value)`, `EditorState` (`active`, `disabled`, `link`, `textTransform`) | renamed | |
| `commands.focus()`, `destroy()` | `focus()`, `destroy({ restore })` | kept | |
| `@tiptap/react` `BubbleMenu` (`shouldShow`, `updateDelay`, `options.placement`) | `bubbleMenu` (`actions`, `placement`, `updateDelay`, `shouldShow`) · HTML bubble menu markup | renamed | Owlky's own (popover controller, Alt+F10); `pluginKey`, `appendTo`, `resizeDelay`, other Floating UI options not applicable |
| `@tiptap/react` `useEditor` (the editor instance, its event options) | `editorRef`, `onCreate` and the event props | renamed | the component creates the editor |
| `@tiptap/react` `EditorContent`, `useCurrentEditor`, `FloatingMenu` | — | deferred | |
| form `name` (hidden input) | `name` · `input[data-ok-editor-input][name]` | kept | |

Beyond upstream: `defaultValue`, `highlighter`, `onFullscreenChange`, `aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby`, fullscreen.
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` (root and Backdrop); popover triggers carry
`data-ok-popover-open` in HTML only. Snippets write text transforms as `data-ok-text-transform`
(no `style` in snippets); the content DOM after mount is the same `style` form on both sides.
Both mount the same controller, so the content DOM matches after mount (React fills it from
`value`, HTML from the markup). The Bubble menu, Table and Mentions snippets are generated from the
React demos (`node apps/storybook/scripts/demo-snippets.mjs editor`: content filled in, readable
ids, `data-ok-runtime="off"` kept on the bubble menu and the mention list, the mention template
added). The mention list's options and the textbox's `aria-activedescendant` exist only while the
list is open (core writes them in both).

sections.body:
(Options of `fab`: listed under "options".)

| Variant | Rest | Hover (`hover: hover`) |
|---|---|---|
| contained | bg `main` (default: grey-300, inherit: `--ok-inherit-main`), text `contrast`, shadow `--ok-c-shadow` (z8 for default / inherit / black / white) | bg `hover`, no shadow |
| outlined | border `channel` 48 % (default / inherit 32 %), text `main` (default: secondary text) | bg 8 % |

Upstream: MUI `Fab` (+ `ButtonBase`), mui.com/material-ui/api/fab/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` (`circular` · `extended`) | `extended` flag | renamed | Owlky's `variant` is the fill style (`contained` · `outlined` · `soft`, reference) |
| `color` (default `default`) | `color` | kept | + `inherit`, `black` / `white` |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`, default `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`, default `md`) | renamed | |
| `children`, `disabled`, `href` | same | kept | |
| `component`, `LinkComponent` (ButtonBase) | same | kept | 4.18.22: as on Button (router links; a disabled router link keeps its `href`, `aria-disabled`, `tabindex=-1`, no pointer events) |
| `action`, `focusVisibleClassName`, `onFocusVisible`, `nativeButton` (ButtonBase) | `ref.focus()`, `:focus-visible` | not applicable | |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (+ ButtonBase ripple props) | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

Beyond MUI: `animate` (reference).

sections.body:
Groups a control (or a group of controls) with its label and helper text and shares their states:
`disabled`, `error`, `required`, `focused`, plus `size`, `color`, `variant`, `fullWidth`,
`margin` for a composed input. CSS only: in HTML the states are attributes on the root that the
parts' CSS reads; in React a context (`useFormControl()`) carries them to the parts.

FormControl composes **around** selection controls (Checkbox, Radio, Switch with
FormControlLabel, RadioGroup, FormGroup) and standalone controls (Switch, Slider, Rating…). It
never goes inside TextField, which keeps its own label and helper parts. The controls' DOM and API
don't change: their ARIA (`aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`, `disabled`) is
written by the author on them, as in MUI.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
(div | fieldset)[data-ok-form-control][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-size]?[data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-margin]?
                [data-ok-full-width]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?[data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?
                [disabled]?                                          (fieldset: native disabled)
  (label | legend | span)[data-ok-form-label][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?
                         [data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?[data-ok-filled]?[id]?[for]?
    …text
    span[data-ok-form-label-asterisk][aria-hidden="true"]?           (required: own or the root's)
  div[data-ok-form-group][data-ok-row]?                              › FormControlLabels
  | div[role=radiogroup][data-ok-radio-group][aria-labelledby][aria-describedby]?
  | a standalone control (its input has id, aria-describedby)
  p[data-ok-form-helper-text][data-ok-margin]?[data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-error]?
                             [data-ok-required]?[data-ok-focused]?[data-ok-filled]?[id]?
```
Groups of controls: `fieldset` + `legend` (native group name), or a `div` root with a FormLabel
`id` referenced by the group's `aria-labelledby`. Standalone input: `label[for]`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `form-control`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-label`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-group`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `form-helper-text`: listed under "options".)

Style options are written only when given (a plain group stays `data-ok-form-control` alone).

React: `component` on FormControl (default `div`), FormLabel (`label`), FormHelperText (`p`);
FormGroup `row`. A part's own state props add a state to it (`data-ok-*` on the part); the
FormControl's states reach the parts through CSS in both frameworks, so React writes the root's
states only on the root. FormLabel renders the asterisk when its own `required` or the
FormControl's is on (`required={false}` on the label hides it). `disabled` on a `fieldset`
FormControl is also written as the native `disabled`, which disables every control inside; on a
`div` root, pass `disabled` to each control. `useFormControl()` returns the shared state (or
`undefined` outside a FormControl).

API mapping: see "Upstream API mapping" below.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root: `inline-flex` column, `min-width: 0`, no margin / padding / border (a `fieldset` too),
  `vertical-align: top`. `fullWidth` → `width: 100%`. `margin`: dense 8 / 4px, normal 16 / 8px
  (`--ok-spacing` × 2 / 1, × 4 / 2), like TextField.
- FormLabel: body2 (`--ok-typography-body2-*`), `--ok-text-secondary`, no padding; `legend` has
  no float or padding. Focused: `--ok-text-primary` (`color` default) or `--ok-palette-<c>-text`
  (through `--ok-c-text`, read on the root into `--_ok-form-focus`, since `--ok-c-*` don't
  inherit). Error: `--ok-palette-error-text`. Disabled: `--ok-text-disabled` (inactive; exempt
  from contrast like disabled controls). Error wins over focused, disabled over both. Asterisk:
  0.25ch before it.
- FormGroup: flex column, wrap; `row` → row. Same as RadioGroup.
- FormHelperText: caption (`--ok-typography-caption-*`), `--ok-text-secondary`, margin-top 6px
  (`--ok-spacing` × 1.5; dense 4px), inline 0; `outlined` / `filled` variant (own or the root's)
  indent 12px (× 3) like TextField's helper. Error: `--ok-palette-error-text`. Disabled keeps
  `--ok-text-secondary` (AA, as TextField's helper).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Intrinsic: the root shrinks (`min-width: 0`), groups wrap, label and helper text wrap
(`overflow-wrap: anywhere`).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: None at runtime. States are attributes (and native `:disabled` on a fieldset root).
sections.title: States / Behavior

sections.body: The controls' own keyboard behavior. A `legend` / label doesn't take focus.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- Groups: `fieldset` + `legend` name the group natively; a `div` root needs the group's
  `aria-labelledby` pointing at the FormLabel's `id`.
- Helper text: give it an `id` and reference it from the control or the group
  (`aria-describedby`).
- Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the radio group or on each checkbox / input; required:
  `aria-required="true"` on a radio group, `required` on an input. The asterisk is `aria-hidden`.
- Label and helper text colors meet AA (4.5:1) except disabled labels (inactive).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None. React `useFormControl()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Select composes FormControl + an InputLabel without changing this DOM:
- InputLabel = FormLabel (`label[data-ok-form-label][for]` + Select's own part attribute, such as
  `data-ok-input-label`, `data-ok-shrink`) inside the root; its float / shrink styles live in
  Select's CSS (`[data-ok-form-control]:has(> [data-ok-select])`).
- Select reads `useFormControl()` for `disabled`, `error`, `required`, `size`, `color`, `variant`,
  `fullWidth` and writes the resolved values on its own field box and trigger (as MUI's InputBase
  takes them from the context); the FormControl's attributes style the label and helper text.
- Focus and value: the root's CSS uses `:focus-within` / `:has()` on Select's parts in both
  frameworks (no React-only focus state, for parity): the hidden input's `:placeholder-shown`
  tells whether there is a value. No `data-ok-filled` and no context setters were needed.
- `hiddenLabel` (`data-ok-hidden-label`) arrived with Select's filled variant.
sections.title: Contract for Select (batch C; implemented, see select.md and ADR-0045)

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `FormControl`, `FormLabel`, `FormGroup`, `FormHelperText`, `useFormControl`.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| FormControl `children`, `component`, `color`, `disabled`, `error`, `focused`, `fullWidth`, `hiddenLabel`, `margin`, `required`, `size`, `variant` | same | kept | `color` default `default` (MUI `primary`); `hiddenLabel` since Select |
| FormControl `focused` / FormLabel / FormHelperText `filled` tracking | props | renamed | MUI tracks them from its InputBase; here they are props (Select uses CSS `:focus-within` / `:placeholder-shown`) |
| FormLabel `children`, `component`, `color`, `disabled`, `error`, `filled`, `focused`, `required` | same | kept | |
| FormGroup `children`, `row` | same | kept | |
| FormHelperText `children`, `component`, `disabled`, `error`, `filled`, `focused`, `margin`, `required`, `variant` | same | kept | |
| `useFormControl()` | same | kept | `undefined` outside a FormControl |
| context `disabled` / `required` / `error` read by Checkbox, Radio, Switch | — | not applicable | controls' API unchanged by decision; a `fieldset` root disables them natively |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:

sections.body:
A `<label>` around a control (Checkbox, Switch; Radio later) and its text: the text names the
control and clicking it toggles the control.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
label[data-ok-form-control-label][data-ok-label-placement][data-ok-required]?
  (control: span[data-ok-checkbox] | span[data-ok-switch])
  span[data-ok-form-control-label-text]
    …label
    span[data-ok-form-control-label-asterisk][aria-hidden="true"]?   (required)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `form-control-label`: listed under "options".)

React: `control` (element), `label` (node); `disabled`, `required`, `checked`, `onChange`,
`value` are cloned onto the control when set and the control doesn't set them (server-safe
`cloneElement`). Upstream `disableTypography`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`, `classes` don't apply.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Body2 text (`--ok-typography-body2-*`), `--ok-text-primary`; margin −11px on the control side
(`--ok-spacing` × −2.75) and 16px (× 4) on the other; `start` reverses the row, `top` / `bottom`
stack (margin 16px on both inline sides). Disabled (`:has(input:disabled)`): `--ok-text-disabled`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Inline-flex; text wraps (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`) instead of overflowing.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Native `<label>`: the text is the control's accessible name; clicking it toggles. The asterisk is
hidden from assistive technology (the input is `required`).
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body: None (the control's events).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `FormControlLabel`, mui.com/material-ui/api/form-control-label/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `control`, `label`, `labelPlacement` | same | kept | |
| `checked`, `disabled`, `required`, `onChange`, `value` | same | kept | cloned onto the control when it doesn't set them |
| `disableTypography`, `slotProps.typography` | — | not applicable | the text span carries body2 itself; any node is passed through |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

sections.body:
Show a project's tasks on a timeline: a task list (name, dates, duration, progress) and a timeline
with one bar per task in the same rows, the hierarchy of summary tasks, milestones and the
dependencies between tasks. One core layout (`renderGantt`) draws it for React and HTML.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-gantt][data-ok-view][data-ok-bar-label][data-ok-pixels-per-day]?[data-ok-row-height]?
   [data-ok-bar-margin]?[data-ok-tasks-container-width]?[data-ok-week-start]?
   [data-ok-show-today="false"]?[data-ok-show-non-working-days="false"]?[data-ok-column-lines="false"]?
   [data-ok-critical-path]?[data-ok-baseline]?[data-ok-project-boundary]?[data-ok-toolbar]?
   [data-ok-selection]?[data-ok-disable-tooltip]?
   [data-ok-columns]?[data-ok-today]?[data-ok-locale]?[data-ok-working-weekdays]?[data-ok-holidays]?
   [data-ok-ready]?                                    (set once drawn: hides the table)
  table[data-ok-gantt-data]                            (the tasks; the Gantt without JavaScript)
    caption                                            (the Gantt's name)
    thead › tr › th[scope=col][data-ok-gantt-field="name|startTime|endTime|progress|dependency|baselineStart|baselineEnd"]
    tbody › tr[data-ok-task-id][data-ok-parent-id]?[data-ok-type="milestone"]?[data-ok-color]?
             [data-ok-collapsed]?[data-ok-selected]?
      td[data-ok-value]?                               (ISO dates, progress numbers; else the text)
  div[data-ok-gantt-toolbar][role=toolbar][aria-label] (toolbar)
    button[type=button][data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-color=default][data-ok-size=sm][data-ok-gantt-zoom="out|in"][aria-label] › svg[aria-hidden]
  div[data-ok-gantt-viewport][tabindex=-1]             (scrolls both ways; not a tab stop: rows are)
    div[role=treegrid][data-ok-gantt-grid][aria-label][aria-rowcount][aria-colcount][aria-multiselectable]?
      div[role=rowgroup][data-ok-gantt-head] › div[role=row][aria-rowindex=1]
        div[role=columnheader][data-ok-gantt-column="<key>"][aria-colindex]   (task-list columns)
        div[role=columnheader][data-ok-gantt-column=timeline][aria-colindex]
          span[data-ok-gantt-visually-hidden] "Timeline"
          div[data-ok-gantt-scale][aria-hidden] › div[data-ok-gantt-tier="top|bottom"] › span[data-ok-gantt-tick]
      div[role=rowgroup][data-ok-gantt-body]
        svg[data-ok-gantt-canvas][aria-hidden][focusable=false][width][height][viewBox]
          path[data-ok-gantt-non-working]? path[data-ok-gantt-grid-lines]? path[data-ok-gantt-boundary]*
          path[data-ok-gantt-today]? g[data-ok-gantt-links]?
            › g[data-ok-gantt-link][data-ok-type][data-ok-critical]? › path[data-ok-gantt-link-line] + path[data-ok-gantt-link-head]
        div[role=row][data-ok-gantt-row][data-ok-task-id][data-ok-type="task|summary|milestone"][aria-rowindex]
           [aria-level][aria-posinset][aria-setsize][tabindex][aria-expanded]?[aria-selected]?
          div[role=gridcell][data-ok-gantt-cell=name][aria-colindex]
            span[data-ok-gantt-toggle|data-ok-gantt-toggle-space][aria-hidden] (› svg) + span[data-ok-gantt-name]
          div[role=gridcell][data-ok-gantt-cell="startTime|endTime|duration|progress"][aria-colindex]
          div[role=gridcell][data-ok-gantt-cell=timeline][aria-colindex]
            span[data-ok-gantt-baseline][aria-hidden]?
            div[data-ok-gantt-bar][data-ok-type][role=img][aria-label][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-critical]?
              (› span[data-ok-gantt-bar-text] with barLabel inside / auto)
            span[data-ok-gantt-label="right|left"][aria-hidden]?
  div[data-ok-gantt-tooltip][aria-hidden=true][hidden]?[data-ok-placement]?
    div[data-ok-gantt-tooltip-title] + div[data-ok-gantt-tooltip-row] › span + span
```
Private properties (from core, React `style`, HTML CSSOM): `--_ok-gantt-columns`, `-name`, `-list`,
`-timeline`, `-row`, `-bar-margin` on the grid; `--_ok-gantt-left` (sticky offset) and
`--_ok-gantt-indent` on list cells; `--_ok-gantt-x`, `-w`, `-progress` on bars, labels, baselines
and ticks; `--_ok-gantt-tooltip-x|y` on the tooltip (controller).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `gantt`: listed under "options".)

Outside the schema (root text attributes ↔ React props):

| HTML | React | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-ok-columns` | `columns` | `name startTime duration progress` | task-list columns, from `name`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `duration`, `progress` (name always first) |
| `data-ok-today` | `today` | the current day | ISO date of the today line |
| `data-ok-locale` | `locale` | `en-US` | BCP 47 tag of dates |
| `data-ok-working-weekdays` | `workingWeekdays` | `1 2 3 4 5` | 0 = Sunday |
| `data-ok-holidays` | `holidays` | — | ISO dates |
| table `caption` (else `aria-label`) | `label` | — | accessible name |
| table rows | `tasks` | — | `GanttTask[]`: `id`, `name`, `startTime`, `endTime` (ISO, last day included), `progress` 0–100, `type` (`milestone`), `parentId`, `dependency` (id, `{ taskId, type, lag }` or a list; HTML text `id[:FS|SS|FF|SF[±lag]]`, comma separated), `color` (palette), `collapsed`, `baseline` `{ start, end }` |
| `setLocaleText()` | `localeText` | English | texts and column titles |

Upstream mapping (ApexGantt → Owlky): `series` → `tasks` (`startTime`, `endTime`, `progress`,
`type`, `parentId`, `dependency`, `collapsed`, `baseline` kept; `barBackgroundColor` → `color`, a
palette name), `pixelsPerDay`, `rowHeight`, `barMargin`, `tasksContainerWidth`, `barLabel.position`
→ `barLabel`, `columnLines`, `enableCriticalPath` → `criticalPath`, `baseline.enabled` →
`baseline`, `enableProjectBoundary` → `projectBoundary`, `enableSelection` → `selection`,
`enableTooltip` → `disableTooltip` (MUI-style negative flag), `calendar.workingWeekdays` /
`holidays` / `weekStart` / `showNonWorkingStripes` → `workingWeekdays` / `holidays` / `weekStart` /
`showNonWorkingDays`, `columnConfig[].key` → `columns`, `locale.tag` → `locale`,
`locale.messages` → `localeText`, `zoomIn()` / `zoomOut()` / `scrollToTask()` kept (HTML instance).
Not applicable: colors and fonts as options (tokens and palettes), `canvasStyle`, `theme`,
`tooltipTemplate` / `barLabel.render` (HTML strings), `persistState` (no storage, ADR-0007),
`inputDateFormat` (ISO dates). Phase 2 adds `editable` (`enableTaskDrag` / `enableTaskResize` / `enableProgressDrag` → `taskDrag`, `taskResize`, `progressDrag` behaviors), `onTaskChange` (upstream `taskUpdate` events) and `onTaskEdit` (upstream `enableTaskEdit` dialog, the form is yours), `updateTask()` (HTML). Phase 3 adds `height` (upstream `height`; bounds the scroll area and virtualizes rows), `disableVirtualization`, `exportFormat` (kept) / `disableExport` (upstream `enableExport`) and `exportChart(format)` (kept; HTML instance, core `exportGantt(root, layout, format)`). Deferred (roadmap): the rest below
(phase 3), sorting and filtering, grouping, custom column renderers, inline editing, CRUD toolbar,
context menu, undo / redo, split tasks, rollups, annotations, crosshair, draw tasks and links,
critical path in working days, right to left, sub-day scales.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`aria-expanded` on parent rows (`data-ok-collapsed` on their table rows), `aria-selected` with
`selection` (`data-ok-selected`), the roving `tabindex="0"` on the active row, `data-ok-ready`,
the zoom in `data-ok-pixels-per-day`.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- **Dates:** ISO days as UTC day numbers; the end day is included; a task without `endTime` (and
  without children) is a milestone at `startTime`. Parents become summary tasks: their dates span
  their children, their progress is the duration-weighted mean of their leaf tasks.
- **Scale:** `view` presets the zoom (`day` 36, `week` 16, `month` 5, `quarter` 1.6, `year` 0.5 px
  per day); `pixelsPerDay` overrides it. Two header tiers from the zoom: month / day (≥ 24),
  month / week (≥ 8), year / month (≥ 2.5), year / quarter (≥ 0.9), year / half. The range starts
  one bottom unit before the first task and ends one after the last. Zoom buttons multiply or
  divide by 1.4 (0.25–120).
- **Background:** non-working days shaded from 8 px per day, column lines at bottom-tier units,
  row lines, a today line, dashed project boundary lines, dependency arrows (orthogonal, rounded
  corners, an arrow head; critical links in the error color).
- **Critical path:** a backward pass from the project's end over the dependencies (calendar days),
  tasks and milestones with no total float, links with no slack.
- **Labels:** `right` (default), `left`, `inside` (clipped), `auto` (inside when the estimated
  width fits). Milestones are always labeled outside; summaries have no bar label.
- **Controller** (`createGanttController`, both implementations): row focus (roving tab stop, a
  row focused another way becomes active), expand / collapse, selection, zoom buttons, tooltip.
  It reports intent; React keeps state in props / state, the HTML runtime in the table and the
  root, after a cancelable event.
- **Responsive:** one scroll container; the header and the task list are sticky. Below 600px of
  the Gantt's own width (container query) only the name column shows, at most 40% of the width.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | into the grid (the active row), then out of it |
| ↓ / ↑ | next / previous row |
| Page Down / Page Up | 10 rows down / up |
| Home / End | first / last row |
| → | expands a collapsed parent; on an expanded parent, moves to its first child |
| ← | collapses an expanded parent; otherwise moves to the parent |
| Enter | toggles a parent |
| Space | toggles the row's selection (`selection`); Shift + Space selects the range |
| Shift + ↓ / ↑ / Page / Home / End | extends the selection (`selection`) |
| Ctrl / Cmd + A | selects every row (`selection`) |
| Escape | hides the tooltip (wherever the focus is); cancels a drag |
| Enter (editable task row) | starts the edit mode: ← / → move a day, Shift + ← / → change the end, Page Up / Page Down ±10 % progress, Enter saves, Escape (or Tab) cancels; other arrows stay in the mode |
| F2 (editable task row) | asks for the owner's edit form (`onTaskEdit`, `ok:gantt:edit`) |

Pointer: a click focuses a row and selects it (Ctrl / Cmd toggles, Shift selects the range); the
chevron toggles a parent; hovering a bar shows the tooltip, which stays while hovered.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- `role=treegrid` named by `label` (the table caption in HTML), `aria-rowcount` / `aria-colcount`,
  rows with `aria-level`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected`.
- Each bar is `role=img` named with the task, its dates, progress, planned dates (baseline), the
  critical path and its predecessors with the dependency type and lag. Labels, the scale and the
  SVG are `aria-hidden` (the header names the timeline column "Timeline").
- The tooltip repeats the row's data (`aria-hidden`), shows on keyboard focus too, stays while
  hovered and closes with Escape (WCAG 1.4.13).
- Color is never the only cue: critical tasks and links are also named; milestones are diamonds.
- Text uses neutral tones (AA); bars are graphics (palette fills, 3:1 against the paper).

Editing (`editable`, phase 2): editable task bars carry `span[data-ok-gantt-handle="start|end|progress"]`
(aria-hidden), rows `aria-keyshortcuts="Enter F2"`; drag the bar (move), an edge (resize, at least a
day) or the progress handle (whole percents); 3 px before a drag starts; the preview is CSSOM on the
bar (`data-ok-dragging`), undone before the change is reported, so the owner's render decides.
Milestones move only; summaries never edit. Touch: `touch-action: none` on editable bars. Double
click / double tap / F2 → `onTaskEdit` (the single-pointer path, WCAG 2.5.7). The edit mode
announces its keys and each draft in `div[data-ok-gantt-status][role=status]` (last child of the
root). Right to left mirrors the arrows and drags.

Virtualization (phase 3, `height`): the viewport gets `--_ok-gantt-height` (max height); the body
keeps every row's height (`--_ok-gantt-body`) and pads the rows above the window
(`--_ok-gantt-offset`); `ganttRowWindow` picks the rows in view plus 8 on each side from the scroll
position (the `height` before measuring, so server, React and HTML render the same first window).
Rows keep their `aria-rowindex`; the keyboard walks the full list (`rowList`) and the owner renders
the window around the row it moves to; the tab stop falls back to the window's first row while the
active row is scrolled away. Every link is drawn. Export (phase 3): a toolbar button
`button[data-ok-gantt-export="svg|png|csv"]` (aria-label "Download SVG"…); the SVG file is built
with DOM methods from the layout of every row (no window) with colors read from computed styles;
PNG draws it on a canvas; CSV is the data table (formulas neutralized). Downloads need a user
gesture.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML events: `ok:gantt:taskchange` (cancelable; `{ id, change: { startTime, endTime?, progress? }, source:
"drag" | "resize" | "progress" | "keyboard" }`; then the runtime writes the table row), `ok:gantt:edit`
(`{ id }`), `ok:gantt:toggle` (cancelable; `{ id, expanded, collapsed }`),
`ok:gantt:selectionchange` (cancelable; `{ selected, mode }`), `ok:gantt:zoom` (cancelable;
`{ pixelsPerDay }`). Instance (`runtime.get(el, "gantt")`): `tasks`, `collapsed`,
`setCollapsed(ids)`, `selected`, `setSelected(ids)`, `pixelsPerDay`, `zoomIn()`, `zoomOut()`,
`scrollToTask(id)`, `setLocaleText(text)`, `refresh()`.
React: `onCollapsedChange(ids)`, `onSelectionChange(ids, mode)`, `onZoomChange(pixelsPerDay)`;
controlled `collapsed`, `selected`, `pixelsPerDay` with `default…` counterparts.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
React renders the same table and treegrid the runtime builds (one core node tree); the SVG and the
private properties are compared by `e2e/tests/gantt.spec.ts` (parity doesn't walk into SVG or
`style`). The tooltip's content is written by the controller in both.

import { Gantt, type GanttTask } from "@owlky/react";

const tasks: GanttTask[] = [
  {"id":"discovery","name":"Discovery"},
  {"id":"research","name":"User research","parentId":"discovery","startTime":"2025-03-03","endTime":"2025-03-07","progress":100},
  {"id":"audit","name":"Content audit","parentId":"discovery","startTime":"2025-03-05","endTime":"2025-03-11","progress":80,"dependency":{"taskId":"research","type":"SS","lag":2}},
  {"id":"brief","name":"Brief approved","parentId":"discovery","startTime":"2025-03-12","type":"milestone","dependency":"audit"},
  {"id":"design","name":"Design"},
  {"id":"wireframes","name":"Wireframes","parentId":"design","startTime":"2025-03-13","endTime":"2025-03-20","progress":60,"dependency":"brief"},
  {"id":"visual","name":"Visual design","parentId":"design","startTime":"2025-03-21","endTime":"2025-04-01","progress":25,"dependency":"wireframes"},
  {"id":"review","name":"Design review","parentId":"design","startTime":"2025-04-02","type":"milestone","dependency":"visual"},
  {"id":"build","name":"Build"},
  {"id":"backend","name":"Back end","parentId":"build","startTime":"2025-03-24","endTime":"2025-04-16","progress":10,"dependency":"wireframes"},
  {"id":"frontend","name":"Front end","parentId":"build","startTime":"2025-04-03","endTime":"2025-04-22","dependency":"review"},
  {"id":"testing","name":"Testing","parentId":"build","startTime":"2025-04-17","endTime":"2025-04-25","dependency":[{"taskId":"frontend","type":"FF","lag":3},"backend"]},
  {"id":"launch","name":"Launch","startTime":"2025-04-28","type":"milestone","dependency":"testing"},
];

export function TimelineViewsGantt() {

        tasks={tasks}
        today="2025-03-18"
        label="Website relaunch, year view"
        view="year"
      />
    </>
  );
}

sections.body: An action shown only as an icon (toolbar, card actions). For text actions use Button.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
(button[type="button"] | a[href])[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-animate]?[aria-label]
  svg[aria-hidden="true"]            (any decorative SVG or img)
  span[data-ok-icon-button-loader][aria-hidden="true"]   only while loading (data-ok-loading)
    span[data-ok-circular-progress][data-ok-color="inherit"][data-ok-button-spinner]   default loader: a CircularProgress (React: `loadingIndicator` replaces it)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `icon-button`: listed under "options".)

Also required: an accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).

`default` = secondary text color, `inherit` = primary text color, palette colors = `main`.
Unknown values fall back to the defaults (`iconButtonAttributes()` and CSS).

React only: `loadingIndicator?: ReactNode` (default: the spinner) replaces the loader while
`loading`; in HTML, put your own loader inside `[data-ok-icon-button-loader]`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`:hover` (hover-capable devices: background `channel` 8 %, `--ok-action-hover` for default /
inherit), `:focus-visible` (2px outline), `:disabled` (`--ok-action-disabled`), `:active` (animate).
sections.title: States

sections.body:
Native `<button>`, or `<a href>` for an icon link — CSS only, no runtime. Circular (`--ok-radius-full`), transparent background.
`data-ok-animate` transitions `transform`; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the scale.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native: `Enter` / `Space` activate.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Name from `aria-label` (or `aria-labelledby`); the icon is `aria-hidden`. Every size is
≥ 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLButtonElement`) and every native button prop.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same size at every breakpoint.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `IconButton` (+ `ButtonBase`), mui.com/material-ui/api/icon-button/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children`, `color`, `edge`, `disabled`, `loading`, `loadingIndicator` | same | kept | `color` + `black` / `white`; `edge` `false` = absent |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`) | renamed | |
| `type` (ButtonBase) | native `type` | kept | |
| `href`, `component`, `LinkComponent` (ButtonBase) | same | kept | 4.18.22: `href` renders an `<a data-ok-icon-button>` (an icon link; disabled / loading: no `href`, `role=link`, `aria-disabled`); `component` / `LinkComponent` as on Button (router links) |
| `action`, `focusVisibleClassName`, `onFocusVisible`, `nativeButton` (ButtonBase) | `ref.focus()`, `:focus-visible` | not applicable | |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (+ ButtonBase ripple props) | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

Beyond MUI: `animate` (reference).
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Visible focus outline (the reference has none). The reference's "With animate" uses an
animation library; here it is plain CSS.

sections.body:
A theme-aware illustration set. Each illustration is data (a tree of SVG nodes) whose shapes name
a tone instead of a color; the stylesheet maps tones to `--ok-*` tokens, so pictures follow the
color scheme, nested themes, `data-ok-preset` and the `color` option. One export per picture in
the opt-in entry `@owlky/core/illustrations` (tree-shaken). Components that show decorative art
compose it (Upload's drop zone).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
Every scene follows `docs/illustrations-style.md` (canvas, composition, tones, strokes, people,
detail) and composes the parts of `@owlky/core/illustrations` (`backdrop`, `groundShadow`,
`sparkle`, `dot`, `cloud`, `plant`, `lines`, `paper`, `screen`, `person`;
`core/src/illustrations/parts.ts`). Parts set `part` on their first node (data only, never
rendered); `core/src/illustrations/style.test.ts` enforces the guide. New pictures: `/illustration`.
sections.title: Style

sections.body:
```
svg[data-ok-illustration="<name>"][data-ok-color][data-ok-size]?[viewBox][focusable="false"]
   [aria-hidden="true"] | [role="img"][aria-label | aria-labelledby]
  title?                                   (React `title`)
  (g[transform]? › …) | path | circle | ellipse | rect | polygon | polyline | line
    [data-ok-tone="<tone>"][data-ok-stroke][stroke-width]?  geometry attributes only
```
- Elements: `g path circle ellipse rect polygon polyline line` (`illustrationTags`); attributes:
  geometry, `transform`, `opacity`, `fill-rule`, `stroke-dasharray` (`illustrationAttributeNames`).
  Never `href`, `use`, `image`, `foreignObject`, `script`, `style`, ids or colors.
- Every shape has a tone; groups never do. `data-ok-stroke` paints the tone as the outline
  (`stroke-width` from the data), with round caps and joins.
- Tones (`illustrationTones`): brand `lighter light main dark darker` (the `color` palette),
  accent `accent-light accent-main accent-dark` (warning palette), scheme-aware `paper neutral
  outline line shadow shade ink`, fixed `grey-300 grey-500 grey-600 white`, skin `skin-light
  skin-medium skin-deep` (`--ok-illustration-skin-*` tokens).
- Scenes use `viewBox="0 0 480 360"`; shapes (`avatar-shape`) their own.
- React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and the private `--_ok-illustration-size` in `style`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `illustration`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `illustration` (required: the data, an export of `@owlky/core/illustrations` or your
own `Illustration` object), `title` (accessible name: `role="img"`, `aria-label` and a `<title>`),
`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` (also make it `role="img"`), `ref`, `className`, `style` and other
SVG attributes (go to the `svg`). HTML: a `width` attribute sizes the picture without the runtime.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`display: block`, `max-width: 100%`, `height: auto` (the viewBox keeps the ratio). Width: the
`width` attribute, else `--_ok-illustration-size` (size option), else 480px
(`calc(var(--ok-spacing) * 120)`). Brand tones read `--_ok-illustration-<shade>` declared on the
root from `--ok-palette-<color>-<shade>`, so a root inside a `[data-ok-preset]` / `[data-ok-theme]`
scope takes that scope's values. `ink` is `light-dark(grey 800, grey 600)` inside
`@supports (color: light-dark(#000, #fff))` (grey 800 otherwise). Translucent tones use
`rgb(var(--…-channel) / α)`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: renders the tree as elements (attribute names camelCased); invalid nodes / attributes /
  tones are dropped (`illustrationNodeAttributes`, `illustrationChildren`).
- HTML snippets: the full inline SVG (generated from React,
  `node apps/storybook/scripts/illustration-snippets.mjs`); CSS only, no JavaScript.
- HTML runtime (opt-in: `owlky-illustrations.js`, `@owlky/html/illustrations`, or
  `createIllustration([…])`): on `svg[data-ok-illustration]` without artwork, builds the named
  picture with `createElementNS` and sets `viewBox`; artwork already there (snippets, custom art)
  stays. Writes `aria-hidden="true"` unless the author named it (then `role="img"`), and
  `focusable="false"`. Turns `data-ok-size` into `--_ok-illustration-size` (CSSOM) and follows
  changes of `data-ok-size` and of the name (redrawing what it drew). Unknown names: nothing drawn.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: None: illustrations never take focus.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Decorative by default (`aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`). Meaningful pictures get a name
(`title` / `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` → `role="img"`). No text inside the art. Decorative
art has no contrast requirement (axe passes in light and dark).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML instance: `runtime.get(svg, "illustration").illustration` (the data drawn, or `undefined`).
Core: `illustrationAttributes(name, options)`, `illustrationNodeAttributes(node)`,
`illustrationChildren(nodes)`, `illustrationStyle(size)`, `illustrationAria(named, title?)`.
`@owlky/core/illustrations`: the pictures, `illustrations`, the parts (pure functions returning
nodes; numbers and tones only) and `illustrationParts` (the `part` names).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: No upstream: the set is original artwork and API (ADR-0041); nothing to map.
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Snippets carry the shapes; the runtime draws the same markup for named placeholders (tested).
`style` is ignored by parity (React's private size property; the runtime's CSSOM).
sections.title: Parity notes

components.summary: A theme-aware illustration set. Each illustration is data (a tree of SVG nodes) whose shapes name a tone instead of a color; the stylesheet maps tones to `--ok-*` tokens, so pictures follow the color scheme, nested themes, `data-ok-preset` and the `color` option. One export per picture in the opt-in entry `@owlky/core/illustrations` (tree-shaken). Components that show decorative art compose it (Upload's drop zone).

sections.body: A picture that loads lazily behind a placeholder and appears with an effect, cropped to an aspect ratio, with an optional overlay. Native first: a plain `` with `loading="lazy"`.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-image][data-ok-fit][data-ok-position][data-ok-effect][data-ok-ratio]?[data-ok-overlay]?[data-ok-overlay-from]?[data-ok-disable-placeholder]?[data-ok-visible-by-default]?[data-ok-state]?
  span[data-ok-image-placeholder][aria-hidden="true"]   (› img[alt=""] preview | custom content)?
  span[data-ok-image-overlay][aria-hidden="true"]?      (with `overlay`)
  img[src][alt][loading][decoding][srcset]?[sizes]?[width]?[height]?[fetchpriority]?
  svg[data-ok-image-icon][aria-hidden="true"]?          (after an error: React renders it, the HTML runtime builds it)
```
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and the placeholder span always (CSS hides it with
`disablePlaceholder` / `visibleByDefault`). `data-ok-state` is written by the owner only, never
in snippets.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `image`: listed under "options".)

Other props (go to the `img`): `src`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `alt` (required; `""` = decorative),
`width`, `height`, `loading` (`lazy` default; `eager` with `visibleByDefault`), `decoding`
(`async` default), `fetchPriority`, `crossOrigin`, `referrerPolicy`, `imgProps`, `imgRef` (`ref`
is the root). `placeholderSrc` (a preview in the placeholder, blurred), `placeholder` (custom
content), `onLoad(event)`, `onError(event)`. Root `className` / `style` / other attributes go to
the `span`.

API mapping (Minimals `Image` / react-lazy-load-image-component): kept `ratio`,
`disablePlaceholder`, `visibleByDefault`, `effect` (+ `none`), `placeholderSrc`, `placeholder`,
`onLoad` (upstream `afterLoad`), `src`, `alt`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `width`, `height`;
`slotProps.img` → `imgProps`; `slotProps.overlay` → `overlay` / `overlayFrom` (allowlists);
`slotProps.placeholder` → `placeholder`. Not applicable (native `loading="lazy"`, ADR-0038):
`threshold`, `delayTime`, `delayMethod`, `scrollPosition`, `useIntersectionObserver`,
`beforeLoad`, `wrapperClassName`, `wrapperProps`, `sx`. Beyond the reference: `fit`, `position`,
`onError` + the error state, `decoding`, `fetchPriority` (native image features).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root `display: block`, `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden`, `max-width: 100%`. The `img`
fills the root (`width` / `height` 100%, `object-fit` / `object-position` from `fit` /
`position`); with `ratio` the root takes `aspect-ratio` and the `img` is absolute. Without
`ratio` the picture keeps its own ratio (`width` / `height` attributes reserve it).
Placeholder: radial gradient, transparent white center → `grey-500 / 0.48` (the reference's SVG).
Overlay: `dark` = `grey-900 / 0.48`; a color = `linear-gradient(transparent, <main> / 0.8)`; with
`overlayFrom`: `linear-gradient(to top, <from main> / 0.24, <main> / 0.8)`. Error icon: 40% of
the box, at most 48px, `text-disabled`. Effects: `opacity` `--ok-duration-shortest`, `filter`
`--ok-duration-standard`, `--ok-easing-standard`; `blur(12px)` / `grayscale(1)` while loading.
Corners are the consumer's (stories: `--ok-radius-xl`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- No `data-ok-state` (no JavaScript, snippets): the picture shows; placeholder transparent.
- `loading`: picture `opacity: 0` (+ the effect's filter), placeholder visible.
- `loaded`: picture visible (transition), placeholder fades out.
- `error`: picture `opacity: 0` (keeps its `alt` in the accessibility tree), placeholder visible,
  icon shown.
- `visibleByDefault`: no placeholder, no effect, `loading="eager"`.
- `@media (scripting: none)`: the picture always shows (React's server markup says `loading`).
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no transitions.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
React: state `loading` until the `img` fires `load` / `error`; after mount (hydration) it reads
`complete` / `naturalWidth` (core `imageLoadState`) for pictures that settled before React. A new
`src` / `srcSet` starts at `loading` again. HTML runtime `image`: the same from `complete` at
setup, `load` / `error` listeners on the `img`, and a MutationObserver on `src` / `srcset` /
`sizes`. Lazy loading is the browser's (`loading="lazy"`).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
The root is fluid (its container's width, `max-width: 100%`); a ratio keeps the shape at every
width. Stories: grids of 2 columns below 600px, 3 from 600px, 4 from 900px.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Not focusable. Put it in an `a` / `button` to make it interactive (the `span` root is phrasing
content).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`alt` required (React type); decorative pictures use `alt=""`. Placeholder, overlay and icon are
`aria-hidden`. A broken picture stays in the tree with its `alt`. Overlays help white text on
pictures reach AA (docs).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:image:load` (`detail.src` = `currentSrc`), `ok:image:error` (`detail.src`); instance
`runtime.get(el, "image")` → `{ state }`. React: `onLoad(event)`, `onError(event)` (and
`imgProps.onLoad` / `onError`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: Minimals `Image` on react-lazy-load-image-component `LazyLoadImage`
(github.com/Aljullu/react-lazy-load-image-component README, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src`, `srcSet`, `sizes`, `alt`, `width`, `height`, other image attributes | same (on the `img`) | kept | `imgProps` for the rest |
| `effect` (`blur`, `opacity`, `black-and-white`) | `effect` (+ `none`) | kept | |
| `placeholderSrc`, `placeholder` | same | kept | |
| `visibleByDefault` | same | kept | `loading="eager"` |
| `onLoad`, `afterLoad` (deprecated) | `onLoad(event)` · `ok:image:load` | kept | + `onError` / `ok:image:error` |
| `threshold`, `delayMethod`, `delayTime`, `useIntersectionObserver`, `beforeLoad`, `scrollPosition`, `trackWindowScroll` | — | not applicable | native `loading="lazy"` (ADR-0038) |
| `wrapperClassName`, `wrapperProps` | root `className` / attributes | renamed | the root `span` is the wrapper |
| `LazyLoadComponent` | — | not applicable | lazy non-image content is app code (`content-visibility`) |
| Minimals `ratio`, `disablePlaceholder` | same | kept | |
| Minimals `slotProps.img` / `.overlay` / `.placeholder` | `imgProps`, `overlay` / `overlayFrom`, `placeholder` | renamed | allowlists for overlays |
| Minimals `sx` | — | not applicable | by decision |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
HTML authors may leave the placeholder span out (no placeholder). React always renders it. Both
write `data-ok-state`; parity compares settled pictures.
sections.title: Parity notes

Height 24px, min width 24px, padding 0 6px, gap 6px, `--ok-radius-sm`, 12px bold. Soft (default):

an inactive status).

the reference (ADR-0014).
