MotionBorder:
(Options of `motion-border`: listed under "options".)

Content: `children` (MotionText: a string), CountUp `prefix` / `suffix`. API mapping (Framer
Motion): variants → `variant` (the reference's 48 entrance / exit names, its background and its
other effects); `whileInView` + `viewport.once` / `amount` → `trigger="inView"`, `once`, `amount`;
`animate` / `exit` / `AnimatePresence` → `trigger="manual"` + `in` (exits play the entrance
backwards); `transition.duration` / `delay` → `duration`, `delay`; `staggerChildren` → MotionGroup /
MotionText `stagger`; `whileHover` / `whileTap` → `variant="interactive"`; `pathLength` → `draw`.
MotionBorder (the reference's own animated border): `slotProps.primaryBorder` → `color`, `width`;
`slotProps.secondaryBorder` → `secondaryColor` (the two lights share one ring); per-side `padding` /
per-corner radius → the root's CSS `border-width` / `border-radius` (zero specificity, so author
rules win). Beyond the reference: `paused` (WCAG 2.2.2). `viewport.margin` / `viewport.root` →
`viewportMargin` / `viewportRoot` (HTML `data-ok-viewport-margin`, `data-ok-viewport-root="<id>"`;
free text, so not in the option schemas: React writes the margin attribute, a ref root has none),
`onViewportEnter` / `onViewportLeave` → `ok:motion:enter` / `leave` (also `ok:motion-group:*`,
`ok:motion-text:*`), `component` (Motion, MotionGroup, MotionText; HTML: any element). Deferred:
CountUp `component` / viewport options / viewport events (not in the row), spring physics, custom keyframes, layout animations, scroll-linked progress (Scroll
progress page), exit of a Dialog, the reference's logo rings (shape-morphing,
custom keyframes: Motion full version, phase 1). Not applicable: `motion.*` element factories, `useAnimate`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Entrances: `--ok-duration-enter` (640ms), exits `--ok-duration-exit` (480ms),
`--ok-easing-expressive`. Distances: 160px (`--ok-spacing` × 40) slides, 120px fades, 360px
directional zoom / bounce. Loops: `--ok-duration-enter` × 8 (≈ 5 s). Draw: × 3. Interactive:
scale 1.09 on hover, 0.97 pressed, `--ok-duration-shorter`. Color change: a gradient of primary,
warning, secondary and error `main`, 2–5 times the text width (the element shrinks to its content).
MotionBorder: 2px, `--ok-radius-lg` (circle: 50%), three layers: the fill on the padding box
(`--ok-bg-paper`, `--_ok-motion-border-fill`), a conic gradient on the border box (multi: the same
four colors all around; `inherit` / a palette color: a light about 90° long, symmetric; with
`secondaryColor`: a second light 180° away) and a faint track under it (135°, first light's channel
at 8% → second light's at 24%; `inherit` and `multi` use `--ok-palette-grey-500-channel`). CountUp: tabular figures, ease-out cubic, 2000ms.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
`initial` holds in-variants at their start (paused animation) and out-variants as themselves;
`enter` plays; `exit` plays the other way (other keyframe name, so it restarts). An entered
in-variant drops the animation at its end (`animation-fill-mode: backwards`): no transform is left.
`inView` (IntersectionObserver; none → shown at once): plays when `amount` is visible; `once=false`
exits when it leaves. `viewportMargin` is the observer's `rootMargin` (invalid → none),
`viewportRoot` its `root` (HTML: the element with that id; unknown → the browser viewport). Both
are read when the trigger starts. Viewport events: enter once per crossing into view (the
`amount` visible), leave when nothing is visible after an entrance; with `once`, the first
entrance only. Only the element that owns the trigger reports (a Motion in a group doesn't);
`mount` and `manual` triggers don't observe, so they report nothing. `mount`: at once. `manual`: follows `in` / `data-ok-in`. Changing `variant`,
`duration` or `distance` replays an entered Motion (React too). MotionGroup drives every Motion
whose closest group it is. Loops run while entered, `paused` stops them. Reduced motion: entrances
and exits take 1ms, loops and the border don't run, interactive doesn't transition, CountUp shows
the end at once.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Not interactive. Content inside keeps its own keyboard behavior.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Content never depends on the animation (no JavaScript → shown; reduced motion → shown at once).
MotionText and CountUp hide the moving copy (`aria-hidden`) and expose a visually hidden label with
the whole text / end value. Loops need a pause control (WCAG 2.2.2): `paused`. Directional
entrances start outside the box: clip containers that could widen the page.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:motion:end` (`{ state }`) on a Motion; `ok:motion:enter` / `ok:motion:leave`
(`{ ratio }`: the visible fraction), also `ok:motion-group:enter|leave` and
`ok:motion-text:enter|leave`. Instances: motion / motion-group / motion-text
`{ state, replay() }`, count-up `{ replay() }`, motion-border `{}` (width and duration only).
React: native `onAnimationEnd`, `onViewportEnter(entry)` / `onViewportLeave(entry)`
(`IntersectionObserverEntry`, as Motion for React); change the `key` to replay.
Core: `createMotionTrigger` options `margin`, `root`, `onViewport(inView, entry)`;
`readMotionViewport(element)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Nothing changes per breakpoint. Stories clip their stages (`overflow: clip`).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: Framer Motion / Motion for React `motion` component props (motion.dev/docs/react-motion-component,
checked 2026-11-09), as used by the Minimals Animate page. CountUp and MotionBorder are the
reference's own components (rows in the paragraph above).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variants` + `initial` / `animate` / `exit` (named variants) | `variant` (the reference's names) | renamed | CSS keyframes |
| `animate` / `exit` / `AnimatePresence` | `trigger="manual"` + `in` | renamed | exit = entrance backwards |
| `whileInView`, `viewport.once`, `viewport.amount` | `trigger="inView"`, `once`, `amount` | renamed | |
| `viewport.margin`, `viewport.root` | `viewportMargin`, `viewportRoot` · `data-ok-viewport-margin`, `data-ok-viewport-root="<id>"` | renamed | IntersectionObserver `rootMargin` / `root`; React root is a ref, HTML an id |
| `transition.duration`, `.delay`, `staggerChildren` | `duration`, `delay`, MotionGroup / MotionText `stagger` | renamed | |
| `transition` springs, easing, custom keyframes (`animate` objects), `style` motion values, `transformTemplate` | — | deferred (5.1) | |
| `onAnimationStart`, `onAnimationComplete` | `ok:motion:end` / native `onAnimationEnd` | renamed | start event deferred with 5.1 |
| `onUpdate` | — | deferred (5.1) | |
| `onViewportEnter`, `onViewportLeave` | same (`IntersectionObserverEntry`) · `ok:motion:enter` / `leave` (`{ ratio }`) | kept | in-view trigger only; group and text roots too |
| `whileHover`, `whileTap` | `variant="interactive"` | renamed | springs, `onHoverStart` / `End`, `onTap*`, `tap`: deferred (5.3) |
| `whileFocus` | — | deferred (5.3) | |
| `drag*`, `whileDrag`, `dragControls`, `onDrag*`, `onDirectionLock`, `onPan*`, `pinch`, `whilePinch`, `propagate` | — | deferred (5.3) | |
| `layout`, `layoutId`, `layoutDependency`, `layoutAnchor`, `layoutScroll`, `layoutRoot`, `onLayoutAnimation*` | — | deferred (5.4) | shared elements 5.5 |
| `useScroll` (scroll progress) | — | deferred (5.2) | |
| `inherit`, `custom` | MotionGroup sets the children's timing | renamed | dynamic variants not applicable (named CSS variants) |
| `motion.*` element factories / `component` | `component` (Motion, MotionGroup, MotionText) · HTML: any element | renamed | factories not applicable; inline elements need `display: inline-block` for transforms |
| `useAnimate`, `animate()` | — | deferred (5.1) | core `animate(element, keyframes, options)` |
| — | `paused`, MotionBorder, CountUp, background and path variants | kept | Owlky / reference additions |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` and writes `data-ok-state` itself (SSR: `initial`); snippets
carry no state (the runtime writes it). React 19's `<link rel="preload">` hints next to images are
skipped by parity. Private properties go through `style` (ignored by parity).

sections.body:
A hierarchy (people of a company, parts of a product) as a tree of nodes joined by connector
lines, top-down by default or grown from another side (`direction`, ADR-0052). Node content is free (cards in the stories). CSS only; a small runtime turns the
length options into private custom properties in HTML. Opt-in (`enableExpandCollapse`): branches
collapse and expand with a toggle button, their children list is a Collapse, children can load on
demand. Opt-in (`highlightOnHover`): hovering or focusing a node highlights its path to the root
and fades the others; `highlightNode(id)` highlights a node found by a search (an Autocomplete
composed next to the chart) without fading.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ul[data-ok-organization-chart][data-ok-direction]?[data-ok-line-color][data-ok-line-style]
  [data-ok-line-height]? [data-ok-line-width]? [data-ok-line-border-radius]? [data-ok-node-padding]?
  [data-ok-enable-expand-collapse]? [data-ok-expand-collapse-on-node-click]?
  [data-ok-collapse-badge-threshold]? [data-ok-highlight-on-hover]? [data-ok-dim-opacity]?
  [aria-label | aria-labelledby]
  li[data-ok-organization-chart-node][data-ok-node-id]?[data-ok-highlighted]?
                                                          (the root node: React `label`)
    div[data-ok-organization-chart-label]                 (any content)
    button[data-ok-organization-chart-toggle][type=button][aria-expanded][aria-controls]
          [aria-busy]?                                    (collapsible charts, branches only)
      span[data-ok-organization-chart-toggle-label]       (the name, visually hidden)
      svg[data-ok-organization-chart-toggle-icon]         (chevron, aria-hidden)
      span[data-ok-circular-progress][data-ok-organization-chart-spinner][aria-hidden]?
                                                          (lazy nodes: a CircularProgress)
      span[data-ok-organization-chart-badge]?             (hidden count, written by the script)
    ul[data-ok-organization-chart-children][data-ok-collapse]?[id]?[hidden]?
                                                          (only when there are children, or
                                                           empty + hidden on a lazy node)
      li[data-ok-organization-chart-node]                 (OrganizationChartNode, any depth)
        div[data-ok-organization-chart-label]
        ul[data-ok-organization-chart-children]?
```
Wide charts scroll by composition: `Scrollbar › OrganizationChart` (stories, docs). Search by
composition: `Autocomplete` (options = node ids and names) + a `role="status"` line next to the
chart; the app calls `highlightNode(value)` on change (stories "Highlight and search", docs).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `organization-chart`: listed under "options".)

Content: `label` (ReactNode) on `OrganizationChart` and `OrganizationChartNode`; `children`
(`OrganizationChartNode` elements). Rest props go to the root `ul` (chart) or the `li` (node);
`style` is merged after the length properties.

Expand and collapse (React, ADR-0051): `enableExpandCollapse` (default `false`),
`expandCollapseOnNodeClick`, `collapseBadgeEnabled` (default `true`; HTML: leave the badge span
out), `collapseBadgeThreshold` (default 1), `collapsedNodes` / `defaultCollapsedNodes` /
`onCollapsedNodesChange` (ids; default: every node expanded), `onExpand(nodeId)` /
`onCollapse(nodeId)` (user intent, before the change), `loadChildren({ id }) => Promise<ReactNode>`,
`apiRef` (`useOrganizationChartApiRef()`). Highlight: `highlightOnHover` (default `false`),
`dimOpacity` (default 0.7, 0–1, above 1 = 1), `highlightedNode` / `defaultHighlightedNode` /
`onHighlightedNodeChange` (a `nodeId` or `null`; method calls report through it). Per node (and on the chart for its root node): `nodeId`
(`data-ok-node-id`; nodes without one get an internal id), `hasChildren` (children to load),
`toggleLabel` (default "Child nodes").

API mapping (`react-organizational-chart`): `Tree` → **renamed** `OrganizationChart` (a generic
`Tree` would collide with Tree view), `TreeNode` → **renamed** `OrganizationChartNode`; kept
`label`, `children`, `lineHeight`, `lineWidth`, `lineColor`, `lineStyle`, `lineBorderRadius`,
`nodePadding`. Defaults follow the reference (the Minimals wrapper), not the upstream:
`lineHeight` 40 (upstream 20px), `lineBorderRadius` 24 (5px), `nodePadding` 4 (5px), `lineColor`
`divider` (`black`). `lineColor` is an allowlist (`divider`, `inherit`, palette colors at their
light tone) instead of any CSS color: `inherit` + the root's `color` covers custom colors without
untrusted CSS. `lineStyle` keeps `solid` / `dashed` / `dotted` (other border styles look like
`solid` at 1px). Lengths: a number (px) or a non-negative length in `px`, `rem` or `em`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Root: `display: flex`, centered, `inline-size: max-content`, `min-inline-size: 100%` (centered
  when it fits, otherwise as wide as its widest level and starting at the container's start, so a
  scroll container reaches every node). List reset, `--ok-text-primary`, `--ok-font-family`.
- Node: flex column, centered, `text-align: center`; child nodes `padding: lineHeight nodePadding 0`.
- Children list: flex row, centered, `padding-block-start: lineHeight`; `::before` draws the line
  down from the parent (`lineHeight` tall, on the list's center).
- Child node `::before` / `::after`: the two halves of the bar above it (`lineHeight` tall, 50%
  wide); `::after` also draws the line down to the label. First child: no start half, rounded
  start corner (`lineBorderRadius`); last child: no end half, the start half turns down with the
  rounded end corner (shifted by `lineWidth` onto the same pixels); only child: a straight line.
- Lines: `lineWidth lineStyle lineColor`; default 1px solid `--ok-divider`; palette colors
  `--ok-palette-<color>-light`; `inherit` = `currentColor` of the chart.
- Private properties: `--_ok-org-line-height` (default `--ok-spacing` × 10 = 40px),
  `--_ok-org-line-width` (1px), `--_ok-org-line-radius` (`--ok-spacing` × 6 = 24px),
  `--_ok-org-node-padding` (`--ok-spacing` = 4px), `--_ok-org-line-color`, `--_ok-org-line-style`,
  `--_ok-org-line`; all declared on every root, so nested charts don't inherit them.
- Logical properties throughout: right-to-left charts mirror.
- Direction (ADR-0052, CSS only, same markup): `bottom` → nodes `column-reverse`, lists pad the
  block end, connector borders and radii move from the block start to the block end; `left` /
  `right` → nodes are rows, lists columns (`padding-inline-start: lineHeight`), the line from the
  parent runs along the inline axis at the list's block center, each child's bar halves along
  its inline start (`inline-size: lineHeight`, `block-size: 50%`) and its line to the label along
  its block center; `right` reverses the inline axis (`row-reverse`, borders on the inline end).
  `left` is logical: in a right-to-left scope the chart grows toward the left. Toggles move to
  the edge facing the children; the chevron's angle is `--_ok-org-chevron` on the root (0 /
  180deg / -90deg / 90deg, horizontal ones swapped under `[dir="rtl"]`), plus 180deg when
  expanded. A chart nested in a label of a chart with another direction picks up the outer
  direction's rules (descendant selectors): give nested charts the same direction.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Highlight: hovered / focused path (`:hover` / `:focus-within` on a label, `:hover` /
`:focus-visible` on a toggle, `data-ok-highlight-on-hover`: the other labels and toggles at
`opacity: 1 - dimOpacity`) · highlighted node (`data-ok-highlighted`: a ring on its label, its
path colored, nothing fades; a hovered path replaces it while it lasts).
Static unless `data-ok-enable-expand-collapse`. Then per branch: expanded (list without `hidden`,
toggle `aria-expanded="true"`, chevron turned) · collapsed (list `hidden`, so it and its connectors
aren't drawn; the badge shows the hidden count when ≥ threshold) · loading (toggle
`aria-busy="true"`, the spinner replaces the chevron) · lazy (empty hidden list). Collapse's own
`data-ok-state` while animating.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
Without `enableExpandCollapse`, no interaction. HTML runtime (`organization-chart`): reads `data-ok-line-height`,
`data-ok-line-width`, `data-ok-line-border-radius`, `data-ok-node-padding` through the schema
(invalid → left out) and writes the private properties through CSSOM; follows changes to those
attributes (`MutationObserver`); `destroy()` removes what it wrote. Without JavaScript the
stylesheet defaults apply. React writes the same properties in `style` and renders
`data-ok-runtime="off"`.

Expand and collapse (ADR-0051): core `createOrganizationChartController(root, options)` reports a
toggle click (and, with `expandCollapseOnNodeClick`, a click on a label outside its interactive
content: links, buttons, form fields, `[tabindex]`, menu items, popovers, prevented clicks) as
`onToggle(node, expanded)`, ignores busy toggles, and writes every collapsed node's badge (the
node's descendants at every depth, nested charts left out; empty when expanded or under the
threshold) from a MutationObserver. React keeps the collapsed ids and renders `hidden` /
`aria-expanded`; the HTML runtime emits cancelable `expand` / `collapse` and writes them. The
toggle straddles the label's bottom edge (half its 24px height over the label); the children
list's connector starts below it, so collapsible charts are 12px taller per level. During the
Collapse animation the list's top padding (the line from the parent) stays (ADR-0044). Lazy
nodes: React calls `loadChildren` once, renders the resolved nodes as the node's children and
expands it (empty → leaf: no toggle, no list; rejected → stays collapsed, retried on the next
expand); HTML emits `loadchildren` with `respondWith(nodes | Promise<nodes>)` (elements, a
fragment or nothing), appends them and expands, or removes toggle and list when nothing came.
Batch methods (`organizationChartPlan`) change loaded nodes only and emit nothing.

Lineage highlight: CSS finds the path with `:has()` (a node `:has()` the active label or toggle;
its lists' `::before` take `--_ok-org-highlight-color`, `--ok-palette-primary-main`). The bar
segment from a parent's line to a child on the path is the child label's `::before` (z-index 1,
over the connectors): CSS can't know where the list's center falls among siblings of different
sizes, so core `createOrganizationChartHighlight(root)` (both owners) measures
`organizationChartPathStyle(node)` for each node of the active paths (pointerover / focusin on a
label or toggle, `data-ok-highlighted`, DOM and size changes) and writes `--_ok-org-path-offset`
(signed logical px to the list's center), `--_ok-org-path-forward`, `--_ok-org-path-round` on the
node through CSSOM (parity ignores `style`). Without them only the line to the label shows.
`highlightNode(id)`: writes the state (React: `highlightedNode`; HTML: `data-ok-highlighted`, one
node), expands the collapsed ancestors (no events, like the batch methods), then core
`revealOrganizationChartNode` waits a frame and the ancestors' Collapse animations and calls
`scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" })`, smooth unless reduced motion. Nodes
without `nodeId` can't be highlighted from code.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
None of its own. Controls in labels follow DOM order: a node, its toggle, then its children, in
every direction (only flex directions change, never the DOM).
Toggles are native buttons (Enter / Space). Label clicks are a pointer shortcut only.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Highlight: faded nodes are below the text contrast minimum while a hover / focus highlight
lasts (transient, user-driven; `dimOpacity={0}` keeps full contrast, the path colors remain); a
search result fades nothing for that reason. The highlight is visual: the composed search
announces its result in a `role="status"` line (polite).
Nested lists: screen readers announce each level, its size and positions. Name the root `ul`
(`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`). Lines are decorative (borders on pseudo-elements). Wide
charts go in a named, focusable Scrollbar (keyboard scrolling). Toggles: `aria-expanded`,
`aria-controls` (the list's id), the name from the visually hidden label plus the visible count
(label in name, WCAG 2.5.3), `aria-busy` while loading, a 24px target, a focus ring. Collapsed
children are `hidden` (out of the accessibility tree).
In every direction the children list's Collapse animates its block size (left / right charts:
the column folds toward its center; ADR-0052).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML events (user intent only): `ok:organization-chart:expand` / `collapse` (cancelable, `{ nodeId,
node }`), `ok:organization-chart:loadchildren` (`{ nodeId, node, respondWith }`). HTML instance:
`expand(id)` (Promise; loads lazy children), `collapse(id)`, `isExpanded(id)`, `expandAll()`,
`collapseAll()`, `expandToDepth(depth)` (root = 0), `expandSubtree(id)`, `collapseSubtree(id)`,
`highlightNode(id)` (Promise; resolves once in view), `clearHighlight()`, `getHighlightedNode()`,
`destroy()`. React: the same methods on `apiRef`. Highlight methods emit no events.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same layout at every breakpoint: the chart never wraps (a tree keeps its shape) and keeps its
`direction` (apps switch it themselves, for example from `matchMedia`; ADR-0052). Narrower than its
container: centered. Wider: overflows to the inline end; the Scrollbar wrapper scrolls it from the
first node (the reference centers with `justify-content: center` and cuts off the start on phones).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: `react-organizational-chart` `Tree`, `TreeNode` (github.com/daniel-hauser/react-organizational-chart
README, checked 2026-11-09). ApexTree parity is roadmap 2.4.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Tree` | `OrganizationChart` | renamed | avoids a clash with Tree view |
| `TreeNode` | `OrganizationChartNode` | renamed | |
| `label`, `children` | same | kept | |
| `lineHeight`, `lineWidth`, `lineBorderRadius`, `nodePadding` (CSS lengths) | same (px number or `px` / `rem` / `em`) | kept | reference defaults (40 / 1 / 24 / 4) |
| `lineColor` (any CSS color) | `lineColor` (`divider`, `inherit`, palette) | kept | allowlist; custom colors via `inherit` + `color` |
| `lineStyle` (any border style) | `solid` · `dashed` · `dotted` | kept | others look solid at 1px |

ApexTree (`apexcharts.com/apextree/docs`: options, methods, expand-collapse and lazy-children pages,
checked 2026-11-10; ADR-0051):

| ApexTree | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enableExpandCollapse` (default `true`) | same (default `false`) | kept | off keeps existing charts unchanged |
| `expandCollapseOnNodeClick` | same | kept | skips interactive content in labels |
| `collapseBadgeEnabled`, `collapseBadgeThreshold` | same | kept | |
| `expand`, `collapse`, `expandAll`, `collapseAll`, `expandToDepth`, `expandSubtree`, `collapseSubtree` | same (React `apiRef`, HTML instance) + `isExpanded` | kept | `expand` returns a promise (lazy loads) |
| node `id`, `hasChildren` | `nodeId`, `hasChildren` | renamed / kept | `id` would be the DOM id |
| `loadChildren({ id, name, data })` → nodes | React `loadChildren({ id })` → `ReactNode`; HTML `loadchildren` + `respondWith` | renamed | name and data are the app's own |
| — | `collapsedNodes` / `defaultCollapsedNodes` / `onCollapsedNodesChange`, `onExpand` / `onCollapse`, `toggleLabel`, `ok:organization-chart:expand` / `collapse` | added | React state, HTML events, the toggle's name (ApexTree has none) |
| `expandCollapseButton*` colors and size, `collapseBadge*` colors and font size | tokens | not applicable | 24px target, line-colored border |
| `locale.messages.loadingNodeLabel` | `aria-busy` | not applicable | a stable toggle name |
| `countBadgeEnabled`, `countBadgeSource`, `countBadgeDataKey`, `countBadgeThreshold` | — | deferred | always-on counts; content badges belong in labels |
| `enableExpandCollapseZoom`, `maxZoomNodeSpan` | — | deferred (4.18.5) | zoom / fit |
| `enableAnimation`, `motion.stagger`, `motion.spring` | Collapse timing tokens | not applicable | reduced motion respected |
| `onNodeClick`, `cardExpansion`, `expandCard` / `collapseCard` / `toggleCard` | — | not applicable | labels hold the app's content and handlers |
| `direction` `top` · `bottom` · `left` · `right` | `direction` (default `top`, not written) | kept | CSS only; `left` / `right` are logical (ADR-0052) |
| `direction: "radial"` | — | deferred (4.18.7) | rings need measured positions (Chart engine) |
| `locale.direction` (`ltr` · `rtl` · `auto`) | the page's `dir` | not applicable | logical properties mirror the chart |
| `highlightOnHover` (default `true`) | same (default `false`) | kept | off keeps existing charts unchanged; the focus highlights too |
| `focus.dimOpacity` (default 0.7) | `dimOpacity` (0.7) | renamed | applies to the hover highlight |
| `edgeColorHover`, `nodeBGColorHover`, `borderColorHover` | `--ok-palette-primary-main` path | not applicable | tokens; cards are the app's |
| `enableSearch`, `locale.messages.searchPlaceholder` / `searchAriaLabel` / `searchMatchCount` | a composed `Autocomplete` + `highlightNode(id)` + a status line | renamed | the root is a list (no room for a field); labels, placeholder and announcement are the app's |
| `focus.clickToFocus`, `clearFocus()`, `graph.setActivePath(ids)` | `highlightNode(id)` / `clearHighlight()` | renamed | no camera (zoom is 4.18.5) |
| — | `highlightedNode` / `defaultHighlightedNode` / `onHighlightedNodeChange`, `getHighlightedNode()` | added | React state, HTML instance |
| grouped leaves, zoom / pan, per-node lines | — | deferred (4.18.3, 4.18.5, 4.18.6) | |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
The path measures (`--_ok-org-path-*`) are CSSOM on both sides (parity ignores `style`). The search
snippet is the React render (the Autocomplete's ids renamed `org-search-<n>`, `autoComplete` →
`autocomplete`); its status line starts empty. Otherwise none: the same markup; React's `style` and the runtime's CSSOM properties are equal (parity
ignores `style`). Collapsible charts: React's list ids come from `useId` (parity ignores `id` and
compares `aria-controls` as references; the snippet generator renames them `org-<story>-<n>`);
badge counts are written by the shared controller in both. The lazy snippet ships the answers as
`<template>`s (skipped by parity) that the story script clones.

sections.body: Page numbers with previous / next (optional first / last) buttons and ellipses for long ranges.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
nav[data-ok-pagination][aria-label][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-shape][data-ok-size][data-ok-disabled]?
    HTML: [data-ok-count][data-ok-page][data-ok-sibling-count]?[data-ok-boundary-count]?[data-ok-label-page]?[data-ok-label-current]?
    React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  ul
    li › button[type=button][data-ok-pagination-item][data-ok-type=first|previous|next|last][aria-label][disabled]? › svg[aria-hidden] (or your icon)
    li › button[type=button][data-ok-pagination-item][data-ok-type=page][value=<n>][aria-label][aria-current=page]?[disabled]? › n
    li › span[data-ok-pagination-ellipsis][aria-hidden=true] › …
```
Paging a table (HTML): `data-ok-pagination="<table id>"` + `data-ok-rows-per-page` (default 10)
without `data-ok-count`. React has no equivalent prop: the app slices its rows for `page`.

`PaginationItem` with `href` renders `a[data-ok-pagination-item]` (links; React).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `pagination`: listed under "options".)

Range and labels (React prop ↔ HTML attribute): `count` (default 1) ↔ `data-ok-count`; `page` /
`defaultPage` (1-based, default 1) ↔ `data-ok-page`; `siblingCount` (1) ↔ `data-ok-sibling-count`;
`boundaryCount` (1) ↔ `data-ok-boundary-count`; `showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`,
`hidePrevButton`, `hideNextButton` ↔ which buttons the markup contains;
`getItemAriaLabel(type, page, selected)` ↔ `data-ok-label-page` (default `"Go to page {page}"`) and
`data-ok-label-current` (default `"page {page}"`) for the page items the runtime builds; previous /
next / first / last keep their markup labels. `icons={{ previous, next, first, last }}` ↔ the SVG in
the markup. `renderItem(item)` + `PaginationItem` (React) for custom items or links.

Values from attributes are validated: non-integers and out-of-range values fall back to defaults.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Items: `--ok-spacing` × 8 (32px; `sm` 26px, `lg` 40px), padding 6px, margin 3px between items,
  body2 (`lg`: `--ok-font-size-lg`), current page weight 600; icons 20px (18 / 22).
- Shape: `circular` = `--ok-radius-full`, `rounded` = `--ok-radius-md`.
- Hover (hover-capable devices): `--ok-action-hover`. Focus-visible: 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline.
- Current page — `text`: `main` fill, `contrast` text (`standard`: `--ok-inherit-main` /
  `--ok-inherit-contrast`); `outlined`: grey 32 % borders, current `main` border and text, 8 % fill
  (`standard`: inherit main, grey 8 %); `soft`: 16 % fill, `-text` tone (`standard`: grey 16 %,
  primary text).
- Disabled: `--ok-action-disabled` text; current page `--ok-action-disabled-bg`.
- Items wrap onto more lines when the row is too narrow.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: controlled (`page` + `onChange(page)`) or uncontrolled (`defaultPage`); `onChange` fires
  with the requested page; a controlled owner refuses by not updating `page`.
- HTML runtime (`pagination`): an item click → cancelable `ok:pagination:change` `{ page }` → the
  page items and ellipses are rebuilt (DOM APIs, no HTML strings), the buttons' disabled states
  and `data-ok-page` updated; focus stays on the clicked button (or the new current page).
  Instance: `page`, `count`, `setPage(page)`, `refresh()`.
- Linked to a table (`data-ok-pagination="<table id>"`, no `data-ok-count`): `count` = row groups
  ÷ `data-ok-rows-per-page`; row groups outside the page get `hidden` (open detail rows follow
  their row); the table's `sort()` refreshes it.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native buttons: Tab / Shift+Tab move between items, Enter / Space activate.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- `nav` with an `aria-label` (default "pagination navigation"); the current page has
  `aria-current="page"`; every item has a name (`getItemAriaLabel` / label templates).
- Ellipses are `aria-hidden`. Disabled items are native `disabled`.
- Brand-colored current pages (`text`, `outlined` with a color) follow the reference (ADR-0014);
  `standard` and `soft` meet AA.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: `ok:pagination:change` (cancelable, `detail.page`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Mobile first: items keep their size (≥ 24px targets) and wrap; the page never overflows.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Pagination`, `PaginationItem`, `usePagination` (mui.com/material-ui/api/pagination,
/api/pagination-item, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count`, `page`, `defaultPage`, `onChange(event, page)` | same / `data-ok-count`, `data-ok-page`, `ok:pagination:change` | kept | React `onChange(page)` (no event) |
| `siblingCount`, `boundaryCount` | same / `data-ok-sibling-count`, `-boundary-count` | kept | |
| `showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`, `hidePrevButton`, `hideNextButton` | same / the buttons the markup contains | kept | |
| `color` | `color` / `data-ok-color` | kept | adds `info` … `error`; arbitrary strings not applicable |
| `shape`, `disabled` | same | kept | |
| `size` `small` / `medium` / `large` | `size` `sm` / `md` / `lg` | renamed | project size names |
| `variant` `text` / `outlined` | `variant` | kept | `soft` added (reference) |
| `getItemAriaLabel(type, page, selected)` | same / `data-ok-label-page`, `-label-current` | kept | HTML: templates for page items only |
| `renderItem` | `renderItem` (React) | kept | HTML: author the markup |
| PaginationItem `type`, `page`, `selected`, `disabled` | same | kept | |
| PaginationItem `color`, `shape`, `size`, `variant` | root options | not applicable | items read the root's attributes |
| PaginationItem `component` (router links) | same (React): the item's attributes, content and other props (a router link's `to`) go to the component; disabled → `aria-disabled` | kept (4.18.73) | HTML: `a[data-ok-pagination-item][href]` |
| PaginationItem `slots` (`first` / `last` / `next` / `previous` icons) | `icons` / `icon` | renamed | composition |
| `usePagination` | core `paginationItems` | renamed | framework-free; no React hook |
| `classes`, `sx`, `slots` / `slotProps` | — | not applicable | by decision |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
- Labels: React builds them with `getItemAriaLabel`; HTML uses the `data-ok-label-page` and
  `data-ok-label-current` templates. Defaults are identical.
- HTML only: `data-ok-pagination="<table id>"` pages a table's rows (see Behavior); in React the app
  slices its rows for `page`.
- React only: `renderItem` + `PaginationItem` (links, custom items).

The element is the author's: `div` by default (React `component`, HTML any element such as
`section`, `article`, `li`). Paper adds no role: it is a visual surface only.

sections.body:
(Options of `paper`: listed under "options".)

React: `component` (the element, default `div`), `children`, `ref` and every HTML attribute
(passed to the element). Not applicable: `sx`, `classes`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`--ok-bg-paper` background, `--ok-text-primary` text, `--ok-radius-md` corners (`square`: 0).
`elevation` 0–24 → `box-shadow: var(--ok-elevation-<n>)` (0: none), changes animate over
`--ok-duration-standard` / `--ok-easing-standard` (none with reduced motion). `outlined`: no
shadow, `1px solid rgb(var(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel) / 0.16)` (Minimals' theme), elevation
ignored. No size, padding or display of its own: the content and the author's layout decide.
Dark mode: the same `--ok-bg-paper` at every elevation (Minimals' theme drops MUI's lightening
gradient; the dark paper already differs from the dark page background).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- **Card** (`specs/components/card.md`, next) is a Paper root: its element carries
  `paperAttributes()` *and* `data-ok-card` (React: `<Paper {...props} data-ok-card="">` or the
  same attributes on its own element; HTML: `data-ok-paper … data-ok-card` on one element). It
  reuses Paper's `variant`, `elevation` and `square` options (spread `paperOptions.options` into
  its schema) and adds its own.
- `paper.css` is imported **first** among the components in `styles/src/index.css`: every rule is
  a zero-specificity `:where()`, so a composing component's CSS (loaded later) overrides Paper's
  radius, shadow or background by source order — e.g. `:where([data-ok-card]) { border-radius:
  var(--ok-radius-2xl); box-shadow: var(--ok-shadow-card) }`. Such a component restates what must
  still win over its own rule: `:where([data-ok-card][data-ok-variant="outlined"])` (no shadow),
  `:where([data-ok-card][data-ok-square])` (no radius).
- Paper sets only `background-color`, `color`, `border-radius`, `box-shadow`, `border`
  (outlined) and `transition`: no `display`, `overflow`, padding or size, so a composer adds them
  without undoing anything. No private variables (they would inherit into nested papers).
- Existing surfaces (Popover, Menu, Dialog, Drawer, TableContainer) paint the same tokens
  themselves today; they can move onto `data-ok-paper` later without a visual change by keeping
  their own shadow / radius rules after `paper.css`.

Stories: the labels are Typography `body2` (`textSecondary` on the Elevation levels, as in the
reference); `sb-paper-*` classes give sizes and centering only.

meaning by elevation alone.

sections.body:
Content next to an anchor, in the top layer. Runtime behavior: core `createPopoverController`
(positioning, flip, shift, Escape / outside press, focus, layer stack), shared by Menu and Tooltip.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
button[data-ok-popover-open="id"][aria-haspopup][aria-expanded][aria-controls]   (HTML trigger; or data-ok-popover-hover)
div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][id][data-ok-placement][data-ok-arrow]?[role=dialog]?
  › span[data-ok-popover-arrow][aria-hidden]       (always rendered; shown with data-ok-arrow)
  › content
```
States written by the controller: `data-ok-open`, `data-ok-current-placement` (after a flip),
`data-ok-fallback` (no Popover API), CSSOM `--_ok-popover-x|y|arrow|duration` (no `x` / `y`
with `anchorReference="none"`).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `popover`: listed under "options".)

React: `open` + `anchorEl` (element or function) + `onOpenChange(open, reason)`, `initialFocus`,
`children`. Renamed: `anchorOrigin` / `transformOrigin` → `placement` (one vocabulary for
Popover, Menu and Tooltip: side + start/center/end; the controller flips and shifts);
`onClose(event, reason)` → `onOpenChange(false, reason)` with `escape` | `backdrop`; the
Minimals arrow (`slotProps.arrow.placement`) → `arrow` (it follows the placement).
Kept (Phase 4.7): `anchorReference` (`anchorEl` · `anchorPosition` · `none`; HTML
`data-ok-anchor-reference`), `anchorPosition` (`{ top, left }`; HTML
`data-ok-anchor-position="top,left"`, written by React too), `marginThreshold`
(`data-ok-margin-threshold`), `transitionDuration` (ms, the opening animation;
`data-ok-transition-duration` → `--_ok-popover-duration` through CSSOM by the controller).
`anchorEl` also takes a virtual anchor (`{ getBoundingClientRect(), contextElement? }`, MUI
`PopoverVirtualElement`); HTML: `instance.open(virtualAnchor)`. `none` writes no coordinates:
the author's CSS positions the paper. Not applicable: `container` (top layer), `TransitionComponent`, `slots`, `slotProps`,
`sx`, `elevation` (one dropdown shadow), `disableScrollLock` (non-modal: the page stays scrollable;
the popover follows its anchor), `disablePortal` (top layer).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Paper: radius `--ok-radius-md` × 1.25 (10px), padding 4px, `rgb(var(--ok-bg-paper-channel) / 0.9)`,
blur 20px, two glows (info top-right, error bottom-left, 12%), `--ok-shadow-dropdown`, max size
viewport − 32px, scrolls without an arrow. Gap 8px (12px with the arrow); 16px from the viewport
edges. Arrow 14px, `--ok-bg-paper`, 1px grey-500/12% border. Opening: fade + scale 0.96,
`--ok-duration-shorter` (none with reduced motion). Fallback: `position: fixed`, `--ok-z-dropdown`.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Stays 16px inside the viewport at every width (shift on the cross axis, flip on the main axis,
clamp when neither side fits).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Focus moves into the popover on open (first tabbable, else the popover) and back to the anchor on
close (`disableAutoFocus` / `disableRestoreFocus` turn this off; hover triggers do). Escape
closes the top layer only. Interactive popovers: `role="dialog"` + a name; triggers
`aria-haspopup` + `aria-expanded` (synced by the HTML runtime).
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:popover:beforeopen` (cancelable, `detail.anchor`), `ok:popover:open`,
`ok:popover:beforeclose` (cancelable, `detail.reason`: escape | backdrop | trigger | select | tab |
api), `ok:popover:close`. Instance: `{ isOpen, open(anchor), close(reason?), toggle(anchor) }`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API page Popover (inherits Modal).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open`, `anchorEl` (element or function), `children` | same | kept | |
| `onClose(event, reason)` | `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (`escape` `backdrop`) | renamed | |
| `anchorOrigin` / `transformOrigin` | `placement` (side + start / center / end; flip and shift) | renamed | overlapping origins not expressible |
| Minimals `slotProps.arrow.placement` | `arrow` | renamed | follows the placement |
| `anchorReference`, `anchorPosition` | same; HTML `data-ok-anchor-reference`, `data-ok-anchor-position="top,left"` | kept (4.7) | |
| `anchorEl` virtual element (`PopoverVirtualElement`) | same (`PopoverVirtualAnchor`); HTML `open(virtualAnchor)` | kept (4.7) | |
| `marginThreshold` | same (`data-ok-margin-threshold`, default 16; `0` = none) | kept (4.7) | MUI `null` → `0` |
| `transitionDuration` | same, a number of ms for the opening animation | kept (4.18.43) | `auto` and `{ enter, exit }` not applicable: no exit animation (Phase 5.1) |
| `action` (`updatePosition`) | controller repositions on scroll / resize | not applicable | |
| `elevation` | `--ok-shadow-dropdown` | not applicable | one dropdown shadow |
| `container`, Modal `disablePortal` | — | not applicable | top layer |
| `disableScrollLock` | — | not applicable | non-modal: page stays scrollable |
| Modal `disableEscapeKeyDown`, `disableAutoFocus`, `disableRestoreFocus` | same | kept | |
| Modal `keepMounted` | always mounted | kept | |
| Modal `disableEnforceFocus`, `hideBackdrop`, `BackdropProps` | — | not applicable | no focus trap, no backdrop element |
| — | `initialFocus` | kept | beyond upstream |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps`, `TransitionComponent` / `TransitionProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS, composition, one CSS transition |

sections.body:
Give or show a score as icons. A native radio group carries the value, keyboard and labels;
the owner (React state, HTML runtime `rating`) marks filled icons.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-rating][data-ok-size][data-ok-color][data-ok-highlight-selected-only]?[data-ok-disabled]?
  span[data-ok-rating-item]                                       (one per whole value)
    label[data-ok-rating-icon][for][data-ok-value][data-ok-fraction]?[data-ok-filled]?[data-ok-hover]?
      svg[aria-hidden] | span[data-ok-rating-icon-filled] + span[data-ok-rating-icon-empty]
      span[data-ok-rating-label-text]                              (visually hidden: "2 Stars")
    input[type=radio][data-ok-rating-input][id][name][value]       (visually hidden)
  label[data-ok-rating-empty][for] + input[type=radio][data-ok-rating-input][value=""]   ("Empty")
read-only: span[data-ok-rating][data-ok-read-only][role=img][aria-label] › items › span[data-ok-rating-icon]
```
Fractions (precision 0.5 / 0.25) come first in their item, absolutely positioned over the whole
icon and clipped to `data-ok-fraction` × the size.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `rating`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value | null)`, `onChangeActive(value | null)`,
`max` (5), `precision` (1 · 0.5 · 0.25), `name`, `icon`, `emptyIcon`, `renderIcon(value)`
(MUI `IconContainerComponent`, renamed: a function of the value), `getLabelText(value)` (default
"2 Stars"), `emptyLabelText` ("Empty"). HTML: markup per value, labels as text.

API mapping: see "Upstream API mapping" below.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Icon size `--_ok-rating-size`: 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28px (`spacing` × 3 … 7). Filled: palette
`main` (default `--ok-palette-warning-main`); empty `rgb(grey-500 / 0.48)`. Solid SVGs take
`fill: currentColor`; line icons (`fill="none"`) keep their stroke. Hover: the icon under the
pointer scales 1.2 (`--ok-duration-shortest`; none with reduced motion). Disabled: opacity 0.48.
Focus: 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline around the focused value's icon.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Filled = value ≤ shown (hover ?? value); `highlightSelectedOnly`: = shown. A pointer click on the
current value clears it (`event.detail > 0`, so Space doesn't). Hover reports the value under the
pointer (`null` on leave). An empty fraction icon is hidden (its whole icon shows the empty state).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native radio group: Tab to the checked radio; arrows change the value, down to "Empty".
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Every value labelled (`getLabelText`); read-only = `role="img"` named by the value; icons
`aria-hidden`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:rating:change` (cancelable, `{ value, previous }`; prevented → previous radio checked
again), `ok:rating:active` (`{ value }`). Instance `{ value, setValue(value) }`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same sizes everywhere; 24px icons meet the 24px target size (smaller sizes: read-only use).
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Rating`, mui.com/material-ui/api/rating/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value`, `defaultValue`, `max`, `precision`, `readOnly`, `disabled`, `highlightSelectedOnly`, `name`, `icon`, `emptyIcon`, `getLabelText`, `emptyLabelText` | same | kept | |
| `size` | `size` | kept | + `xSmall`, `xxSmall` (reference) |
| `onChange(event, value)`, `onChangeActive(event, value)` | `onChange(value)`, `onChangeActive(value)` | renamed | value-first (ADR-0015) |
| `slots.icon` (`IconContainerComponent`) | `renderIcon(value)` | renamed | a function of the value |
| `component` | — | not applicable | root is a `span` around a native radio group |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

Beyond MUI: `color` (the reference's custom color).
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body: React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"`. Hover feedback text is app markup (React demo state).

sections.body:
A scroll area with themed, thin scrollbars that stay out of the way until needed. Table, Drawer
and Sortable scroll through it (see Anatomy).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-scrollbar][aria-label][tabindex=0][data-ok-auto-hide="false"]?   (named section = region)
  …content (the root itself scrolls: overflow: auto)
```
Used by other components by composition (their CSS adapts when it wraps a Scrollbar):
`TableContainer › Scrollbar › Table`, `DrawerContent › Scrollbar › …`, `Scrollbar › Sortable`.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `scrollbar`: listed under "options".)

Name and focus: `aria-label` (default `"scrollable content"`, as upstream `ariaLabel`; skipped
when `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` is given) and `tabIndex` (default `0`). Upstream
`forceVisible`, `clickOnTrack`, `scrollbarMinSize` / `scrollbarMaxSize`, `direction`, `timeout`,
`classNames`, `recalculate()` and `getScrollElement()` don't apply: the scrollbars are native
(`overflow`, `dir` and the browser cover them) and the root is the scroll element (React `ref`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Thumb: `text.disabled` at 48 % — `rgb(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel / 0.48)` (light),
  grey 600 (dark, via `light-dark()`; light tone without it); track transparent.
- Standard path (`@supports (scrollbar-color: auto)`): `scrollbar-width: thin`,
  `scrollbar-color: <thumb> transparent`.
- Fallback (`::-webkit-scrollbar`, Safari and Chrome < 121): 11px track
  (`--ok-spacing` × 2.75), thumb inset 2px (× 0.5) with `--ok-radius-full`, min 10px (× 2.5).
- Focus-visible: 2px `--ok-text-primary` outline, inset.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- Auto-hide (default): thumb transparent at rest; visible on `:hover` (hover-capable devices)
  and `:focus-within`. Touch screens (`hover: none`): always visible.
- `data-ok-auto-hide="false"`: always visible.
sections.title: States

sections.body: CSS only, no runtime. Scrolling is native (wheel, touch momentum, keyboard, find-in-page).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Tab focuses the area; arrow keys, Page Up / Page Down, Home / End and Space scroll it (native).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- A named `<section>` (role `region`), focusable (axe `scrollable-region-focusable`).
- The thumb shows while focus is inside, so keyboard users see the position.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: None. React: `ref` is the scroll element.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: simplebar / simplebar-react options and API (github.com/Grsmto/simplebar README,
checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoHide` | `autoHide` / `data-ok-auto-hide="false"` | kept | |
| `ariaLabel` | `aria-label` (default "scrollable content") | renamed | native attribute |
| `tabIndex` | `tabIndex` (default 0) | kept | |
| `forceVisible`, `clickOnTrack`, `scrollbarMinSize`, `scrollbarMaxSize`, `direction`, `timeout` | — | not applicable | native scrollbars (`overflow`, `dir`, the browser) |
| `classNames` | — | not applicable | `data-ok-*` anatomy |
| `getScrollElement()`, `getContentElement()` | React `ref` (the root scrolls) | renamed | one element |
| `recalculate()`, `removeObserver()`, `SimpleBar.instances` | — | not applicable | no runtime |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body: None: React renders the same element and attributes as the snippets.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
1. Native scrollbars take layout space where the OS uses classic scrollbars (Windows, Linux);
   simplebar overlays them.
2. On the standard path (Firefox, Chrome 121+) the browser draws the thin thumb's shape and width.
3. No "visible while scrolling, fade out after 0.5s": CSS can't detect scrolling; the thumb shows
   on hover and focus instead.
4. iOS / Android show the system's overlay scrollbars.
sections.title: Intentional differences from the reference

sections.body:
Mobile first, no breakpoints: the area fills its container (`min-width: 0`); content wraps or
scrolls inside. The Layout story stacks Top / Left / content / Right / Bottom below 900px and uses
three columns from 900px (story-only demo CSS).
sections.title: Responsive

stories.html:
Scroll areas keep long content inside a fixed frame while the rest of the page stays where it is. The thumb follows the theme, stays thin, and appears when the pointer rests on the area or when the keyboard focus is inside it.

Every scroll area is a named region that can take focus, so keyboard users reach it with Tab and scroll it with the arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, Home and End. Screen readers announce its name before the content.

The browser does the scrolling itself: momentum on touch screens, smooth wheel scrolling, find-in-page and scroll anchoring all keep working. Only the look of the bar changes, and it falls back to the native bar where styling is not supported.

Wide content scrolls sideways the same way. Tables, drawers and sortable lists in this library use the same thumb, so every scroll area on a page looks and behaves alike.

sections.body:
Choose one or more values from a list. The field shows the value; the list opens in a Popover
(Menu's paper and items) under it. `native` uses the browser's `<select>` instead.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
[data-ok-form-control][data-ok-variant]?[data-ok-size]?[data-ok-hidden-label]?…   (FormControl, optional)
  label[data-ok-form-label][data-ok-input-label][id][for]?[data-ok-shrink]?[data-ok-disable-animation]?
  div[data-ok-select][data-ok-variant][data-ok-size][data-ok-color][data-ok-error]?[data-ok-full-width]?
                     [data-ok-multiple]?[data-ok-auto-width]?[data-ok-display-empty]?
    template[data-ok-select-chip]?          (HTML: a Chip per value, multiple)
    template[data-ok-select-placeholder]?   (HTML: what an empty value shows, displayEmpty)
    [data-ok-text-field-adornment="start"]?   (InputAdornment)
    div[data-ok-select-display][role=combobox][tabindex=0|-1][id][aria-haspopup=listbox]
       [aria-expanded][aria-controls=<id>-listbox][aria-labelledby]?[aria-label]?[aria-describedby]?
       [aria-disabled]?[aria-readonly]?[aria-invalid]?[aria-required]?   › the value's content
    input[data-ok-select-input][aria-hidden=true][tabindex=-1][name]?[value][placeholder=" "][disabled]?[required]?
    svg[data-ok-select-icon][aria-hidden]
    [data-ok-text-field-adornment="end"]?   (InputAdornment, before the arrow on screen)
    fieldset[data-ok-select-outline][aria-hidden] › legend › span (label + " *")   (outlined)
    div[data-ok-popover][popover=manual][id=<id>-menu][data-ok-placement=bottom-start][tabindex=-1]
      span[data-ok-popover-arrow]
      ul[data-ok-select-listbox][role=listbox][id=<id>-listbox][aria-labelledby]?[aria-multiselectable]?
        li[data-ok-menu-item][role=option][tabindex=-1][aria-selected][data-ok-selected]?[data-ok-value][aria-disabled]?
        li[data-ok-list-subheader][role=presentation]   (grouping)
  p[data-ok-form-helper-text][id]?
Native: div[data-ok-select][…] › select[data-ok-select-native][id] › option | optgroup, svg[data-ok-select-icon] (not multiple), fieldset
Composed (no field box of its own): TextField's control `div[data-ok-text-field-control][data-ok-select]`
  around the same parts (trigger also `data-ok-text-field-input`, icon also
  `data-ok-text-field-select-icon`); TablePagination's `div[data-ok-select]` (bare, styled by table.css).
```
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the field box (and the paper). The field box always
writes its variant / size / color (resolved: own prop, else the FormControl's, else the default).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `select`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `input-label`: listed under "options".)

FormControl gains `hiddenLabel` (`data-ok-hidden-label`, see form-control.md): a filled Select
without a label (also automatic when the FormControl has no InputLabel).

React: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` (the options' own values: numbers stay
numbers; multiple → a list), `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange(open, reason)` (reasons
`escape` · `backdrop` · `select` · `tab` · `toggle`), `renderValue(value)`, `label` (the notch),
`labelId`, `id` (the trigger), `name`, `readOnly`, `native`, `inputProps` / `inputRef` (hidden
input or native select), `displayProps` (MUI `SelectDisplayProps`), `menuProps`
(`{ placement, paperProps, listProps }`, MUI `MenuProps`), `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` /
`aria-describedby` (to the trigger), children `MenuItem` (+ `ListSubheader`) or `<option>`
(native). `ref` → the field box. `InputLabel`: FormLabel's props + `shrink`, `disableAnimation`.
TextField: `selectProps` (`{ native: false, … }` → listbox; TextField's `select` stays native by
default for compatibility; MUI's default is the listbox). TablePagination: `selectProps`
(`{ native: false, menuProps }` → listbox; native by default).

API mapping: see "Upstream API mapping" below.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
The field box mirrors TextField (text-field.md): outlined 1px `grey-500` at 0.2 → hover
`text-primary` → focus 2px accent; filled tint `grey-500` 0.08 (hover / focus 0.16, disabled
0.24) with a 2px inset focus ring; standard underline growing from the middle; radius
`--ok-radius-md`; text 15 / 24px; padding 16 / 14px (small 8 / 14px), filled 24 12 8 (small
20 12 4; no label 16 12 / 8 12), standard 4px 0 (small 2px 0); 32px (standard 24px) at the end
for the arrow (20px, `text-secondary`, turns 180° while open). InputLabel: TextField's label
positions per variant and size, floated with focus (`:focus-within` on the FormControl), a value
(the hidden input `:not(:placeholder-shown)`), a native select or `shrink`; colors: focus
`--_ok-form-focus-own`, error `--ok-palette-error-text`, disabled `--ok-text-disabled`, filled
rest `grey-700` (AA on the tint). Menu: Popover paper (`--ok-shadow-dropdown`), at least the
field's width (`--_ok-select-width`, CSSOM) unless `autoWidth`; options are MenuItems (selected
semibold + `--ok-action-hover`). Chips: the trigger wraps them (`display: flex`, 4px gap).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Intrinsic: the field takes its value's width (a FormControl `fullWidth` stretches it); the value
truncates with an ellipsis (chips wrap and the field grows). The menu stays 16px inside the
viewport and scrolls when long (Popover).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Core `createSelectController(root, { isOpen, isInert?, autoWidth?, onOpen(focus), onClose(reason),
onPick(option) })` reports intent; owners keep the value and the open state. Single: a pick
replaces the value and closes (`select`), focus returns to the trigger. Multiple: a pick toggles,
the list stays open. Escape / outside press close through the popover controller. Disabled
(`aria-disabled`) and read-only (`aria-readonly`) triggers don't open. HTML runtime `select`:
renders the trigger's content on change (single: a copy of the option's content; multiple:
chips from `template[data-ok-select-chip]` or the options' texts joined with ", "; empty +
`data-ok-display-empty`: the empty option or `template[data-ok-select-placeholder]`), writes
`aria-selected` / `data-ok-selected`, a checkbox's `checked` inside an option, and the hidden
input. A button `[data-ok-select-open="<trigger id>"]` opens it.
sections.title: States / Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Enter / Space / Alt+ArrowDown (closed) | Open on the selected option (else the first) |
| Home / End (closed) | Open on the first / last option |
| Printable character (closed) | Open on the first option after the selected one that starts with it |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp (open) | Next / previous option, wrapping (MUI MenuList) |
| Home / End (open) | First / last option |
| Printable characters (open) | Typeahead (500 ms buffer; a repeated letter cycles) |
| Enter / Space (open) | Pick (multiple: toggle) |
| Escape | Close; focus to the trigger |
| Tab | Close (prevented, MUI); focus to the trigger |
Disabled options and subheaders are skipped.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Select-only combobox (WAI-ARIA APG) with MUI's roving focus: the trigger is
`role=combobox` + `aria-haspopup=listbox` + `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; the list is
`role=listbox` (`aria-multiselectable` with multiple) of `role=option` with `aria-selected`.
Name: `labelId` (`aria-labelledby`) or `aria-label`. States on the trigger: `aria-invalid`,
`aria-required`, `aria-disabled` (tabindex -1), `aria-readonly`. Subheaders are
`role=presentation`. Checkboxes inside options are `inert` (the option is the control). A disabled
Select's InputLabel is inactive text (exempt from contrast, like TextField's).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:select:change` (cancelable, `{ value }`: string, or string[] with multiple) before the
value changes; `ok:select:open`; `ok:select:close` (`{ reason }`: `escape` · `backdrop` · `select` ·
`tab` · `toggle` · `api`). Instance: `{ value, setValue(value), isOpen, open(), close() }` (a native
select's instance reads and writes the `<select>`). React: `onChange(value)`,
`onOpenChange(open, reason)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Select` (+ OutlinedInput / InputBase props), `InputLabel`, `NativeSelect`,
mui.com/material-ui/api/select/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoWidth`, `children`, `defaultOpen`, `defaultValue`, `displayEmpty`, `id`, `inputProps`, `inputRef`, `label`, `labelId`, `multiple`, `native`, `open`, `renderValue`, `value`, `variant` | same | kept | `id` → the trigger; `inputProps` / `inputRef` → hidden input or native select |
| InputBase `size`, `color`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `fullWidth`, `name`, `readOnly` | same | kept | default: the FormControl's |
| `onChange(event, child)` | `onChange(value)` | renamed | the options' own values (numbers stay numbers) |
| `onOpen` / `onClose` | `onOpenChange(open, reason)` | renamed | reasons `escape` · `backdrop` · `select` · `tab` · `toggle` |
| `MenuProps` | `menuProps` (`placement`, `paperProps`, `listProps`) | renamed | |
| `SelectDisplayProps` | `displayProps` | renamed | |
| `NativeSelect` (`IconComponent`, `input`, `inputProps`, `onChange`, `value`, `variant`) | `Select native` | renamed | `variant="standard"` for its look |
| InputBase `startAdornment` / `endAdornment` | same | kept | 4.18.27: an `InputAdornment` (`[data-ok-text-field-adornment]`) inside the field box: the start one before the trigger (it floats the InputLabel and opens the notch, as in TextField), the end one after the arrow icon in the DOM and drawn before it (the box keeps the arrow's space); native selects too |
| `IconComponent` | — | not applicable | the arrow is part of the anatomy |
| `input` | — | not applicable | the field box is the Select |
| InputLabel `children`, `shrink`, `disableAnimation` | same | kept | |
| InputLabel `color`, `disabled`, `error`, `focused`, `required` | same | kept | from FormLabel |
| InputLabel `variant`, `size`, `margin` | — | not applicable | CSS reads the Select's |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `component` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
Snippets are generated from the React stories
(`apps/storybook/scripts/select-snippets.mjs`), which also adds the HTML-only templates
(`SELECT_TEMPLATES`) and triggers (`data-ok-select-open`, `data-ok-dialog-open` / `-close`;
parity ignores `data-ok-select-open`). `renderValue` is React-only: HTML covers chips, the
placeholder and joined texts. The width of the menu (`--_ok-select-width`) is CSSOM.

Pick a value or a range on a track. Each thumb holds a native `input[type=range]` (keyboard

```
span[data-ok-slider][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-track][data-ok-value-label-display]
```

sections.body:
Root: 26px vertical padding area (13px), width 100% (vertical: height 100%, min 100px). Rail:
10 / 6px (`spacing` × 2.5 / 1.5), `rgb(grey-500 / 0.12)`, `--ok-radius-lg`. Track: `main`.
Thumb: 20 / 16px, `--ok-palette-common-white`, 1px `rgb(grey-500 / 0.08)` border, shadow
`0 1px 2px rgb(grey-500 / 0.16)`, inner dot 62.5% `rgb(grey-500 / 0.16)`; hover / active /
focus-visible: 8px halo `rgb(main / 0.16)`; focus-visible adds a 2px outline. Marks: 1px ticks,
`rgb(grey-500 / 0.48)` (on the track: white 64%). Mark labels `--ok-font-size-sm`,
`--ok-text-secondary`. Value label: `--ok-palette-grey-800`, white, 12px semibold, `--ok-radius-md`,
4px 8px, arrow; scales in over `--ok-duration-shortest`. Disabled: grey, no pointer.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Press on the rail moves the closest thumb there and starts a drag (Pointer Events, captured);
`onCommit` on release. Thumbs swap when crossing (`disableSwap`: stop at the neighbour). Keys
(on the focused input, handled by the controller): arrows ± step (marks only: next mark),
Page Up / Down and Shift + arrows ± `shiftStep` (default 10, snapped to the step), Home / End; RTL mirrors Left / Right. Native `input` events
(assistive technologies) are applied too.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| → / ↑, ← / ↓ | ± one step (or to the next mark) |
| Page Up / Page Down, Shift + arrows | ± `shiftStep` (default 10) |
| Home / End | min / max |

Horizontal sliders fill their container; vertical ones its height. Pressing the track (any
width) moves a thumb, so the 20px thumb isn't the only target.

Upstream: MUI `Slider`, mui.com/material-ui/api/slider/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value`, `defaultValue`, `min`, `max`, `step` (incl. `null`), `marks`, `orientation`, `size`, `track`, `valueLabelDisplay`, `valueLabelFormat`, `getAriaValueText`, `getAriaLabel`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `disabled`, `disableSwap`, `name` | same | kept | |
| `color` | `color` | kept | + `inherit` and every palette color (reference) |
| `onChange(event, value, activeThumb)` | `onChange(value, activeThumb)` | renamed | value-first (ADR-0015) |
| `onChangeCommitted(event, value)` | `onChangeCommitted(value)` | renamed | |
| `aria-valuetext` | `getAriaValueText` | renamed | per thumb |
| `scale` | same | kept | React function; HTML `setScale(scale, format?)` on the instance (a function can't be an attribute) |
| `shiftStep` | same | kept | HTML `data-ok-shift-step`; Page keys now move by it (they moved 10 steps) |
| `tabIndex` | same | kept | on each thumb's input; HTML: `tabindex` on the inputs |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `component` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 (custom thumbs / labels by composition) |

CSSOM on mount (parity ignores `style`).

sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `toaster`: listed under "options".)

React: `toast(title, options)`, `toast.message|info|success|warning|error|loading|promise|custom`,
`toast.dismiss(id?)`; options `id`, `description`, `action` (`{ label, onClick }` or your nodes),
`cancel`, `duration`, `icon`, `dismissible`, `onDismiss`, `onAutoClose`; `<Toaster store>`.
Toast options also `position`, `closeButton`, `invert`, `richColors`, `toasterId`;
`toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error, description, finally, …toast options })` returns
the id boxed with `unwrap()` (as Sonner); `toast.getHistory()`, `toast.getToasts()`; `useSonner()`.
Toaster: `position`, `duration` (4000), `visibleToasts` (3), `closeButton`, `expand` (default
**true**: the reference lists the toasts; `false` = Sonner's stack), `richColors`, `invert`,
`hotkey` (`["altKey", "KeyT"]`), `offset` / `mobileOffset` (16px; number, length or per side),
`gap` (12), `swipeDirections`, `toastOptions` (defaults: `duration`, `closeButton`, `invert`,
`richColors`, `dismissible`), `icons` (`info` · `success` · `warning` · `error` · `loading` ·
`close`), `id` (+ toast `toasterId`), `dir` (native attribute). Not applicable: `className` /
`style` / `unstyled` per toast (CSS), `theme` (follows the page scheme).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Toaster fixed `offset` from the edges (16px; `mobileOffset` under 600px, mobile-first: private
`--_ok-toaster-[mobile-]<side>` from React `style` / the HTML runtime through CSSOM), width
min(300px, 100% − the side offsets), gap `--_ok-toast-gap` (12px); centered positions use
`margin-inline: auto` (no transform: lists of other positions are `position: fixed` inside the
section); bottom positions stack newest nearest the edge. Stacked (`expand` false): toasts 2–3
sit behind the newest at its size (`inset: 0`), 16 / 32px lower (higher at the bottom), scaled
0.95 / 0.9, content hidden; later ones hidden; `:hover`, `:focus-within` or `data-ok-expanded`
lists them. Rich colors: status `lighter` background, `darker` text (as Label inverted). Invert:
default toasts paper, typed toasts grey-800 (reversed in dark). Logical properties inside the
toast (padding, close button at the inline start), so `dir="rtl"` mirrors it. Default toast: inverted (grey-800 / white, dark scheme reversed via
`light-dark()`), padding 8px 8px 8px 12px. Typed toasts: `--ok-bg-paper`, padding 4px 8px 4px 4px,
icon box 48px radius `--ok-radius-lg` tinted with the status channel / 0.08, icon 24px in the
status main color. Radius `--ok-radius-lg`, `--ok-shadow-z8`, 13px (`--ok-font-size-sm`), title
500. Close button 24px circle at the top-left corner, shown on hover / focus (always on touch).
Entry: slide 50% + fade (`--ok-duration-short`); no exit animation.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Never wider than the viewport minus 32px; centered positions stay centered.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Polite live region; toasts never take focus. Time pauses while the toaster is hovered or focused.
Escape closes a focused toast (unless not dismissible). The loading toast has a named progress.
Swipe to dismiss (core `createToastSwipe`, both owners): a pointer drag from the toast (not its
buttons) along an allowed direction past 45px or faster than 0.11px/ms closes it; otherwise it
springs back; directions default to the toaster's edges (`top` / `bottom`, plus `left` / `right`
for corners). The close button and Escape stay the single-pointer / keyboard path (WCAG 2.5.7):
with `closeButton` it is always shown on touch screens. Hotkey (core `createToasterHotkey`):
expands the toaster (`data-ok-expanded`) and focuses its first non-empty list (`tabindex=-1`,
written then); Escape or the focus leaving collapses it.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:toaster:show`, `ok:toaster:dismiss` (`detail.reason`, now also `"swipe"`),
`ok:toaster:action` (cancelable). Instance: `{ show(options), showTemplate(template),
promise(promise, messages), dismiss(id?), getToasts(), getHistory() }` — `show()` builds nodes
from text only and takes `position`, `closeButton`, `invert`, `richColors`; `promise` takes
`description` and `finally` (the HTML instance returns the id string: the caller holds the
promise, so no `unwrap()`). Several toasters: one instance each; triggers pick one with
`data-ok-toast-toaster`. `toastOptions` / `icons` are React-only by nature (nodes): HTML toaster
attributes are the defaults, and templates carry their own icons.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against Sonner docs (`toast()`, `<Toaster>`) and its `types.ts` / `state.ts`.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toast()`, `toast.message` / `info` / `success` / `warning` / `error` / `loading` / `promise` / `custom` / `dismiss(id?)` | same (React `toast`; HTML instance `show` / `showTemplate` / `promise` / `dismiss`) | kept | |
| `toast.custom(jsx(id))` | `toast.custom(content)` | renamed | content, not a function of the id |
| toast `id`, `description`, `action`, `cancel`, `duration`, `icon`, `dismissible`, `onDismiss`, `onAutoClose` | same | kept | |
| toast `position` | same; HTML `show({ position })` / `li[data-ok-position]` | kept | 4.14: a list per position |
| toast `richColors`, Toaster `richColors` | same; HTML `data-ok-rich-colors` | kept | 4.14 |
| toast `closeButton`, `invert`; Toaster `invert`, `toastOptions`, `icons` | same (React); HTML `data-ok-invert`, `show({ closeButton, invert })` | kept | 4.18.38; `toastOptions` / `icons` React only (HTML: toaster attributes, templates) |
| `toasterId`, Toaster `id` (several toasters) | same; HTML one instance per toaster, trigger `data-ok-toast-toaster` | kept | 4.18.40 |
| `toast.promise` result `unwrap()`, promise options (`finally`, `id`, other toast options) | same (React); HTML `finally`, `description` | kept | 4.18.41: the id is boxed (`ok.valueOf()` for `===`) like Sonner |
| `toast.getHistory()`, `toast.getToasts()`, `useSonner()` | same; HTML instance `getHistory()` / `getToasts()` (elements) | kept | 4.18.41 |
| Toaster `position`, `duration`, `visibleToasts`, `closeButton` | same | kept | |
| Toaster `expand`, `swipeDirections` (swipe to dismiss), `hotkey`, `offset` / `mobileOffset`, `gap` | same; HTML `data-ok-expand="false"`, `data-ok-swipe-directions`, `data-ok-hotkey`, `data-ok-offset` / `data-ok-mobile-offset` (one length), `data-ok-gap` | renamed | 4.14: `expand` defaults to `true` (the reference); per-side offsets React only |
| Toaster `dir` | native `dir` (React prop passes through) | kept | 4.18.37: logical properties in the toast |
| Toaster `theme` | page scheme | not applicable | follows `data-ok-theme` |
| Toaster `containerAriaLabel` / `customAriaLabel` | `aria-label` ("Notifications") | renamed | |
| `className`, `classNames`, `style`, `unstyled`, `descriptionClassName`, `actionButtonStyle`, `cancelButtonStyle`, `testId` | — | not applicable | CSS on `[data-ok-toast*]`; DOM attributes |
