sections.body:
A list whose items the user reorders — by dragging, by keyboard, or by two taps — and optionally
removes.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ul[data-ok-sortable][data-ok-layout][aria-label][id]?[data-ok-group]?[data-ok-accept]?
   [data-ok-strategy="swap"]?[data-ok-activator="item"]?      React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
  li[data-ok-sortable-item][data-ok-dragging | data-ok-grabbed]?[data-ok-disabled]?[data-ok-swap-target]?
    … content (yours), may hold [data-ok-sortable-move-to="<list id>"] triggers (buttons, menu items)
    div[data-ok-sortable-actions]
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-size="sm"][data-ok-sortable-remove][aria-label]?  (optional)
      button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-size="sm"][data-ok-sortable-handle][aria-label][aria-pressed][disabled]?
  template[data-ok-sortable-template]?                          HTML only: markup of new items
[add trigger] button[data-ok-sortable-add="<list id>"]          HTML only
div[data-ok-sortable-announcer][aria-live="polite"]             created once per document (visually hidden)
```
Scrolling (vertical / horizontal): wrap the list in a Scrollbar — `section[data-ok-scrollbar] ›
ul[data-ok-sortable]`. The Scrollbar then scrolls and carries the dashed frame; the list grows
freely (`:has(> [data-ok-sortable])`). A list without a Scrollbar still scrolls itself (as before).
Handles and remove buttons are Icon buttons (`default`, `sm`), so they share its CSS.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `sortable`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| item markup | `items` + `getKey` + `renderItem` | your data |
| move handling | `onReorder(items)` (controlled) | |
| `data-ok-sortable-remove` buttons | `onRemove(item, index)` (renders the buttons) | none |
| handle / remove names | `getItemLabel(item, index)` → `Reorder …` / `Remove …` | `Item <n>` |
| `data-ok-group="<name>"` on the list | `group` | lists of the same group exchange items (ADR-0053) |
| `data-ok-accept="<names>"` (spaces) | `accept` (string or array) | groups the list takes from; default its own |
| `id` on the list | `id` (falls back to `useId()` with a group) | names lists in transfers and move-to triggers |
| `ok:sortable:transfer` (cancelable) · instance `transfer` | `onTransfer({ item, from, to, fromIndex, index })` + `moveBetweenLists(lists, event)` | without `onTransfer` a React list never gives items |
| `[data-ok-sortable-move-to="<list id>"]` inside an item | same attribute (in `renderItem`) | moves the item to that list's end |
| `li[data-ok-disabled]` + the handle's `disabled` | `isItemDisabled(item, index)` | the item never moves and isn't a target |
| `ok:sortable:dragstart` · `dragover` · `dragend` · `dragcancel` (`detail: { item, index, list }`) | `onDragStart` · `onDragOver` · `onDragEnd` · `onDragCancel` (`{ item, index, list }`, `list` = id) | to the owner of the list holding the item |
| `data-ok-message-<grabbed\|moved\|moved-to-list\|dropped\|cancelled\|removed>` (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`) | `messages` | announcement texts |
| `ok:sortable:swap` (cancelable, `detail: { from, to, item, target }`) · instance `swap(from, to)` | `onReorder(arraySwap(items, from, to))` | swap lists (`strategy="swap"`) |
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Items: background `channel(grey-500)` 4 %, 1px border 16 %, radius `--ok-radius-lg`; actions at the
  top end. Remove buttons appear on item hover / focus-within, always on touch (`hover: none`).
- `grid`: columns of at least 160px (`auto-fill`), gap 20px.
- `vertical`: one column, at most 480px wide and 560px tall (scrolls), dashed frame, padding 20px.
- `horizontal`: one row of 144px items that scrolls horizontally, dashed frame, padding 20px.
- An empty list with a group keeps a block size of 80px (a drop target).
- Dragging: the item follows the pointer above the others (`--ok-shadow-z16`); grabbed (keyboard /
  tap): `--ok-shadow-z8` and a 2px outline in `--ok-text-secondary`.
- Swap target (`data-ok-swap-target`): a 2px dashed outline in `--ok-text-secondary`; previewed
  items slide (`transform`, `--ok-duration-short`) while a target exists, never when the swap is
  applied.
- `activator="item"`: items show `cursor: grab`, `touch-action: none` and `user-select: none`
  (touch drags start on the item, so the page scrolls only outside the items on touch screens).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
The controller reports intent (`onMove(from, to)`, `onRemove(index)`); the owner reorders its state
(React) or the DOM (HTML runtime). It re-reads the DOM on every step, so async owners work.
- **Pointer drag** (mouse, touch, pen) on the handle: starts after 4px; the item follows the pointer;
  moving over another item moves it there. Release drops; `pointercancel` / Escape restore the start
  position.
- **Keyboard / taps** on the handle: Space / Enter / click grabs; Arrow keys move it (vertical: ↑↓,
  horizontal: ←→, grid: ←→ ±1 and ↑↓ ± one row); Space / Enter / click drops; Escape cancels;
  focus leaving the list drops. Clicking another item's handle while one is grabbed moves it there.
  Focus stays on the moved handle.
- **Remove:** reported for the item; focus moves to the next item's handle (or the previous one).
- **Several lists** (ADR-0053): lists with the same `data-ok-group` (or a target whose
  `data-ok-accept` names the source's group) exchange items. Controllers register in a
  module-scoped registry per document; the grab / drag is one session per document, continued by
  the controller of the list holding the item, and every intent goes to that list's owner
  (`onTransfer({ item, from, to, fromIndex, index })`, `false` refuses). React may render the moved
  item as a new element: the session resolves to it (same node in the target, or the target's item
  at `index` once the old one is gone; refused after 8 frames) and moves its flags and focus there.
  Pointer: over another list's item → its index; over another list's box (or its Scrollbar) → its
  end. Keys: vertical ←/→, horizontal ↑/↓ go to the previous / next accepting list (document
  order, index kept); grids go there when ←/→ pass the first / last item. Taps: a grabbed item
  goes to the tapped handle's position in another list. `[data-ok-sortable-move-to]` moves an item
  to that list's end (single-pointer alternative; the Kanban story composes a Menu). Escape puts it
  back in its start list. Announced with `movedToList` (the list's `aria-label`).
- **Announcements** (polite live region): grabbed, moved, dropped, cancelled, removed — with
  positions ("position 3 of 12"). HTML replaces them with `data-ok-message-*` on the list (read when
  announced; `{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
- **Disabled items** (`data-ok-disabled`, dnd-kit `disabled: true`): can't be grabbed, dragged or
  moved by a trigger; the pointer over one moves nothing; keys skip them (the item jumps past, or
  stays when only disabled items are left in that direction). Other items may still move past
  them, which shifts them by one (as upstream).
- **Drag events:** `onDragStart` on a grab or once a drag starts; `onDragOver` before each move
  (the target index and list); `onDragEnd` on a drop (where it landed); `onDragCancel` before the
  item goes back. Each goes to the owner of the list holding the item.
- **Swap strategy** (`data-ok-strategy="swap"`, dnd-kit `rectSwappingStrategy` + `arraySwap`):
  nothing moves in the DOM while dragging. The target (the item under the pointer, hit-tested on
  the items' resting boxes; or the arrow keys' target, moved from the last one and skipping
  disabled items) gets `data-ok-swap-target` and a transform onto the item's place; without a
  pointer the item moves onto the target's place too. Back over the item's own place (or keys
  back to it) clears the preview. Drop (pointer up, Space / Enter, focus leaving, a tap on
  another handle) reports `onSwap(from, to)`; Escape and `pointercancel` clear it. Moves to other
  lists of a group still insert (the preview is cleared first). Announcements reuse `moved` /
  `dropped` with the target's position.
- **Whole-item drags** (`data-ok-activator="item"`, dnd-kit without `setActivatorNodeRef`): a
  pointer press anywhere on an item starts the drag, except on controls inside it (links,
  buttons, fields, `label`, `summary`, editable content, `[tabindex]`), which keep their presses.
  Mouse presses are `preventDefault()`ed (no text selection, no native image drag). The handle
  stays the keyboard path and the single-pointer alternative (two taps).
- **Auto scroll** (on unless `data-ok-auto-scroll="false"`): while a pointer drag is near an edge
  (a fifth of the container, at most 80px) of a scrolling ancestor of the item, or of the window,
  the nearest one that can scroll on that axis scrolls up to 20px per frame (full speed past the
  edge), within the scroll size measured when the container was first met (the dragged item's
  transform would grow it). Items under the pointer move meanwhile. Keys scroll the item into view.
sections.title: Behavior (`core` `createSortableController`)

sections.body:
| Key (handle focused) | Action |
|---|---|
| Space / Enter | grab · drop |
| Arrow keys (grabbed) | move by one (grid: ↑↓ by a row) |
| ←/→ (vertical) · ↑/↓ (horizontal) · ←/→ past the ends (grid) | move to the previous / next list of the group |
| Escape (grabbed) | cancel, back to the start position |
| Tab (grabbed) | drop, then move focus |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
Handles and remove buttons need names (`aria-label`); the handle is `aria-pressed="true"` while
grabbed. Dragging has single-pointer and keyboard alternatives (WCAG 2.5.7, 2.1.1). The list needs a
name (`aria-label`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:sortable:move` (cancelable, `detail: { from, to, item }`), `ok:sortable:swap`
(cancelable, `detail: { from, to, item, target }`, swap lists), `ok:sortable:transfer`
(cancelable, `detail: { item, from, to, index }`, on the list it leaves), `ok:sortable:remove`
(cancelable, `detail: { index, item }`), `ok:sortable:add` (after a template clone is inserted,
`detail: { item, index }` — fill its content here). Instance: `move(from, to)`, `swap(from, to)`, `remove(index)`, `transfer(index, to, toIndex?)`.
React: `onReorder`, `onRemove`; helpers `arrayMove(items, from, to)`, `arraySwap(items, from, to)`; `messages?:
Partial<SortableMessages>` localizes the announcements (`grabbed`, `moved`, `dropped`, `cancelled`,
`removed`, `movedToList`, each `(position, total, list) => string`, `list` = the list's
`aria-label`; defaults from `defaultSortableMessages`). React: `group`, `accept`, `onTransfer`,
helper `moveBetweenLists`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Grid columns follow the width (one column at 320px). Vertical and horizontal lists scroll inside the
Scrollbar around them (which carries the frame); the page never scrolls horizontally.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: Minimals "Dnd" on dnd-kit — `DndContext`, `SortableContext`, `useSortable` (legacy
`@dnd-kit/sortable` docs, dndkit.com/legacy/…, and `@dnd-kit/react` `useSortable`, checked
2026-11-09). Owlky is one component, not a toolkit: rows map dnd-kit concepts to it.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SortableContext items`, `arrayMove`, `onDragEnd` reorder | `items` + `onReorder(items)`, `arrayMove` · `ok:sortable:move` | renamed | controlled list |
| `useSortable id`, `index` | `getKey(item)`, position | renamed | |
| `strategy` `rectSortingStrategy` / `verticalList…` / `horizontalList…` | `layout` (`grid` · `vertical` · `horizontal`) | renamed | |
| `strategy` `rectSwappingStrategy`, `arraySwap` | `strategy="swap"` · `data-ok-strategy="swap"`, `arraySwap` · `ok:sortable:swap` | renamed | one strategy per list; moves between lists still insert |
| `sensors` (Pointer, Keyboard, `sortableKeyboardCoordinates`) | pointer + keyboard + two taps, built in | kept | activation distance fixed (4px) |
| `useSortable handle` / `handleRef` | handle button (always) | kept | |
| `setActivatorNodeRef` omitted (the whole item drags) | `activator="item"` · `data-ok-activator="item"` | renamed | the handle stays for keys and taps (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.5.7); controls inside an item keep their presses |
| `accessibility.announcements` | `messages` (React), `data-ok-message-*` (HTML) | renamed | `screenReaderInstructions`: part of `grabbed` |
| `useSortable disabled` (`true`) | `isItemDisabled` · `li[data-ok-disabled]` | renamed | the `{ draggable, droppable }` object form: not offered |
| `onDragStart`, `onDragOver`, `onDragEnd`, `onDragCancel` | same names · `ok:sortable:dragstart` / `dragover` / `dragend` / `dragcancel` | kept | the React ones replace the `ul`'s native HTML drag handlers |
| `onDragMove` | — | not applicable | every pointer move; `onDragOver` reports each new position |
| `cancelDrop` | cancelable `ok:sortable:move`; React refuses by not updating `items` | renamed | |
| `autoScroll` (boolean) | `autoScroll` · `data-ok-auto-scroll="false"` | kept | its options (`threshold`, `acceleration`, `interval`, `canScroll`, `order`): fixed values |
| `modifiers` (restrict to an axis, to the parent) | layout axis | not applicable | the item follows the pointer inside the list |
| `DragOverlay` | the dragged item itself (`data-ok-dragging`) | not applicable | |
| several lists: `group`, `accept`, multiple `SortableContext`s / one `DragDropProvider`, `onDragOver` between containers | `group`, `accept` on the list · `onTransfer` · `ok:sortable:transfer` | renamed | ADR-0053: list attributes, not per item; groups connect lists of the page |
| `move(items, event)` (`@dnd-kit/helpers`) | `moveBetweenLists(lists, event)` | renamed | record of arrays keyed by list id |
| `useDroppable` columns (empty lists) | empty lists of a group are drop targets (min block size) | kept | |
| `type`, `accept` predicate `(source) => boolean` | — | deferred | one kind of item per list; HTML can't express a predicate |
| `collisionDetection`, `collisionPriority`, `layoutMeasuring`, `plugins`, `effects`, `transition`, `target`, `element`, returned refs / flags | — | not applicable | engine internals; `data-ok-dragging` / `data-ok-grabbed` are the flags |
| — | `onRemove`, remove buttons, HTML add template | kept | Owlky additions (reference) |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
- "Add item" is app logic: React adds to `items`; HTML clones `template[data-ok-sortable-template]`
  on `[data-ok-sortable-add]` and emits `ok:sortable:add`.
- Announcements: React accepts `messages`; the HTML runtime uses the English defaults.
- Moves between lists: React lists need `onTransfer` (state); HTML moves the node. React and HTML
  lists can't be mixed in one group. The Kanban story's "Move" menus list every column (choosing
  the current one does nothing), so both stay equal after moves.

sections.body:
Progress through numbered steps (wizard, checkout). Presentational: the app owns the active step.
CSS for the look; core `stepState` derives each step's state (React and the HTML runtime
`stepper`); `mobile-stepper` keeps the compact bar in step.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ol[data-ok-stepper][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-variant][data-ok-alternative-label]?[data-ok-active-step][aria-label]
  li[data-ok-step][data-ok-active | data-ok-completed | data-ok-disabled][aria-current="step"]?
    div[data-ok-step-connector][aria-hidden="true"] › span[data-ok-step-connector-line]   (index > 0)
    span[data-ok-step-label][data-ok-error]?
      span[data-ok-step-icon][data-ok-custom]?[aria-hidden="true"]
        span[data-ok-step-icon-text] svg[data-ok-step-icon-check] svg[data-ok-step-icon-error]
        (custom: the icon node)
      span[data-ok-step-label-text]
        span[data-ok-step-label-title] span[data-ok-step-label-optional]?
    div[data-ok-collapse][data-ok-timeout="auto"][data-ok-step-content][hidden]?           (vertical; a Collapse)
[data-ok-stepper-panel="<id>"][data-ok-stepper-panel-step]?   (HTML: shown at its step)
button[data-ok-stepper-next | -back | -reset="<id> …"]       (HTML triggers)

div[data-ok-mobile-stepper][data-ok-variant][data-ok-position][data-ok-steps][data-ok-active-step]
  (back button) · span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-text] | span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-dots][role="img"][aria-label]
  › span[data-ok-mobile-stepper-dot][data-ok-active]? | span[data-ok-linear-progress][data-ok-mobile-stepper-progress] · (next button)
```
The connector sits inside the `li` (an `ol` may only hold `li`; MUI puts it between them unless
`alternativeLabel`).
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `stepper`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `step`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `step-label`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `mobile-stepper`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `div[data-ok-step-connector]` | `Stepper connector` (default `<StepConnector />`, `null`: none) | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-label-title]` | `StepLabel children` | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-label-optional]` | `StepLabel optional` | node |
| `span[data-ok-step-icon]` content (+ `data-ok-custom` for a node) | `StepLabel icon` | text, number or node |
| `div[data-ok-collapse][data-ok-timeout="auto"][data-ok-step-content][hidden]?` | `StepContent` | node (a Collapse, `hidden` off the active step) |
| buttons in the bar (`data-ok-mobile-stepper-back` / `-next`) | `backButton` / `nextButton` | node |
| `data-ok-label-step` (`{step}`, `{steps}`) | `getStepLabel(step, steps)` | default "Step 2 of 3" |

API mapping (MUI): kept Stepper `activeStep`, `alternativeLabel`, `orientation`, `connector`;
Step `active`, `completed`, `disabled`, `index`; StepLabel `error`, `optional`, `icon`;
StepContent; MobileStepper `steps`, `activeStep`, `variant`, `position`, `backButton`,
`nextButton`. Beyond MUI (reference "Customized stepper"): Stepper `variant` (`dot`, `circle`);
`getStepLabel` (accessible name of dots / bar, MUI has none). Deferred (roadmap backlog):
`nonLinear`, `StepButton`, Step `expanded` / `last`, StepContent `TransitionComponent` /
`transitionDuration` / `TransitionProps` (it is always a Collapse with `timeout="auto"`, MUI's defaults),
MobileStepper `LinearProgressProps`. Not applicable: `component`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `classes`,
`sx`, `StepIconComponent` / `StepIconProps` (use `icon`).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Horizontal: flex row; steps padding-inline 8px; steps after the first grow and start with their
connector (shrinks to 0 like MUI, 8px before the icon). Icon 24px circle, `--ok-font-size-xs` white number;
not reached `--ok-palette-grey-600` (AA for the white number), active / completed
`--ok-palette-primary-main` (completed shows a check), error `--ok-palette-error-main` with "!".
Title body2, `--ok-text-secondary` / weight regular; active and completed `--ok-text-primary`,
medium; error `--ok-palette-error-text`. Optional caption `--ok-text-secondary`. Line 1px
`--ok-divider`. Alternative label: steps share the width (`flex: 1 1 0`), titles 16px below the
icon, connector absolute at the icon's middle, 8px from each icon. Vertical: label padding 8px 0;
connector 24px tall, 12px in; content 12px in, padding 0 8px 0 20px, 1px line (not on the last
step). `dot`: 22px icon box with an 8px dot, completed check, 3px lines, active / completed lines
primary. `circle`: 50px circles, `rgb(grey-500 / 0.24)`, active / completed gradient
`warning-main → error-main` (active `--ok-shadow-z8`), 3px lines with the gradient.
Mobile: flex, space-between, 8px padding and gap, `--ok-bg-paper`; `bottom` / `top` fixed at
`--ok-z-mobile-stepper` (new token, 1000 like MUI); dots 8px, 2px apart, `grey-500 / 0.8`, active
primary; progress bar 50% wide (LinearProgress `inherit`).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Step flags `data-ok-active`, `data-ok-completed`, `data-ok-disabled` (linear: before / at / after
the active step; explicit Step props win), `aria-current="step"` on the active one; StepLabel
`data-ok-error`; StepContent shows on the active step only: it carries `hidden` on the others
(React from the step context, HTML runtime on every step change) and the Collapse animates its
height (collapse.md); the CSS rule on inactive steps stays for markup without the runtime.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
React: `Stepper` clones its direct `Step` children with `index`; each step reads `activeStep`
from context. `activeStep === steps.length` → all completed. HTML runtime `stepper`: derives the
flags from `data-ok-active-step` on mount and on every move; triggers (`data-ok-stepper-next` /
`-back` / `-reset`, several space-separated ids move several steppers) move it; panels
`data-ok-stepper-panel="<id>"` show at their index (or `data-ok-stepper-panel-step`); Back
triggers are disabled on the first step. `mobile-stepper`: updates text, dots (count from
`data-ok-steps`), progress value (`mobileStepperProgress`, MUI rounding) and labels; Back / Next
inside the bar (empty value) or naming it; disabled at the ends; panels
`data-ok-mobile-stepper-panel="<id>"`.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Steps aren't interactive (MUI linear). The app's Back / Next buttons are native buttons.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`ol` named by `aria-label`; `aria-current="step"`; icons `aria-hidden` (the title names the step);
mobile dots `role="img"` and the bar named "Step n of m" (`getStepLabel` / `data-ok-label-step`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:stepper:change` and `ok:mobile-stepper:change` (cancelable) — `detail: { activeStep,
previous }`. Instances → `{ activeStep, setActiveStep(step), go(step) }` (`setActiveStep` emits
nothing). React: no callbacks (the app owns `activeStep`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same sizes at every breakpoint. On narrow screens titles wrap inside their steps, and a word
breaks only when it can't fit on its own line (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`), so a horizontal stepper
never overflows; `vertical` or `MobileStepper` read better on phones.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Stepper`, `Step`, `StepLabel`, `StepContent`, `StepIcon`, `StepConnector`,
`StepButton`, `MobileStepper` (mui.com/material-ui/api/stepper …, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stepper `activeStep`, `alternativeLabel`, `orientation` | same / `data-ok-active-step`, `-alternative-label`, `-orientation` | kept | |
| Stepper `connector` | `connector` / `div[data-ok-step-connector]` | kept | `null`: none |
| Stepper `children` | `children` | kept | |
| Stepper `nonLinear` | same / `data-ok-non-linear` | kept (4.10) | core `stepState(…, nonLinear)`: only the active step is derived; HTML leaves `data-ok-completed` / `-disabled` as written |
| Stepper `component` | — | not applicable | root is `ol` |
| — | Stepper `variant` (`dot`, `circle`) | kept | Owlky addition (reference "Customized") |
| Step `active`, `completed`, `disabled`, `index` | same / `data-ok-active`, `-completed`, `-disabled` | kept | |
| Step `expanded`, `last` | same / `data-ok-expanded`, `data-ok-last` | kept (4.10) | `expanded` keeps `StepContent` open; `last` = `:last-child` for wrapped lists |
| Step `component` | — | not applicable | `li` |
| StepButton (`icon`, `optional`, `children`) | `StepButton` / `button[data-ok-step-button]` › StepLabel markup | kept (4.10) | disabled with its step; HTML runtime moves to the pressed step |
| StepLabel `children`, `error`, `optional`, `icon` | same / `data-ok-error`, `-step-label-optional`, `-step-icon` | kept | |
| StepLabel `slots.stepIcon` / `StepIconComponent` | `icon` (node) | renamed | composition |
| StepIcon `active`, `completed`, `error`, `icon` | step / label state | not applicable | internal part, state from the step |
| StepContent `children` | `StepContent` (a Collapse, `timeout="auto"`) | kept | |
| StepContent `transitionDuration` | same (React) → Collapse `timeout`; HTML `data-ok-timeout` on the content | kept (4.18.74) | ms or `auto` (default) |
| MobileStepper `steps`, `activeStep`, `variant`, `position`, `backButton`, `nextButton` | same / `data-ok-steps`, … | kept | |
| — | MobileStepper `getStepLabel` / `data-ok-label-step` | kept | Owlky addition (name of dots / bar) |
| MobileStepper Paper props (`elevation`, `square`) | — | not applicable | bar keeps the paper background; compose a Paper around it |
| MobileStepper `slots` / `slotProps` (`root`, `dot`, `dots`, `progress`) | — | not applicable | composition |
| `classes`, `sx`, StepContent `slots.transition` | — | not applicable | by decision |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
MobileStepper renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` in React. HTML-only hooks (triggers, panels,
`data-ok-label-step`) are ignored by parity; React demos render the same buttons with handlers.
Stories compose the reference's surfaces: step text in a flat Paper (`elevation={0}`, tinted by
demo CSS), the mobile demos in an outlined Paper with a Divider above the MobileStepper.

sections.body:
Turn one setting on or off, with immediate effect. A native checkbox with `role="switch"`; CSS
only. Labels come from `FormControlLabel`. Used by Table's "Dense" toggle.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
span[data-ok-switch][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][data-ok-edge]?
  input[type=checkbox][role=switch][data-ok-switch-input]   (covers the target, opacity 0)
  span[data-ok-switch-track][aria-hidden="true"]
  span[data-ok-switch-thumb][aria-hidden="true"]
    span[data-ok-switch-icon]?            (icon: shown while off, and while on without a checked icon)
    span[data-ok-switch-checked-icon]?    (checkedIcon: shown while on)
```
React `ref` and the remaining props go to the **input**; `className` / `style` to the root.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `switch`: listed under "options".)

React only: `onChange(checked)`. `icon` / `checkedIcon` (React nodes) render the thumb's
icon parts; HTML writes the same parts in the thumb. CSS picks the one for the state (`:has(> input:checked)`):
icons are centered in the thumb at 80% of its size, `--ok-text-secondary`, the checked icon in the
track color (`--_ok-main`). Upstream `disableRipple`, `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps` don't apply.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Medium: track 34 × 20px (`--ok-spacing` × 8.5 × 5), thumb 14px (× 3.5), inset 3px (× 0.75),
  root padding 9px 12px → 58 × 38px. Small: track 26 × 16px, thumb 10px, padding 4px 7px → 40 × 24px.
- Track off: `rgb(--ok-palette-grey-500-channel / 0.48)`; on: `--ok-c-main` (`default` =
  `--ok-text-primary`; its thumb is `grey-800` in dark schemes via `light-dark()`).
- Thumb white, `--ok-shadow-z1`; moves `track − thumb − 2 × inset` (14px / 10px);
  `--ok-duration-shortest` `--ok-easing-standard`.
- Hover: a 9px halo (main channel at 0.08, off: `--ok-action-hover`). Focus-visible: 2px
  `--ok-text-primary` ring around the track, offset 2px. Disabled: track opacity 0.48.
- `edge`: −8px margin on that side.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Fixed size at every breakpoint; targets ≥ 24px high. Rows wrap.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: From the input via `:has()`: `:checked`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible`, plus `:hover`.
sections.title: States

sections.body: Native toggling; no runtime.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focus the switch |
| Space | Toggle |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role="switch"` (announced on / off). Name from the label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
Off track ≈ 1.6:1 on white: follows the reference (approved); the white thumb with its shadow

sections.body:
Native `<table>` markup with the Minimal look, plus the interactive parts tables need: sortable
headers, row selection, collapsible detail rows and pagination. React leaves data to the app (like
MUI); the HTML runtime sorts, selects and pages the rows already in the DOM.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
section[data-ok-table-container]                          holds the table (overflow: visible with a Scrollbar)
  section[data-ok-scrollbar][aria-label][tabindex=0]       scrolls — the Scrollbar component (set a max-height for a sticky header)
    table[data-ok-table][data-ok-size][data-ok-padding][data-ok-sticky-header]?[id]   React: + data-ok-runtime="off"
      thead › tr › th[scope=col][aria-sort]?[data-ok-align]?[data-ok-padding]?
        button[type=button][data-ok-table-sort-label][data-ok-direction][data-ok-active]?[data-ok-hide-sort-icon]?
          … label, span[data-ok-table-sort-icon][aria-hidden=true] › svg (arrow down; rotated when ascending)
        span[data-ok-checkbox][data-ok-size="small"] › input[type=checkbox][data-ok-checkbox-input][data-ok-table-select-all][aria-label]   selection column (a Checkbox; a bare input still works)
      tbody
        tr[data-ok-hover]?[data-ok-selected]?
          td | th[scope=row] [data-ok-align]?[data-ok-padding]?[data-ok-size]?
          span[data-ok-checkbox][data-ok-size="small"] › input[…][data-ok-table-select][aria-label]   in a selection cell
          button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-table-expand=<detail id>][aria-expanded][aria-controls][aria-label]
        tr[data-ok-table-detail][id][hidden]? › td[colspan]                 detail row of the row above
      tfoot? › tr › td
div[data-ok-table-pagination=<table id>]                                   React: value "" + data-ok-runtime="off"
  label[data-ok-table-pagination-rows] › "Rows per page:" select          (only with 2+ options)
  span[data-ok-table-pagination-displayed][aria-live=polite] "1–5 of 12"
  div[data-ok-table-pagination-actions] › button[data-ok-icon-button][data-ok-table-pagination-action=first|previous|next|last][aria-label][title][disabled]?
```
Sort labels go in the last header row (one header cell per column). Detail rows follow the row
they belong to; sorting and paging move and hide them together with it.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `table`: listed under "options".)

Sort label:
(Options of `table-sort-label`: listed under "options".)

Cell overrides (`TableCell` props ↔ attributes, absent = inherit the table's): `align`
(`left` `center` `right` `justify`; numbers are right-aligned) → `data-ok-align`, `padding` →
`data-ok-padding`, `size` → `data-ok-size`, `sortDirection` (`asc` `desc` `false`) → `aria-sort`,
`scope`. Row: `hover` → `data-ok-hover`, `selected` → `data-ok-selected`.

Pagination (`TablePagination` ↔ HTML): `count` (`-1` = unknown) ↔ number of row groups or
`data-ok-count`; `page` (0-based) ↔ `data-ok-page`; `rowsPerPage` ↔ the selected `<option>`;
`rowsPerPageOptions` (default `[10, 25, 50, 100]`, `-1` = all) ↔ the `<option>`s;
`onPageChange(page)` / `onRowsPerPageChange(rowsPerPage)` ↔ `ok:table-pagination:change`;
`labelRowsPerPage`, `labelDisplayedRows({ from, to, count, page })`, `getItemAriaLabel(type)`,
`showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`, `disabled` ↔ markup.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Cells: body2, `--ok-text-primary`, padding 16px (`small`: 6px / 16px), bottom border `1px dashed
  --ok-divider`; `checkbox` padding: 48px wide, 8px start; `none`: 0.
- Header: `--ok-bg-neutral` band, `--ok-text-secondary`, weight 600, 24px line (56px row); sticky:
  `--ok-bg-paper`, z-index 2, a second header row sticks below the first.
- Footer: caption, secondary text.
- Rows: hover `--ok-action-hover` (hover-capable devices); selected primary channel 8 % (12 % hovered).
- Sort label: arrow 18px, hidden when inactive (50 % on hover / focus), shown when active; text
  primary when active or hovered. `hideSortIcon`: no arrow while inactive.
- Detail row: `--ok-bg-neutral`; the expand button's chevron turns 180° when open.
- Pagination: flex, wraps, right-aligned, 16px gaps, min-height 64px; prev/next are small icon
  buttons; the rows-per-page `<select>` is native by default. `selectProps={{ native: false }}`
  (MUI `SelectProps`) composes a bare listbox Select instead (additive):
  `div[data-ok-table-pagination-rows] › span[id] (the label) + div[data-ok-select]` (no variant:
  table.css draws it, 32px, no line, a focus ring); the HTML runtime listens to its
  `ok:select:change` (refused when `ok:table-pagination:change` is prevented) and reads the
  hidden input for the first rows per page. Story "Table pagination with API" (search TextField
  + category Select; HTML: a page script filters the rows the runtime pages).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
- React: data is the app's (sort, select, page in state; `compareCellValues`, `nextSortDirection`,
  `pageRange`, `selectAllState` from `@owlky/core` help). `TableExpandButton` (`expanded`,
  `controls` = the detail row's `id`, `aria-label`) and `TableDetailRow` (`id`, `open`,
  `colSpan: number` — required, the number of columns to span) take their state from the app.
- HTML runtime (`table`, `table-pagination`):
  - sort label click → cancelable `ok:table:sort` `{ column, direction }` → rows (with their detail
    rows) reordered by `data-ok-sort-value` or the cell text (numbers numerically), `aria-sort` and
    the labels updated, pagination refreshed;
  - row checkbox → `data-ok-selected` on its row, the select-all checkbox updated (checked /
    indeterminate); select-all → every row (all pages); then `ok:table:select` `{ rows }`;
  - `input[data-ok-table-dense="<table id>"]` (a Switch under the table, story "Sorting &
    selecting") → the table's `data-ok-size` becomes `small` when checked, `medium` otherwise;
  - expand button → cancelable `ok:table:expand` `{ row, expanded }` → `hidden` and `aria-expanded`;
  - pagination → cancelable `ok:table-pagination:change` `{ page, rowsPerPage }` → rows outside the
    page get `hidden`, the label and buttons are updated. With `data-ok-count` (server-side) rows
    aren't touched: the app replaces them.
- With `Pagination` (story "Pagination with API"): React slices the rows for `page`; in HTML
  `nav[data-ok-pagination="<table id>"][data-ok-rows-per-page]` pages the rows the same way (see
  specs/components/pagination.md). Sorting refreshes either kind of pagination.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
Sort labels, checkboxes, expand and page buttons are native buttons / inputs (Tab, Enter / Space).
The Scrollbar inside the container is the focusable scroll region (arrow keys scroll it).
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
- `aria-sort` on the sorted header cell; checkboxes and icon buttons need names (`aria-label`).
- Name the Scrollbar (`aria-label`): it is the focusable region; the container stays unnamed and
  unfocusable. Without a Scrollbar, name the container instead: it scrolls natively (as before).
- The displayed-rows label is `aria-live="polite"`.
- Header text (`--ok-text-secondary` on `--ok-bg-neutral`) meets AA in both schemes.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
`ok:table:sort` (cancelable), `ok:table:select`, `ok:table:expand` (cancelable),
`ok:table-pagination:change` (cancelable). Instances: table `sort(column, direction?)`,
`expand(row, open?)`; pagination `page`, `rowsPerPage`, `setPage(page)`,
`setRowsPerPage(rows)`, `refresh()`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Mobile first: the container scrolls horizontally when the table is wider than the screen (the page
never overflows); pagination wraps onto two lines below ~420px. No breakpoint changes otherwise.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Table`, `TableContainer`, `TableHead` / `TableBody` / `TableFooter`, `TableRow`,
`TableCell`, `TableSortLabel`, `TablePagination` (mui.com/material-ui/api/table …, checked
2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Table `size`, `padding`, `stickyHeader` | same / `data-ok-size`, `-padding`, `-sticky-header` | kept | arbitrary size strings not applicable |
| Table / TableHead / TableBody / TableFooter / TableRow / TableContainer `component` | — | not applicable | native table elements (`div` tables: Data grid); container is a `section` |
| TableRow `hover`, `selected` | same / `data-ok-hover`, `data-ok-selected` | kept | |
| TableCell `align`, `padding`, `size`, `sortDirection`, `scope` | same / `data-ok-align`, `-padding`, `-size`, `aria-sort`, `scope` | kept | |
| TableCell `variant` (`head` · `body` · `footer`) | — | not applicable | from the section (`thead` / `tbody` / `tfoot`) |
| TableSortLabel `active`, `direction`, `hideSortIcon` | same | kept | |
| TableSortLabel `IconComponent` / `slots.icon` | `icon` | renamed | composition |
| TablePagination `count`, `page`, `rowsPerPage`, `rowsPerPageOptions` (numbers or `{ label, value }`) | same | kept | HTML: row groups, `data-ok-page`, `<option>`s |
| TablePagination `onPageChange(event, page)`, `onRowsPerPageChange(event)` | `onPageChange(page)`, `onRowsPerPageChange(rowsPerPage)` · `ok:table-pagination:change` | renamed | value-first callbacks |
| TablePagination `labelRowsPerPage`, `labelDisplayedRows`, `getItemAriaLabel`, `showFirstButton`, `showLastButton`, `disabled` | same | kept | |
| TablePagination `slotProps.select` (`SelectProps`) | `selectProps` (`native`, `menuProps`) | renamed | composes Select |
| TablePagination `ActionsComponent`, `slots` (`actions`, `toolbar`, `spacer`, `selectLabel`, `displayedRows`, `menuItem`) | — | not applicable | composition |
| TablePagination `component` (TableCell inside a `tfoot`) | `div` after the table | not applicable | keeps the table free of layout rows |
| — | `TableExpandButton`, `TableDetailRow`, HTML sort / select / page runtime | kept | Owlky additions (reference "Collapsible", HTML data) |
| `classes`, `sx` | — | not applicable | by decision |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
- Data: React renders the rows the app gives it (one page); the HTML runtime sorts, selects and
  pages the rows already in the DOM, hiding the others (`hidden`). Parity compares visible rows.
- `data-ok-table-pagination` holds the table `id` in HTML and is empty in React (the app links them).
- Scrolling: both wrap the table in a Scrollbar inside the container (`TableContainer › Scrollbar ›
  Table`); a named container without a Scrollbar still scrolls itself.

sections.body:
Switch between related views on one page (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern). A sliding indicator marks the
selected tab. Behavior is core `createTabsController` (keyboard, indicator, scroll buttons),
shared by React and the HTML runtime `tabs`; the owner applies the selection.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-tabs][data-ok-variant][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-text-color][data-ok-indicator-color][data-ok-scroll-buttons]…
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroll-button="start"][aria-hidden="true"] › svg      (scrollable, scrollButtons ≠ false)
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroller]
    div[role="tablist"][data-ok-tabs-list][aria-label | aria-labelledby][aria-orientation="vertical"]?
      button[type="button"][role="tab"][data-ok-tab][data-ok-icon-position]?[data-ok-wrapped]?
            [value][aria-selected][tabindex][id]?[aria-controls]?[disabled]?
        svg[aria-hidden="true"]? span[data-ok-tab-label]?
    span[data-ok-tabs-indicator]                     (--_ok-tabs-indicator-start / -size via CSSOM)
  div[data-ok-tabs-scroll-button="end"][aria-hidden="true"] › svg
div[role="tabpanel"][data-ok-tab-panel][id][aria-labelledby][tabindex="0"][hidden]?   (one per tab)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `tabs`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `tab`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `aria-selected="true"` on one tab | `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` | tab value or `false` (none) |
| `value` on the tab | `Tab value` | string; default the position (`"0"`, `"1"`, …) |
| `span[data-ok-tab-label]` | `Tab label` | node |
| `svg` in the tab | `Tab icon` | element (icon-only tabs need `aria-label`) |
| `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the tablist | same props on `Tabs` | string |
| `div[role="tabpanel"]` | `TabPanel` (DOM props; app sets `hidden`) | — |

API mapping (MUI): kept `value`, `onChange` (value-first: `onChange(value)`), `orientation`,
`variant`, `centered`, `textColor`, `indicatorColor` (+ `inherit`, the reference default),
`scrollButtons` (`"auto" | true | false`), `allowScrollButtonsMobile`, `visibleScrollbar`,
`selectionFollowsFocus`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`; Tab `value`, `label`, `icon`,
`iconPosition`, `wrapped`, `disabled`. Beyond MUI (reference "Custom" section): `segmented`;
`defaultValue` (uncontrolled, like the other components). Not applicable: `action`,
`TabIndicatorProps`, `TabScrollButton`, `ScrollButtonComponent`, `slots`, `slotProps`,
`classes`, `sx`, `component`, `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (no ripple).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Tabs: `min-height` 48px (`spacing × 12`), `min-width` 48px, padding 12px 0, gap 40px
(`spacing × 10`; `fullWidth`, vertical and segmented: 0), `subtitle2` size / line height, weight
`--ok-font-weight-medium`, selected `--ok-font-weight-semibold`. Colors: unselected
`--ok-text-secondary`, selected `--ok-text-primary` (or primary / secondary `main`). Icon 24px;
top / bottom: 72px tall, 9px padding, 6px gap; start / end: row, 8px gap. Disabled: opacity 0.48.
Indicator: 2px (`--ok-text-primary` or palette `main`), slides over `--ok-duration-standard`
(after the first measure: `data-ok-ready`). Segmented: bar `--ok-bg-neutral`, `--ok-radius-md`,
list padding 0 8px (vertical 8px 0), tabs 52px tall, padding-inline 16px; indicator `::after` pill
inset 6px, `--ok-bg-paper`, `--ok-shadow-z1`, `--ok-radius-md`. Scroll buttons 40px wide,
opacity 0.8 (0 at an edge).
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
`aria-selected="true"` (selected), `:focus-visible` (2px `--ok-text-primary` outline, inset),
`:disabled`. Controller flags: `data-ok-can-scroll-start` / `-end` on the root (scroll buttons),
`data-ok-ready` on the indicator.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
- Click / Enter / Space on an unselected, enabled tab → `onSelect` intent; the owner selects
  (React: `onChange`; HTML: `ok:tabs:change`, then `aria-selected`, `tabindex`, panels' `hidden`).
- Arrow keys move focus only (manual activation, MUI default); `selectionFollowsFocus` selects on
  focus. Disabled tabs are skipped.
- Indicator: measured from the selected tab's offset box (ResizeObserver + `document.fonts.ready`
  re-measure). No selection → zero size.
- Scrollable: the scroller scrolls (scrollbar hidden unless `visibleScrollbar`); scroll buttons
  page by the scroller's size (smooth unless reduced motion); a newly selected tab scrolls into
  view (scroller only). `scrollButtons="auto"`: hidden without overflow and below 600px (unless
  `allowScrollButtonsMobile`); `true`: always; `false`: not rendered.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Into the list (selected tab, else the first enabled one), then to the panel |
| → / ← (vertical ↓ / ↑) | Next / previous enabled tab, wrapping (mirrored in RTL) |
| Home / End | First / last enabled tab |
| Enter / Space | Select the focused tab |
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`role="tablist"` named by `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`; `aria-orientation="vertical"` when
vertical; tabs `role="tab"` with `aria-selected` and roving `tabindex`; `aria-controls` ↔ panel
`aria-labelledby`; panels `tabindex="0"`. Scroll buttons are `aria-hidden` pointer aids (the arrow
keys reach every tab). Brand-colored selected text (primary / secondary) is exempt from
`color-contrast` (ADR-0014); unselected text is AA.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:tabs:change` (cancelable) — `detail: { value, previous, tab }`. Instance
`runtime.get(el, "tabs")` → `{ value, setValue(value), select(tab) }` (`setValue` emits nothing).
React: `onChange(value)`; controlled and uncontrolled.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Same size at every breakpoint. Scrollable bars hide their scroll buttons below 600px (`auto`);
standard bars clip, so use `scrollable` for many tabs on phones.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `Tabs`, `Tab`; MUI Lab `TabContext`, `TabList`, `TabPanel`
(mui.com/material-ui/api/tabs, /api/tab, /api/tab-panel, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value`, `onChange(event, value)` | `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` · `aria-selected`, `ok:tabs:change` | kept | value-first callback; `defaultValue` added |
| `variant`, `orientation`, `centered` | same / `data-ok-variant`, `-orientation`, `-centered` | kept | |
| `textColor`, `indicatorColor` | same | kept | `inherit` added (reference default); arbitrary color strings not applicable |
| `scrollButtons`, `allowScrollButtonsMobile`, `visibleScrollbar` | same | kept | |
| `selectionFollowsFocus` | same | kept | |
| `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` | same (on the tablist) | kept | |
| `action` (`updateIndicator`, `updateScrollButtons`) | — | not applicable | the controller re-measures itself (ResizeObserver, fonts) |
| `component` | — | not applicable | root is a `div` |
| — | `segmented` | kept | Owlky addition (reference "Custom") |
| Tab `value`, `label`, `icon`, `iconPosition`, `wrapped`, `disabled` | same | kept | |
| Tab `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| Tab ButtonBase props (`href`, `component`: link tabs) | same: `a[data-ok-tab][href]` (or the component), `data-ok-value`, `aria-current="page"`; the root becomes `role="navigation"` (named), the list loses `role="tablist"` | kept (4.18.71) | navigation pattern: no roving tabindex or arrow keys (core controller: `a[data-ok-tab]`, `isSelectedTab`, `markTab`) |
| Lab `TabPanel` `value`, `keepMounted` | same (React, in a `TabContext`): links itself, `hidden` while another tab is selected, no children unless `keepMounted` | kept (4.18.72) | HTML: the runtime shows the panel named by `aria-controls` |
| Lab `TabContext` | `TabContext` (React): `value` + generated ids for tabs and panels | kept (4.18.72) | |
| Lab `TabList` | `Tabs` (reads the `TabContext` value) | not applicable | `Tabs` owns the list |
| `slots` / `slotProps` (indicator, scroll buttons and icons, scroller, list, scrollbar) | — | not applicable | composition / by decision |
| `classes`, `sx` | — | not applicable | by decision |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"`. Controller-written state (`style`, `data-ok-ready`,
`data-ok-can-scroll-*`) is the same in both (same controller). Parity ignores `style`.
sections.title: Parity notes

sections.body:
Enter and edit text: a native `<input>`, `<textarea>` or `<select>` with a floating label, optional
adornments and helper text.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[data-ok-text-field][data-ok-variant][data-ok-size][data-ok-margin][data-ok-error]?[data-ok-full-width]?[data-ok-shrink]?[data-ok-hidden-label]?[data-ok-focused]?[data-ok-min-rows]?[data-ok-max-rows]?
  label[data-ok-text-field-label][for=<input id>]? (› span[data-ok-text-field-asterisk][aria-hidden] " *")
  div[data-ok-text-field-control]
    span[data-ok-text-field-adornment="start"][data-ok-disable-pointer-events]?   (optional; any element)
    input[data-ok-text-field-input][id][placeholder]   | textarea[…][rows][placeholder] | select[…] › option
    svg[data-ok-text-field-select-icon][aria-hidden]?  (select)
    span[data-ok-text-field-adornment="end"]?
    fieldset[data-ok-text-field-outline][aria-hidden] › legend? › span (label + " *")   (outlined only)
  div[data-ok-text-field-helper][id]?                  (linked by aria-describedby)
```
Inputs and textareas always carry a `placeholder` (" " when none): `:not(:placeholder-shown)` is
how CSS knows there is a value. React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the root; `ref` and the
remaining props go to the input; `className` / `style` to the root.
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `text-field`: listed under "options".)

React: `label`, `helperText`, `startAdornment` / `endAdornment` (`InputAdornment position`),
`multiline` + `rows`, `select` + `<option>` children, `value` / `defaultValue` /
`onChange(value)`, `id` (default `useId()`), native input props. Renamed: `slotProps.input.*Adornment`
→ `startAdornment` / `endAdornment`, `slotProps.inputLabel.shrink` → `shrink` (no slotProps).
`color` keeps MUI's name and values plus `default` (the text color, as on the reference), which is
the default (MUI: `primary`): lines use the palette's `main`, the focused label its AA `-text` tone.
Listbox `select`: `selectProps={{ native: false, … }}` (MUI `SelectProps` / `slotProps.select`)
with `MenuItem` children composes the Select (select.md) in the control: the control gets
`data-ok-select` (+ `data-ok-auto-width` / `data-ok-display-empty`), the trigger
`div[data-ok-text-field-input][data-ok-select-display][role=combobox]` replaces the `<select>`,
followed by the hidden `input[data-ok-select-input]`, the icon (`data-ok-text-field-select-icon
data-ok-select-icon`), the outline and the Select's popover; the label gets `id` (`<id>-label`).
`select` alone stays native (MUI's default is the listbox; additive, no DOM change). Single
values only (`value` stays a string): use FormControl + Select for `multiple`. Not applicable:
`sx`, `classes`, `slots`, `slotProps`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Text `--ok-font-size-lg` (15px) / 24px; label rest `--ok-text-secondary` 15px (filled:
  `grey-700` in light schemes, AA on the tint), floated 16px × 0.75 semibold; focus
  `--ok-text-primary` (or `--ok-c-text` with `color`); error `--ok-palette-error-text`; disabled
  `--ok-text-disabled`. Transitions `--ok-duration-shorter` `--ok-easing-decelerate`.
- Outlined: border 1px grey-500 at 0.2 → hover text-primary → focus 2px; radius `--ok-radius-md`;
  input padding 16 / 14px (small 8 / 14px) → 56 / 40px; label 14px in, rest y 16 (small 8), up −9.
- Filled: grey-500 tint 0.08 (hover / focus 0.16, disabled 0.24, error error channel 0.08);
  padding 24 12 8 (small 20 12 4; no label 16 12 / 8 12); label x 12, up 6 (small 4); focus adds
  a 2px inset ring (the reference has none).
- Standard: underline 1px grey-500 at 0.32 → hover 2px → focus 2px line growing from the
  middle; label space 16px above; padding 4px 0 (small 2px 0).
- Adornments: `--ok-text-secondary`, 14px semibold, 8px from the input. Helper: caption 12 / 18px,
  margin 6px 12px 0, `--ok-text-secondary` (also when disabled, for AA).
- Select: native, `appearance: none`, own arrow 20px at 7px from the end.
- Multiline: textarea `resize: none`; with min / max rows it grows (`field-sizing: content`,
  `min-height` / `max-height` = rows × 1lh); fallback: `rows` = minRows, scrolls.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Inline-flex column; `fullWidth` stretches. No breakpoint rules; the label truncates with an
ellipsis, helper text wraps.
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body: `:focus-within`, input `:disabled`, `:placeholder-shown`, `[data-ok-error]`, hover.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
CSS only. HTML runtime `text-field`: `data-ok-min-rows` / `data-ok-max-rows` → `--_ok-min-rows` /
`--_ok-max-rows` (CSSOM, observed); `data-ok-error` → the input's `aria-invalid="true"` (removed
again only if the runtime set it); a `button[data-ok-text-field-reveal]` inside the field toggles
the input between `password` and `text` and sets `aria-pressed` (React apps keep `type` in state).
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native input, textarea and select behavior.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`<label for>` names the input (no label → `aria-label`); helper via `aria-describedby`; error
sets `aria-invalid`; the asterisk is `aria-hidden` (the input is `required`). The resting label is
`text-secondary`, not the reference's `text-disabled` (AA).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body: HTML: native `input` / `change`. React: `onChange(value)`.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `TextField` (+ FormControl props), `InputAdornment`, `InputBase`, `OutlinedInput`,
`FilledInput`, `Input`, mui.com/material-ui/api/text-field/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant`, `size`, `error`, `fullWidth`, `margin`, `label`, `helperText`, `disabled`, `required` | same | kept | |
| `color` | `color` | kept | + `default` (the default; MUI `primary`) |
| `value`, `defaultValue`, `id`, `name`, `type`, `placeholder`, `autoComplete`, `autoFocus` | same | kept | native ones go to the input; `id` default `useId()` |
| `multiline`, `rows`, `minRows`, `maxRows` | same | kept | |
| `select`, `children` | same | kept | `select` stays native by default (MUI: listbox) |
| `onChange(event)` | `onChange(value)` | renamed | value-first (ADR-0015) |
| `inputRef` | `ref` | renamed | `ref` and rest props go to the input |
| `slotProps.input.startAdornment` / `endAdornment` (`InputProps`) | `startAdornment` / `endAdornment` | renamed | |
| `slotProps.inputLabel.shrink` (`InputLabelProps`) | `shrink` | renamed | |
| `slotProps.htmlInput` (`inputProps`) | rest props on the input | renamed | `readOnly`, `min`, `maxLength`… |
| `slotProps.select` (`SelectProps`) | `selectProps` | renamed | `{ native: false }` → listbox Select; single value only |
| FormControl `hiddenLabel`, `focused`, `component` | same | kept | 4.18.25: `data-ok-hidden-label` (the label is visually hidden but still names the input; the field is laid out as without a label: filled gets the label-less padding, outlined no notch, standard no space above, the placeholder shows), `data-ok-focused` (focus colors, floating label and ring without focus; hover doesn't override them), React `component` = the root element (HTML: any element) |
| InputAdornment `position`, `children` | same | kept | |
| InputAdornment `disablePointerEvents`, `component` | same | kept | 4.18.25: `data-ok-disable-pointer-events` on the adornment (`pointer-events: none`); `component` default `span` (MUI `div`) |
| InputAdornment `disableTypography`, `variant` | — | not applicable | CSS reads the field's variant and styles the text |
| `InputBase`, `OutlinedInput` (`notched`), `FilledInput` (`disableUnderline`), `Input`, `inputComponent` | — | deferred | standalone inputs without label / helper (custom fields, Select `input`) |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots`, other `slotProps` (`formHelperText`, `root`) | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

Related reference features: copy to clipboard (4.20), number input (4.24), phone input (4.25).
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body:
React stories render the password button without state (apps own `type`, see the docs page);
`data-ok-text-field-reveal` is an HTML hook (ignored by parity).

sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `timeline`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `timeline-item`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `timeline-dot`: listed under "options".)

API mapping (MUI Lab): kept Timeline `position`; TimelineItem `position`; TimelineDot `variant`,
`color` (`grey` default, `inherit`, primary, secondary + Owlky's info / success / warning /
error, as on the reference); TimelineSeparator, TimelineConnector, TimelineContent,
TimelineOppositeContent. Not applicable: `classes`, `sx`, `component`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Root padding 6px 16px, list reset. Item: flex row (left: row-reverse), min-height 70px; without
opposite content a `::before` takes the other half (MUI). Content / opposite: `flex: 1`, padding
6px 16px, body1, `overflow-wrap: anywhere`; content aligned away from the line, opposite toward it.
Dot: 4px padding + 2px border (12px), margin 11.5px 0, `--ok-palette-grey-400` (grey), palette
`main`, `--ok-text-primary` (inherit); outlined: border in the color, transparent fill; an icon is
24px (36px dot). Connector: 2px, `--ok-divider`, grows. Alternate: even items reversed
(`alternate-reverse`: odd).

sections.body: None (static).
sections.title: States

sections.body:
A list: screen readers announce count and position. Dots are decorative; content carries the
meaning. Text `--ok-text-primary` (AA).

sections.body: Same at every breakpoint; long words wrap inside their half.

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI Lab `Timeline`, `TimelineItem`, `TimelineSeparator`, `TimelineDot`,
`TimelineConnector`, `TimelineContent`, `TimelineOppositeContent`
(mui.com/material-ui/api/timeline …, checked 2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Timeline `position` | `position` / `data-ok-position` | kept | |
| Timeline `children`, `className` | same | kept | |
| TimelineItem `position` | `position` (`right` · `left`) | kept | `alternate*` on one item not applicable (alternation is a list rule) |
| TimelineDot `variant`, `color` | same / `data-ok-variant`, `data-ok-color` | kept | `info` … `error` as on the reference; arbitrary strings not applicable |
| TimelineSeparator, TimelineConnector | same / `data-ok-timeline-separator`, `-connector` | kept | |
| TimelineContent, TimelineOppositeContent (Typography props) | `div` parts, body1 | renamed | compose a Typography inside for other variants |
| `classes`, `sx` | — | not applicable | by decision |

sections.body:
A button that stays pressed (format text, choose a view). Standalone, or in a group with
exclusive (one) or multiple selection.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
div[role="group"][data-ok-toggle-group][data-ok-orientation][data-ok-exclusive]?[aria-label]
  button[type="button"][data-ok-toggle-button][data-ok-color][data-ok-size][value][aria-pressed]…
    svg[aria-hidden="true"] | text

button[type="button"][data-ok-toggle-button]…[aria-pressed]      (standalone)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `toggle-button`: listed under "options".)

(Options of `toggle-group`: listed under "options".)

Other props (not options):

| HTML | React | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | string identifying the button in a group |
| group value | `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange` | exclusive: `string \| null`; multiple: `string[]` |

React passes the group's `color`, `size` and `disabled` to every child (a child prop wins).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
- Unpressed: secondary text color. Pressed: bg `channel` 8 % and `main` text (standard:
  `--ok-action-selected`, primary text); standalone pressed buttons also get a `currentColor` border.
- Standalone: 1px border (grey 20 %). Group: 1px border (grey 16 %), 4px padding and gap; buttons inside
  have no border.
- `:hover` (`hover: hover`): `--ok-action-hover` (colored: `channel` 8 %). `:disabled`:
  `--ok-action-disabled` text; pressed + disabled: `--ok-action-disabled-bg` fill.
sections.title: States

sections.body:
Runtime needed in HTML (React keeps state). Selection logic is shared in core
(`nextToggleSelection()`): exclusive → pressing the pressed button clears the selection, any other
replaces it; multiple → adds or removes the value. Disabled buttons never change.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body: Native buttons: `Tab` to each button, `Enter` / `Space` toggle.
sections.title: Keyboard

sections.body:
`aria-pressed` carries the state; the group is `role="group"` (add `aria-label`). Icon-only buttons
need `aria-label`.
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML, cancelable (call `preventDefault()` to keep the current state):
- `ok:toggle-button:change` on a standalone button — `detail: { pressed }` (the new state).
- `ok:toggle-group:change` on the group — `detail: { value, previous, button }` (`value` shaped as
  in the options table).

Instances: `runtime.get(el, "toggle-button")` → `{ pressed, setPressed(pressed) }`;
`runtime.get(el, "toggle-group")` → `{ value, setValue(value) }` (setters don't emit events).
React: `onChange(selected)` on a standalone `ToggleButton`, `onChange(value)` on `ToggleButtonGroup`;
both work controlled and uncontrolled.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body: Same size at every breakpoint; use `vertical` for narrow screens.
sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI `ToggleButton`, `ToggleButtonGroup`, mui.com/material-ui/api/toggle-button/ and
/toggle-button-group/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| ToggleButton `children`, `value`, `selected`, `color`, `disabled`, `fullWidth`, `onClick` | same | kept | `onClick` native; + `defaultSelected` (uncontrolled) |
| ToggleButton `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`) | renamed | |
| ToggleButton `onChange(event, value)` | `onChange(selected)` | renamed | value-first (ADR-0015) |
| ToggleButtonGroup `children`, `exclusive`, `value`, `orientation`, `fullWidth`, `color`, `disabled` | same | kept | + `defaultValue`; exclusive value `string \| null` |
| ToggleButtonGroup `size` | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`) | renamed | |
| ToggleButtonGroup `onChange(event, value)` | `onChange(value)` | renamed | HTML `ok:toggle-group:change` |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (+ ButtonBase ripple props) | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
sections.title: Upstream API mapping

sections.body: React renders `data-ok-runtime="off"` on the group and on standalone buttons.

sections.body:
A short text label on hover, focus or long press. Runtime behavior: core `createHoverIntent`
(timing) + `createPopoverController` (positioning; no focus move, no outside dismiss).
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
trigger[aria-labelledby="id"] | trigger[aria-describedby="id"]      (describeChild)
div[data-ok-tooltip][role=tooltip][popover=manual][id][data-ok-placement][data-ok-arrow]?[data-ok-transition]?
  › span[data-ok-tooltip-arrow][aria-hidden]       (always rendered; shown with data-ok-arrow)
  › text
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `tooltip`: listed under "options".)

React: `title`, one element `children` (cloned: relation attribute, pointer / focus handlers,
merged ref), `describeChild`, `open` / `onOpenChange(open)`, `enterTouchDelay` (700),
`leaveTouchDelay` (1500), `disableHoverListener`, `disableFocusListener`,
`disableTouchListener`. Renamed: `TransitionComponent` (Grow / Fade / Zoom) → `transition`;
`onOpen` / `onClose` → `onOpenChange`. Kept behavior: `describeChild=false` names the trigger
(MUI sets `aria-label`; we use `aria-labelledby`, same name). Kept (4.6): `followCursor`
(`data-ok-follow-cursor`: on `pointermove` over the trigger the tooltip opens at and follows a
core `pointAnchor(x, y, trigger)` virtual anchor; focus and touch keep the trigger as anchor) and
`enterNextDelay` (`data-ok-enter-next-delay`: core `createHoverIntent` keeps a module-scoped
count of shown tooltips and the last close; while one shows or within 800 ms of a close the next
one waits `enterNextDelay`). Default `enterNextDelay`: `enterDelay` (MUI 0; kept so existing
tooltips keep their timing). Not applicable: `disableInteractive` (always hoverable, WCAG 1.4.13),
`PopperProps`, `slots`, `slotProps`, `components`, `sx`.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`--ok-palette-grey-800` (dark scheme grey-700, via `light-dark()`), white text, 11px (font-size-xs −
1px) 500 / 1.5, padding 4px 8px, radius `--ok-radius-sm`, max width 300px. Gap 8px (10px with the
arrow); arrow 10px. Transitions: grow (scale 0.75) / fade / zoom, `--ok-duration-shortest`.
`--ok-z-tooltip` in the fallback.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body: Flips and shifts to stay 16px inside the viewport.
sections.title: Responsive behavior
Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML: `ok:tooltip:open` (`detail.trigger`), `ok:tooltip:close`. Instance: `{ isOpen, show(trigger?),
hide() }`. Triggers are found by delegation (`aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` pointing at a
`[data-ok-tooltip]`).
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API page Tooltip.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title`, `children` (one element), `placement`, `arrow`, `describeChild`, `id` | same | kept | name through `aria-labelledby` (MUI: `aria-label`) |
| `enterDelay`, `leaveDelay`, `enterTouchDelay`, `leaveTouchDelay` | same | kept | |
| `disableHoverListener`, `disableFocusListener`, `disableTouchListener` | same | kept | |
| `open`; `onOpen` / `onClose` | `open`; `onOpenChange(open)`; HTML `ok:tooltip:open` / `close` | renamed | |
| `TransitionComponent` (Grow / Fade / Zoom) | `transition` (`grow` `fade` `zoom`) | renamed | |
| `followCursor`, `enterNextDelay` | same (`data-ok-follow-cursor`, `data-ok-enter-next-delay`) | kept (4.6) | `enterNextDelay` defaults to `enterDelay` (MUI 0) |
| `disableInteractive` | — (always hoverable) | not applicable | WCAG 1.4.13 |
| `placement` `auto` / `auto-start` / `auto-end` | — | not applicable | the controller flips |
| `PopperComponent` / `PopperProps`, `slots.popper` / `transition` / `arrow` | — | not applicable | core positioning, top layer |
| `sx`, `classes`, `slots` / `slotProps`, `components` / `componentsProps` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015: CSS and composition |

Panels 220px (`spacing` × 55, max 100%), `--ok-bg-paper`, `--ok-shadow-card`, `--ok-radius-xl`;

move nothing are disabled. Enhanced: select-all checks / clears a side, shows mixed

sections.body:
Upstream: the MUI "Transfer list" demo (mui.com/material-ui/react-transfer-list/); MUI has no
component, so the demo's state and handlers map to props.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic demo: `left` / `right` state, `checked` rows, `handleAllRight` / `handleCheckedRight` / `handleCheckedLeft` / `handleAllLeft`, buttons disabled when nothing moves | `variant="simple"`, `left` / `right` / `defaultLeft`, `onChange(left, right)` | kept | checked state is internal |
| Enhanced demo: titled cards, `handleToggleAll` (mixed), `numberOfChecked` ("n/m selected") | `variant="enhanced"`, `titles`, `getCountLabel(checked, total)` | kept | |
| `not` / `intersection` / `union` helpers | core `transferMove` / `canTransfer` / `toggleAll` / `sideCheckedState` | renamed | |
| `customList` (List › ListItemButton › Checkbox) | Scrollbar › List › Checkbox rows in a `label` | renamed | no nested interactive rows |

Beyond the demo: `disabled`, `buttonLabels`, `id`, HTML `move(direction)`.

sections.body:
Nested items people expand and select (WAI-ARIA tree). Behavior is core `createTreeController`
(keys, clicks, typeahead → intent) and `nextTreeSelection`; React owns expanded / selected ids,
the HTML runtime `tree-view` writes them to the DOM.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
ul[data-ok-tree-view][role=tree][data-ok-variant][data-ok-expansion-trigger][aria-label]
    [aria-multiselectable]?[data-ok-multi-select]?[data-ok-checkbox-selection]?[data-ok-disable-selection]?
    [data-ok-disabled-items-focusable]?[data-ok-items-reordering]?[data-ok-item-children-indentation]?
    [data-ok-editable]?[data-ok-selection-propagation="parents descendants"]?[data-ok-highlight]?[aria-busy]?
  li[role=treeitem][data-ok-tree-item][data-ok-item-id][tabindex][aria-expanded]?[aria-selected]?[aria-disabled]?
    [data-ok-disable-selection]?[data-ok-editable]?[data-ok-reorderable="false"]?[data-ok-lazy]?[aria-busy]?
    [data-ok-error]?   written by owners: [data-ok-highlighted]?[data-ok-highlighted-ancestor]?
                       written by the controller while dragging: [data-ok-dragging]?[data-ok-drop-position]?
    div[data-ok-tree-item-content]
      span[data-ok-tree-item-icon] › svg[data-ok-tree-chevron] | span[data-ok-tree-expand-icon] + span[data-ok-tree-collapse-icon] | end icon
                                    | CircularProgress (loading) | svg[data-ok-tree-error-icon]
      span[data-ok-tree-item-checkbox][aria-hidden]? › span[data-ok-checkbox] (small, tabindex -1)
      span[data-ok-tree-item-label][hidden]?   (hidden while edited)
      input[data-ok-tree-item-label-input][aria-label]?   (editing)
      span[data-ok-tree-item-error]?           (children failed to load)
    ul[data-ok-collapse][role=group][data-ok-tree-item-group][hidden]?      (branches only; a Collapse)
```
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `tree-view`: listed under "options".)

Other props: `expandedItems` / `defaultExpandedItems` / `onExpandedItemsChange(ids)`,
`onItemExpansionToggle(id, expanded)`, `selectedItems` / `defaultSelectedItems` /
`onSelectedItemsChange` (`string | null`, `string[]` when multi), `expandIcon`, `collapseIcon`,
`endIcon`, `onItemSelectionToggle(id, selected)`, `onItemClick(id)`, `onItemFocus(id)`,
`selectionPropagation` (`{ parents, descendants }`), `highlight` (search text), `apiRef`
(`useTreeViewApiRef()`); TreeItem `itemId`, `label`, `disabled`, `disableSelection`;
RichTreeView `items` (`{ id, label, children?, disabled? }[]`), `getItemId`, `getItemLabel`,
`getItemChildren`, `isItemDisabled`, `isItemSelectionDisabled`, `isItemEditable` (boolean or
function) + `onItemLabelChange(id, label)`, `itemsReordering` + `isItemReorderable(id)` +
`canMoveItemToNewPosition(change)` + `onItemPositionChange(change)`, `dataSource`
(`{ getChildrenCount(item), getTreeItems(parentId?) }`), `dataSourceErrorLabel`.

API mapping (MUI X): kept the props above, `multiSelect`, `checkboxSelection` (implies multi),
`disableSelection`, `expansionTrigger`. Renamed: `slots.expandIcon` / `collapseIcon` / `endIcon`
→ props. Beyond MUI X (reference "Custom styling"): `variant="lines"`; `highlight` (roadmap
4.18.8). As in MUI X, editing, reordering, lazy loading and the item accessors are RichTreeView
props (they need the items as data); the HTML runtime offers them on any markup. Deferred:
virtualization (`itemHeight`, `domStructure: "flat"`; needs an ADR: flat DOM vs nested groups).
Not applicable: `slots`, `slotProps`, `sx`.
Group transition (MUI X `slots.groupTransition`, default Collapse): each group is a Collapse
(collapse.md, ADR-0044; React `TreeItem` renders `Collapse component="ul"`, HTML snippets carry
`data-ok-collapse`); the runtime still writes the group's `hidden`, the Collapse animates it.
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
Rows: min 30px, padding 4px 8px (+`itemChildrenIndentation`, default 12px, per level through
`--_ok-tree-indent`, up to 6 levels, rows stay full width), gap 8px,
`--ok-radius-md`; icon 18px; label body2. Hover `--ok-action-hover`; selected
`rgb(primary / 0.08)` (checkbox selection: the checkbox shows it); focus-visible 2px outline +
`--ok-action-focus`; disabled 0.48. Chevron turns 90° when open (`--ok-duration-shortest`).
Lines: groups indented 17px with a 1px dashed `rgb(grey-500 / 0.4)` guide, rows `--ok-radius-xs`,
labels 13px medium, expand icons round `rgb(primary / 0.25)`, selected `rgb(primary / 0.2)`.
Editing: a 1px primary-bordered input in the label's place. Drag: the dragged row 0.48, the
target row a 2px primary inset line above / below, or a primary ring with a 0.16 tint (inside).
Lazy: a 16px CircularProgress in the icon while loading; error: error-colored icon and a caption
(`--ok-palette-error-text`). Highlight: matching labels on `rgb(warning / 0.24)`, semibold;
ancestors' labels semibold.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Click on the row (or only the icon with `iconContainer`) toggles a branch; click selects (multi:
Ctrl / ⌘ toggles, Shift selects a range from the anchor). The checkbox toggles selection.
Single select replaces; selecting the selected item keeps it. Tab stop: the selected item
(if visible), else the first focusable one. Disabled items are skipped by arrows, Home / End and
typeahead unless `disabledItemsFocusable` (MUI's default; before, they were always focusable).
Selection propagation (multi select, core `propagateTreeSelection` on the DOM): descendants
follow an item; a parent is selected exactly when all its selectable children are.
Editing (core controller): F2 or a double click on the label starts it (`data-ok-editable`);
Enter saves, Escape cancels, blur saves; focus returns to the item.
Reordering (core controller, `data-ok-items-reordering`): a pointer drag on the row (after 4px)
drops before (top quarter), after (bottom quarter) or inside the target; the keyboard path
(WCAG 2.5.7) is Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + ↑ / ↓ (among siblings), → (into the previous sibling) and
← (out, after the parent). Positions are `{ parentId, index }` with the item removed first;
the new parent opens and the moved item keeps the focus. Lazy loading: items with children to
load are expandable without children; expanding one loads them (`aria-busy`), a failure shows
the error, expanding again retries. Expansion helpers: core `treeBranchIds` (expand all, to a
depth, a subtree); highlight: core `treeHighlight` / `applyTreeHighlight`.
sections.title: Behavior

sections.body:
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| ↓ / ↑ | Next / previous visible item (Shift: extend, multi) |
| → | Open; if open, first child |
| ← | Close; if closed, parent |
| Home / End | First / last visible item |
| Enter | Toggle a branch; select a leaf |
| F2 | Edit the label (editable items); Enter saves, Escape cancels |
| Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + ↑ ↓ ← → | Move the item (with reordering) |
| Space | Select (multi: toggle; Shift: range) |
| * | Open all siblings |
| Letters | Typeahead |

sections.body:
`role=tree` named; items `aria-expanded` / `aria-selected` / `aria-disabled`;
`aria-multiselectable`; icons and checkboxes decorative (`aria-hidden`).
sections.title: Accessibility

sections.body:
HTML `ok:tree-view:expand` (cancelable, `{ itemId, expanded }`), `ok:tree-view:select`
(cancelable, `{ selectedItems }`), `selectiontoggle` (`{ itemId, selected }`), `itemclick`,
`itemfocus` (`{ itemId }`), `labelchange` (cancelable, `{ itemId, label }`), `move` (cancelable,
`{ itemId, oldPosition, newPosition }`, MUI `canMoveItemToNewPosition`), `positionchange`.
Instance `{ expandedItems, selectedItems, setExpanded(id, expanded), setSelected(ids),
expandAll(), collapseAll(), expandToDepth(depth), expandSubtree(id), focusItem(id),
getItemOrderedChildrenIds(id | null), setEditedItem(id | null), updateItemLabel(id, label),
highlight(query), setDataSource({ getTreeItems(parentId?) } | null) }` — data source items
`{ id, label, disabled?, childrenCount? }` are built with text only. React `apiRef`: the same
expansion methods plus `getItem`, `getItemDOMElement`, `getItemTree`, `isItemExpanded`,
`setItemExpansion`, `selectItem`.

sections.title: Responsive

sections.body:
Upstream: MUI X `SimpleTreeView`, `RichTreeView`, `TreeItem` (mui.com/x/api/tree-view/…, checked
2026-11-09).

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expandedItems`, `defaultExpandedItems`, `onExpandedItemsChange`, `onItemExpansionToggle` | same · `aria-expanded`, `ok:tree-view:expand` | kept | callbacks without the event |
| `selectedItems`, `defaultSelectedItems`, `onSelectedItemsChange` | same · `aria-selected`, `ok:tree-view:select` | kept | |
| `multiSelect`, `checkboxSelection`, `disableSelection`, `expansionTrigger` | same / `data-ok-*` | kept | |
| RichTreeView `items` | `items` (`{ id, label, children?, disabled? }`) | kept | |
| `slots` `expandIcon` / `collapseIcon` / `endIcon` | props | renamed | |
| `slots.groupTransition` | each group is a Collapse | kept | ADR-0044 |
| — | `variant="lines"` | kept | Owlky addition (reference "Custom styling") |
| TreeItem `itemId`, `label`, `disabled`, `children` | same | kept | |
| `onItemSelectionToggle`, `onItemClick`, `onItemFocus` | same, without the event; HTML `selectiontoggle`, `itemclick`, `itemfocus` | renamed | 4.18.69 |

| — | `expandAll`, `collapseAll`, `expandToDepth`, `expandSubtree` (apiRef, instance); `highlight` | kept | 4.18.8, beyond MUI |
| `isItemEditable` / `onItemLabelChange` | same (RichTreeView); HTML `data-ok-editable`, `labelchange` | kept | 4.11 |
| lazy loading (`dataSource` `getChildrenCount` / `getTreeItems`) | same (RichTreeView, `dataSourceErrorLabel`); HTML `setDataSource`, `data-ok-lazy` | kept | 4.11; no `dataSourceCache` (loaded children stay) |

| `id` | `id` (DOM attribute) | kept | |
| `classes`, `sx`, other `slots` / `slotProps` | — | not applicable | by decision |

sections.body:
Text in one step of the type scale (`--ok-typography-<variant>-*` tokens of `@owlky/tokens`,
responsive at the token breakpoints). CSS only; the element is the author's choice.
sections.title: Purpose

sections.body:
```
<element>[data-ok-typography][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color]?[data-ok-align]?[data-ok-gutter-bottom]?[data-ok-no-wrap]?
```
React picks the element from `variantMapping` (default below) unless `component` is given;
HTML authors write it.

| Variant | `h1`–`h6` | `subtitle1`, `subtitle2` | `body1`, `body2`, `inherit` | `caption`, `overline`, `button` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Element | `h1`–`h6` | `h6` | `p` | `span` |
sections.title: Anatomy

sections.body:
(Options of `typography`: listed under "options".)

React: `children`, `component` (any element type), `variantMapping` (partial, merged over the
default), `ref` (the rendered element), every attribute of the element (`htmlFor`, `id`…).
Not applicable: `sx`, `classes`, `paragraph` (deprecated upstream: `component="p"` +
`gutterBottom`), theme-level `variantMapping` / custom variants (consumer CSS on
`[data-ok-variant="…"]` or the tokens), arbitrary color strings such as `"text.secondary"` /
`"primary.dark"` (use `style` / CSS).
sections.title: Options

sections.body:
`margin: 0`. Each variant: `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-weight`, `line-height`,
`text-transform` from `--ok-typography-<variant>-*` (h1–h3 use the secondary font family through
the tokens; font presets apply). `inherit`: `font: inherit; text-transform: inherit`. Colors:
palette `--ok-c-main` (the `[data-ok-color]` binding), `--ok-text-primary|secondary|disabled`.
`gutterBottom`: `margin-block-end: 0.35em`. `noWrap`: `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
white-space: nowrap`. `typography.css` loads first in `owlky.css` so components that compose
Typography restyle it through their own CSS (same zero specificity, later wins).

Unknown values (HTML) get no rule: the text keeps the parent's font, color and alignment.
sections.title: Layout and tokens

sections.body:
Fluid. Heading sizes (h1–h6) step up at 600 / 900 / 1200px through the tokens; text wraps
except with `noWrap` (one line, ellipsis).
sections.title: Responsive behavior

sections.body:
Not focusable. Variant and element are independent: keep the heading outline (`component`).
Sizes in `rem`. Palette colors use `main` (ADR-0014, exempt from `color-contrast` like other
brand text); `textPrimary` / `textSecondary` meet AA; `textDisabled` is for inactive content.
sections.title: Keyboard / Accessibility

sections.body: None.
sections.title: Events / API

sections.body:
Audit 2026-11-09 against MUI API page Typography.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant`, `align`, `gutterBottom`, `noWrap`, `component`, `variantMapping`, `children` | same | kept | |
| `color` | palette names + `textPrimary` / `textSecondary` / `textDisabled` | kept | no arbitrary strings (`"text.secondary"`) |
| `paragraph` | `component="p"` + `gutterBottom` | not applicable | deprecated upstream |
| theme custom variants / theme `variantMapping` | CSS on `[data-ok-variant]` or tokens | not applicable | |
| Minimals "Text max line" | — | deferred (4.19) | `maxLines` |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |
